items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出残差学习框架，以减轻训练比以往更深网络的难度：把网络层显式地重构为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而非学习无参照的函数。实验证据表明，残差网络更易优化，并能从大幅增加的深度中获益。在 ImageNet 上，我们评估了深达 152 层、比 VGG 深 8 倍而复杂度更低的残差网络，其集成模型取得 3.57% 的测试错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名；在 CIFAR-10 上还分析了 100 层与 1000 层的网络。表征深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要，仅凭极深的表征即在 COCO 目标检测上取得 28% 的相对提升。
items.highlight_zh: 残差学习让 152 层网络更易训练，夺得 ILSVRC 2015 冠军
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：神经网络越深，理论上表达能力越强，但深层网络很难训练，优化困难、精度反而下降。
方法：作者提出「残差学习」——不让若干层直接学目标映射，而是学输入与输出之间的「残差」，并把输入经捷径直接加到输出上，构成残差块。网络只需学「在原有基础上改多少」，优化因此变得容易。
结果：在 ImageNet 上训练了深达 152 层的残差网络，比 VGG 深 8 倍而计算复杂度更低；多个残差网络集成后测试错误率仅 3.57%，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类冠军。在 CIFAR-10 上还验证了 100 层乃至 1000 层网络的可行性。把这种极深表征用于 COCO 目标检测，带来 28% 的相对提升。
为何重要：它说明「深度」本身可以被有效利用，残差连接此后成为几乎所有深层网络的基础组件；该团队也凭此在 ILSVRC/COCO 2015 的检测、定位、分割等多项任务中夺冠。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 用 AlphaFold 实现高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上理解其功能。实验已测定约 10 万个独特蛋白质的结构，但这只占已知数十亿条序列的一小部分；测定单个结构往往需要数月到数年，成为结构覆盖的瓶颈。仅凭氨基酸序列预测三维结构——「蛋白质折叠问题」中的结构预测部分——已开放五十余年，现有方法仍远未达到原子精度，在没有同源结构时尤其如此。本文给出首个能在无相似结构已知时也稳定以原子精度预测结构的方法：完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold，在第 14 届 CASP14 评估中多数案例精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅优于其他方法。其核心是把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识（借助多序列比对）融入深度学习算法设计。
items.highlight_zh: 在无同源结构时也能以原子级精度预测蛋白质结构
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：蛋白质的三维结构决定其功能，但实验测定一个结构往往要数月到数年；已知蛋白序列有数十亿条，已解析结构仅约 10 万，结构覆盖严重不足。仅凭氨基酸序列预测结构——「蛋白折叠问题」的一部分——已悬而未决 50 多年。
方法：作者完全重新设计了基于神经网络的模型 AlphaFold，把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识（尤其是多序列比对中蕴含的共进化信息）融入深度学习算法的设计。
结果：在第 14 届国际蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP14）中，AlphaFold 在多数目标上达到可与实验结构媲美的原子级精度，显著优于其他方法——这是首个在没有相似结构可用时也能稳定给出原子级精度预测的计算方法。
为何重要：它为大规模结构生物信息学打开大门，使海量序列的结构预测成为可能，对基础生物学研究与药物研发都有深远影响。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 利用衍射深度神经网络实现全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光学衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：在通过深度学习设计出协同工作的被动衍射层后，该网络可以学会实现多种功能。我们用 3D 打印的 D2NN 在太赫兹波段实验演示了该框架的成功——它学会了执行手写数字分类以及成像透镜的功能。借助现有的众多 3D 打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这一全光学深度学习框架能够以光速执行计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，并将在全光学图像分析、特征检测和目标分类中得到应用，还可促成能借 D2NN 学习执行独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 3D 打印的衍射层让光本身以光速完成分类与成像
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：常规神经网络靠电子计算，速度受硬件限制；能否让光本身完成神经网络的计算？
方法：作者提出衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）——把多层被动衍射元件堆叠成网络，每个像素对通过的光施加特定调制，光在层间传播与逐层调制，整体效果类比神经网络中的「层＋激活」。网络参数用类似深度学习的方式训练得到，再用 3D 打印制作成实物。
结果：在太赫兹波段，他们做出实物 D2NN，成功实现手写数字分类和「成像透镜」两种功能——光穿过器件后在输出面即完成计算。
为何重要：该框架可利用成熟的 3D 打印、光刻和空间光调制器制造，以光速、较低功耗执行图像分析、特征检测与目标分类等任务，还可能催生能「学习」的新型相机与光学元件。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且被广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，数据科学家广泛使用它在众多机器学习挑战中取得最优结果。我们提出一种新颖的面向稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位草图。更重要的是，我们给出了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的洞见，用以构建可扩展的树提升系统。结合这些设计，XGBoost 能用远少于现有系统的资源扩展到十亿级以上的样本。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知与加权分位草图让树提升扩展到十亿级样本
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：树提升（如梯度提升树）在机器学习竞赛和工业界效果极好，但当样本量达到数十亿、特征高度稀疏时，已有系统难以高效扩展。
方法：作者设计了端到端可扩展的树提升系统 XGBoost，核心包括：面向稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法（能自动处理缺失值、减少无效计算）、用于近似查找分裂点的加权分位草图，以及在系统层面的洞见——缓存访问模式优化、数据压缩与数据分片。
结果：把这些设计结合起来，XGBoost 能用远少于既有系统的资源扩展到十亿级以上的样本量，并在众多机器学习任务上取得当时的最优效果。
为何重要：它把算法改进与系统工程洞见结合，成为数据科学家的常用工具，也说明「可扩展性」往往是机器学习方法能否真正落地的关键。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：面向语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出新的语言表示模型 BERT（即来自 Transformer 的双向编码器表示）。与近期模型不同，BERT 通过在每一层同时联合左右两侧上下文，从无标注文本中预训练深度双向表示。预训练好的 BERT 只需增加一个输出层即可微调，在问答、语言推断等众多任务上达到最先进水平，而无需对任务特定架构做大改动。BERT 概念简单而在实验中十分强大，在十一项自然语言处理任务上刷新纪录：GLUE 达 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率 86.7%（提升 4.6 个百分点），SQuAD v1.1 测试 F1 达 93.2（提升 1.5 点），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 达 83.1（提升 5.1 点）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练加单层微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务纪录
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：在 BERT 之前，语言模型多为单向（从左到右）或浅层拼接双向，难以同时利用完整上下文；而且每个下游任务都要定制网络结构，复用性差。
- 方法：BERT 用 Transformer 编码器做类似“完形填空”的掩码语言建模（随机遮住部分词再预测），并加入判断句对关系的预训练任务，在海量无标注文本上预训练。关键在于每一层都能同时看到左右两侧上下文，得到真正的深度双向表示。下游使用时只需在顶部加一层输出、用少量标注数据微调。
- 结果：在 11 项自然语言处理任务上刷新纪录，GLUE 提升到 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率 86.7%，SQuAD v1.1 与 v2.0 的 F1 分别为 93.2 和 83.1。
- 为何重要：它确立了“大规模预训练 + 轻量微调”的通用范式，把“一个任务造一个模型”变成“一套预训练模型服务多种任务”，成为此后 NLP 与大模型研究的基础路线。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的高精度开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能用单目、双目与 RGB-D 相机及针孔、鱼眼镜头模型，完成视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。其一，紧耦合的视觉惯性 SLAM 完全基于最大后验（MAP）估计，即使 IMU 初始化阶段也如此，因而可在室内外各种规模场景中实时稳健运行，精度比以往方法高 2 至 5 倍。其二，多地图系统依赖召回率更高的新场景识别方法：在视觉信息长期贫乏时仍能存活，丢失后新建地图，重访已建图区域时再无缝合并。它首次在各算法阶段复用全部历史信息，使时间相隔久远或来自此前会话的共视关键帧也能参与光束法平差，提供高视差观测以提升精度。实验显示其稳健性与文献最佳系统相当而精度显著更高：双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机上平均 3.6 cm，TUM-VI 快速手持场景下达 9 mm。源码已公开。
items.highlight_zh: 首个统一视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的开源系统
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：机器人与 AR/VR 设备需要边移动边定位并建图（SLAM）。此前系统往往只支持某一种相机或传感器组合，且只利用最近几秒的信息；一旦跟踪丢失就彻底失败，重访旧场景也难以复用过去的建图成果。
- 方法：ORB-SLAM3 用特征点法把视觉观测与 IMU 读数紧耦合，整个流程（包括 IMU 初始化）统一在最大后验估计框架下求解；同时引入召回率更高的场景识别方法，维护“多地图”结构：跟踪丢失就另起一张新地图，回到旧区域时把新旧地图无缝合并，并让时间相隔很久、甚至来自上一次建图会话的关键帧也参与光束法平差。
- 结果：支持单目、双目、RGB-D 与针孔、鱼眼多种配置，精度比以往方法高 2–5 倍；双目惯性版本在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均误差 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 快速手持场景中约 9 mm，稳健性与当时最好的系统相当。
- 为何重要：它首次让系统在各个阶段复用全部历史信息，在视觉信息长期匮乏时仍能工作，且代码开源，成为 SLAM 研究与产品落地的重要基线。

items.title_en: Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies
items.title_zh: 具身智能未通过镜像测试：一面简单的镜子即可击溃机器人策略
items.abstract_en: Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with $π_{0.5}$ and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.
items.abstract_zh: 一面简单的镜子能否暴露当今机器人操作策略的局限？受动物认知中镜像自我识别测试启发，我们考察机器人策略能否在含自身倒影的场景中可靠地操作物体。我们构建 RoboDojo-Mirror 基准，保持任务目标、成功判据与策略检查点不变，对比无镜基线、单镜、双镜与镜面桌面四种条件。在涵盖视觉-语言-动作模型、世界动作模型与智能体策略的五个策略上，各镜像条件均降低总体成功率：三种条件平均下降 10.8 至 56.7 个百分点，镜面桌面条件下降达 62.5 个百分点。由于镜子也是物理障碍，我们与几何匹配的非反射面板对照；50–88% 的镜像特异性失败没有机器人与面板接触的记录，说明单纯碰撞不足以解释性能退化。轨迹与接触分析揭示出与“瞄准倒影中的幻影物体”和真实物体空间定位错误相一致的行为。π0.5 与 FastWAM 的真机实验同样显示竖直镜面与镜面桌面下成功率下降。这些发现表明多种机器人策略对反射环境存在共同脆弱性，并推动反射感知的具身智能评测。
items.highlight_zh: 镜像场景令机器人策略成功率最多下降 62.5 个百分点
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：如今的机器人操作策略（包括视觉-语言-动作模型）在干净、无干扰的场景里表现不错，但真实环境常有镜子、玻璃等反射面。作者借用动物认知里的“镜像自我识别测试”发问：机器人会不会被自己的倒影骗到？
- 方法：构建基准 RoboDojo-Mirror，在保持任务目标、成功判据与模型权重不变的前提下，把同一批任务分别放到无镜、单镜、双镜和镜面桌面上测试；另设几何形状相同但不可反射的面板作对照，并用轨迹与接触记录分析失败原因；再在真实机器人上用 π0.5 与 FastWAM 验证。
- 结果：五个策略在所有镜像条件下成功率都下降，平均降低 10.8–56.7 个百分点，镜面桌面最多降 62.5 个百分点。对照实验显示 50–88% 的镜像相关失败并未发生机器人与面板的接触，说明不是单纯碰撞所致；行为分析指向“把倒影当真物体去抓”和“真实物体定位偏移”。
- 为何重要：它揭示不同架构的具身智能共享同一类脆弱性，提示评测必须纳入反射等光学干扰，而不能只在理想场景中比较成功率。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: A multimodal foundation model for tissue proteomics and morphology in cancer
items.title_zh: 面向癌症组织蛋白质组学与形态学的多模态基础模型
items.abstract_en: Cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment decisions increasingly rely on integrating tissue morphology with specific molecular readouts of the tumor and its microenvironment. H&E histopathology provides scalable morphology, whereas multiplex spatial proteomics quantifies dozens of proteins in situ with spatial context, but remains selectively deployed, often with different marker panels across cohorts. This creates a translational bottleneck: most patients lack high-depth molecular profiling, and existing models rarely integrate morphology and spatial molecular data in a single framework. We present VirTues-M2, a multimodal foundation model that jointly learns from H&E and spatial proteomics using a novel vision transformer-based architecture. By encoding marker identity during pretraining, VirTues-M2 is robust to missing modalities, imperfect modality pairing or registration, and variable marker panels, enabling unified inference for tissue phenotyping, panoptic cell segmentation, virtual staining, annotation-free biomarker discovery, and reinforcement learning-based adaptive marker panel selection to reduce assay burden. As a concrete demonstration of translational utility, in a newly collected cohort of 1,053 treatment-naive non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with paired spatial proteomics and H&E, VirTues-M2 discovers high-risk and low-risk tissue signatures that stratify overall survival in both the discovery cohort and an independent validation cohort, outperforming current state-of-the-art stratification schemes; all enabled by VirTues-M2's ability to jointly analyze both modalities within a single model.
items.abstract_zh: 癌症诊断、预后与治疗决策日益依赖把组织形态学与肿瘤及其微环境的特异性分子读数结合起来。H&E 组织病理提供可扩展的形态学信息，多重空间蛋白质组学能原位量化数十种蛋白并保留空间背景，但其部署具有选择性，各队列所用标记面板也常不同，由此形成转化瓶颈：多数患者缺乏高深度分子谱，现有模型也鲜有在单一框架内整合形态与空间分子数据者。我们提出 VirTues-M2，一种基于新型视觉 Transformer 架构、从 H&E 与空间蛋白质组学联合学习的多模态基础模型。通过在预训练中编码标记身份，该模型对模态缺失、配对或配准不完美、标记面板可变均具鲁棒性，可统一支持组织表型分析、全景细胞分割、虚拟染色、免标注生物标志物发现，以及基于强化学习的自适应标记面板选择以减少检测负担。在新收集的 1,053 例初治非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者配对空间蛋白质组学与 H&E 队列中，模型发现的高风险与低风险组织特征在发现队列和独立验证队列中均能分层总生存期，优于当前最先进的分层方案。
items.highlight_zh: 联合 H&E 与空间蛋白质组学，可分层肺癌生存风险
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：癌症诊疗越来越依赖“看形态 + 测分子”，但 H&E 染色切片便宜易得，空间蛋白质组学却昂贵、只在部分患者中开展，且不同队列使用的蛋白标记面板还不一致。数据缺失、配对不全、面板不统一，成为把分子信息用于临床的瓶颈。
- 方法：作者提出多模态基础模型 VirTues-M2，基于视觉 Transformer，同时从 H&E 图像与空间蛋白质组学中学习。预训练时把“标记身份”编码进模型，因此即使某种模态缺失、切片与分子数据配对或配准不完美、面板种类变化，模型仍能工作。一个模型即可完成组织表型分析、全景细胞分割、虚拟染色、免人工标注的生物标志物发现，还能用强化学习挑选最必要的标记面板以降低检测成本。
- 结果：在 1,053 例初治非小细胞肺癌患者（配对空间蛋白质组学与 H&E）的新队列中，模型找到的高风险与低风险组织特征能在发现队列和独立验证队列中区分总生存期，效果优于现有最先进的分层方案。
- 为何重要：它把“便宜的形态信息”和“昂贵但稀疏的分子信息”放进同一框架，有望让缺乏深度分子检测的患者也获得分子层面的风险判断，并减少实际检测所需的面板规模。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Geometry-conditioned differentiable surrogate with adjoint Monte Carlo sampling for scintillator detector co-design
items.title_zh: 面向闪烁体探测器协同设计的几何条件可微代理模型与伴随蒙特卡罗采样
items.abstract_en: Optimizing light-guide geometries for scintillator-based imaging detectors requires repeated photon-transport evaluations, making direct Monte Carlo simulation computationally costly. Differentiable surrogates can accelerate these evaluations and support detector readout co-design aimed at improving information extraction from particle interactions. In this work we describe a surrogate model for photon transport. We develop it starting from a modular, event-driven Monte Carlo model for the generation and transport of scintillation photons, and a reciprocal Monte Carlo construction (an adjoint model) of a spatially and temporally resolved optical response field. The latter evaluates the collectible light output and its temporal structure from a scintillator volume by launching weighted photon trajectories from the light-guide readout face. We apply this approach to a scintillator cell with two mirrored, curved, single-clad light guides. We employ the adjoint model to train a geometry-conditioned neural surrogate that predicts collection probabilities and conditional transport-time distributions across a constrained guide-design family. The surrogate is natively differentiable, lending itself to be an element of a differentiable pipeline for gradient-based optimization. A forward-reciprocal benchmark and validation on held-out geometries establish the accuracy of the trained model and identify its limitations. The developed tools provide a foundation for rapid optical-response studies and detector readout co-design.
items.abstract_zh: 优化闪烁体成像探测器的光导几何需要反复评估光子输运，直接蒙特卡罗模拟代价高昂。本文提出一种光子输运代理模型：从模块化、事件驱动的闪烁光子产生与输运蒙特卡罗模型出发，构建空间与时间分辨的光学响应场的互易（伴随）蒙特卡罗形式——从光导读出端面发射加权光子轨迹，以评估可收集光输出及其时间结构。作者以含两条镜像曲面单包层光导的闪烁体单元为例，用伴随模型训练几何条件神经网络代理，在受限设计族内预测收集概率与条件输运时间分布。该代理天然可微，可作为基于梯度的可微优化流程中的组件；前向-互易基准与留出几何验证确认了模型精度并指出其局限，为快速光学响应研究与探测器读出协同设计奠定基础。
items.highlight_zh: 用伴随蒙特卡罗训练可微代理，加速光导协同设计
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】闪烁体探测器（医学成像、粒子物理中常见）的工作流程是：粒子在闪烁体内沉积能量发光，光再经光导传到读出端。光导的几何形状直接决定能收集多少光、光到达的时间分布，因此要优化几何，就得反复做蒙特卡罗光子输运模拟——每次都很贵，而且传统模拟不可求导，无法做梯度优化。
【用了什么方法】作者先搭建模块化、事件驱动的蒙特卡罗模型，描述闪烁光子的产生与传播；再构造它的“互易／伴随”版本：不从闪烁点向外发射光子，而是从光导读出端面反向发射带权重的光子轨迹，一次计算即可得到整个闪烁体体积内的可收集光输出及其时间结构。借助这个高效的伴随模型，作者在一族受约束的光导几何上训练了一个“以几何为条件”的神经网络代理：输入几何，输出收集概率和条件输运时间分布，且天然可微。
【得到什么结果】在一个含两条镜像曲面、单包层光导的闪烁体单元上，通过前向模拟与伴随模拟的交叉对照（前向-互易基准），以及在未参与训练的留出几何上测试，验证了代理的预测精度，并明确指出了它失效的边界。
【为何重要】把昂贵的物理模拟换成快速、可求导的预测器，意味着光导几何与探测器读出电子学可以做端到端的梯度优化，而不必把两者分开设计——这正是“协同设计”的关键一步。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Contact Geometry for Generative Models: An Unbalanced Optimal Transport Formulation
items.title_zh: 面向生成模型的接触几何：一种非平衡最优传输表述
items.abstract_en: Real-world generative problems in biology, medical imaging, or robotics, rarely come with perfectly paired source and target distributions. While unbalanced Optimal Transport (uOT) provides a robust framework to bridge unpaired datasets via minimum-length paths in probability space, existing formulations based on the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) geometry introduce a structural bias toward high density regions, often triggering mode collapse. We introduce Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport (CuOT), a novel uOT formulation grounded in contact geometry that decouples density transport direction from mass growth to eliminate structural bias. This allows CuOT to adapt sampling steps to the local data structure, naturally reducing step sizes in high-density regions to prevent overshooting and ensuring stable convergence. The result is a stable, scalable path-length minimization solver that consistently outperforms WFR-based methods on biological dynamics reconstruction, unpaired image-to-image translation, and video generation.
items.abstract_zh: 真实世界的生成问题——如生物学、医学影像或机器人——很少具备完全配对的源分布与目标分布。非平衡最优传输（uOT）通过概率空间中的最短路径连接非配对数据集，提供了稳健框架，但现有基于 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao（WFR）几何的表述会引入偏向高密度区域的结构性偏置，常引发模式坍塌。我们提出接触非平衡最优传输（CuOT），一种基于接触几何的新型 uOT 表述，将密度传输方向与质量增长解耦以消除结构性偏置。这使 CuOT 能根据局部数据结构自适应调整采样步长，在高密度区域自然减小步长以避免过冲，并确保稳定收敛。最终得到一个稳定、可扩展的路径长度最小化求解器，在生物动力学重建、非配对图像到图像翻译与视频生成上持续优于基于 WFR 的方法。
items.highlight_zh: 以接触几何解耦密度传输与质量增长，消除结构性偏置
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】很多真实生成任务（生物动力学、医学影像、机器人）拿不到成对的源数据和目标数据。非平衡最优传输（uOT）能在这种“不配对”情形下找一条概率空间中代价最小的路径来连接两端数据，是常用工具。但现有基于 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao（WFR）几何的做法有一个结构性毛病：它天然偏向数据的高密度区域，导致模型反复只生成少数几种样本，即所谓的“模式坍塌”。

【用了什么方法】作者提出 CuOT（Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport），把整个变换拆成两件事分别处理：一是“密度往哪里搬”（传输方向），二是“总质量增加多少”（质量增长）。在接触几何的框架下把这两者解耦，就能去掉上述偏置。解耦还有个好处：采样步长可以跟着局部数据结构走——在高密度区域自动迈小步，避免一步跨过头，从而保证收敛稳定。

【得到什么结果】由此得到一个稳定且可扩展的求解器，专门最小化路径长度。在三个任务上——生物动力学重建、非配对图像到图像翻译、视频生成——它都稳定优于基于 WFR 的已有方法。

【为何重要】它给“不配对数据的生成建模”提供了一个更稳的几何基础：既能抑制模式坍塌，又能在密度不均的数据上稳住训练，还具备扩展到大场景的潜力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations
items.title_zh: 人们选择不说的话：对话中细粒度信息操纵的多模态基准
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in MLLMs have improved social understanding, enabling models to recognize emotions and distinguish truthful from deceptive behaviors. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on coarse-grained emotion recognition or binary truth-deception detection, overlooking the diverse ways people manipulate information in conversations, such as withholding, leakage, fabrication, evasion, and defensive counterclaim. Understanding these behaviors requires reasoning about underlying facts, participant knowledge, and conversational context, making them difficult to evaluate reliably. To address this gap, we introduce InfoCon, a multimodal benchmark for fine-grained information manipulation in conversations. InfoCon identifies six fine-grained strategies and derives a coarse consistency label from their factual and interactional relations. We develop an evidence-grounded multi-agent annotation framework to construct and verify reliable labels from rich contextual evidence. We benchmark representative multimodal models and systematically analyze their fine-grained information manipulation understanding, providing a testbed beyond binary truth-deception judgments.
items.abstract_zh: 近期多模态大模型（MLLM）的进展提升了社交理解能力，使其能识别情绪并区分真实与欺骗行为。然而，现有基准多聚焦于粗粒度情绪识别或二元的真假—欺骗检测，忽视了人们在对话中操纵信息的多样方式，如隐瞒、泄露、捏造、回避和防御性反诉。理解这些行为需要推理底层事实、参与者知识与对话语境，因此难以可靠评估。为此我们提出 InfoCon，一个面向对话中细粒度信息操纵的多模态基准。InfoCon 定义了六种细粒度策略，并依据其事实与互动关系推导出粗粒度的一致性标签。我们开发了基于证据的多智能体标注框架，从丰富的上下文证据中构建并校验可靠标签。我们对代表性多模态模型进行基准评测，系统分析其细粒度信息操纵理解能力，提供超越二元真假判断的测试平台。
items.highlight_zh: 提出 InfoCon 多模态基准，细粒度刻画六种对话信息操纵策略
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】大模型越来越会“看人脸色”——能识别情绪、也能分辨一个人是在说真话还是撒谎。但真实对话里，人对信息的处理远比“真/假”复杂：可能故意隐瞒、不小心泄露、凭空捏造、转移话题回避，甚至反过来指控对方（防御性反诉）。现有评测基准大多只测粗粒度情绪或二元真假判断，覆盖不到这些细微差别。而这类行为恰恰很难评，因为要判断它，必须同时理解底层事实、每个参与者知道什么、以及对话上下文。

【用了什么方法】作者构建了 InfoCon，一个多模态对话基准。它定义了六种细粒度信息操纵策略，并利用这些策略之间的事实关系和互动关系，推导出一个粗粒度的“一致性”标签。为了保证标注可靠，他们设计了基于证据的多智能体标注流程：让多个智能体依据丰富的上下文证据来生成标签并交叉验证。

【得到什么结果】作者用该基准评测了若干代表性多模态模型，系统分析了它们在细粒度信息操纵理解上的表现与短板。

【为何重要】它把评测从“是不是撒谎”推进到“用了哪种方式操纵信息”，为多模态模型的社交理解能力提供了一个更细致、更可诊断的测试平台。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading
items.title_zh: LeadVLA：面向机器人带路的学习型跟随者感知路径执行
items.abstract_en: Robot leading requires executing a route while continuously adapting to a designated follower. Existing robot-leading systems often mediate follower understanding and physical route execution through explicit states, planners, or modular interfaces; directly learning this coupling through end-to-end trajectory prediction can instead entangle route execution with follower response. We introduce LeadVLA, a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit Path reference while learning a Pace for route progress and a Residual for local follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation. To make this problem trainable and measurable, we develop LeadInfra, a configurable Unreal Engine-based closed-loop data-generation infrastructure from which we instantiate an approximately 4M-sample training corpus, and LeadBench, a standardized benchmark with 108 fully held-out closed-loop episodes. LeadVLA achieves the highest task success (39.6%) among evaluated robot policies on LeadBench while maintaining strong route fidelity and follower responsiveness, and transfers to unseen real-world environments without real-world policy fine-tuning. Project Page: https://louiszengCN.github.io/LeadVLA_PAGE/
items.abstract_zh: 机器人带路需要在执行路线的同时持续适应指定的跟随者。现有带路系统通常借助显式状态、规划器或模块化接口来衔接跟随者理解与物理路线执行；而直接用端到端轨迹预测学习这种耦合，反而会使路线执行与跟随者反应相互纠缠。我们提出 LeadVLA，一种结构化多模态策略：将路线保留为显式的 Path 参考，同时学习用于推进路线的 Pace 以及用于局部跟随者与场景条件适应的 Residual。为使问题可训练、可测量，我们构建了 LeadInfra——基于 Unreal Engine 的可配置闭环数据生成基础设施，并由此实例化约 400 万样本的训练语料；以及 LeadBench——包含 108 个完全留出的闭环 episode 的标准化基准。在 LeadBench 上，LeadVLA 取得所评估机器人策略中最高的任务成功率（39.6%），并保持较强的路线保真度与跟随者响应性，且无需真机策略微调即可迁移到未见过的真实环境。
items.highlight_zh: 显式路径+节奏+残差的结构化策略，实现跟随者感知的机器人带路
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】“机器人带路”指机器人走在前面引路，同时要一直照顾身后那位特定跟随者的状态。难点在于两件事必须同时做好：按计划走完路线，以及随时根据跟随者调整。现有系统要么靠显式状态机、规划器或模块化接口把“理解人”和“走路”硬接起来，要么干脆用端到端轨迹预测直接学——后者的问题是把“我该怎么走”和“对方会怎么反应”混成一团，难以解释也难以泛化。

【用了什么方法】作者提出 LeadVLA，一种结构化的多模态策略（VLA，视觉—语言—动作模型）。它把任务拆成三部分：Path 是一段显式的路线参考，保证不跑偏；Pace 学习沿路线推进的快慢；Residual 则是在局部根据跟随者和场景做微调。三者分工，既保住路线，又保留灵活应变。配套地，作者还建了 LeadInfra：基于 Unreal Engine 的可配置闭环数据生成平台，产出约 400 万条训练样本；以及 LeadBench：包含 108 个完全留出（held-out）闭环回合的标准化测试基准。

【得到什么结果】在 LeadBench 上，LeadVLA 的任务成功率为 39.6%，是被评估的机器人策略中最高的，同时路线保真度和对跟随者的响应性都不错。更关键的是，它无需在真实环境中做策略微调，就能迁移到没见过的真实场景。

【为何重要】它为机器人带路定义了可训练、可复现评测的问题框架，说明“结构化的显式路线 + 学习式适应”比端到端黑箱更有效。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks
items.title_zh: ThinkMorph-SSL：用前置任务扩展交错多模态推理
items.abstract_en: People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe improves over the base model by an average of 11.33 accuracy points across twelve benchmarks. These results show that supervision derived from images can build the visual skills needed for interleaved reasoning and improve learning from task-specific demonstrations.
items.abstract_zh: 人们不仅用语言、也用图像进行推理。交错多模态推理让模型能够通过生成中间图像并用其引导后续推理来解决问题。训练这种能力通常依赖任务特定的演示，而这类数据难以收集。我们提出 ThinkMorph-SSL，一种两阶段训练方案，利用图像本身作为监督来源。第一阶段为前置任务推理，将图像上色、去噪等视觉前置任务转化为无指令的交错推理轨迹：模型描述被损坏或变换的图像，生成复原或规范化的图像，并对结果进行解读。第二阶段使用自动构建的演示进行问题驱动的指令微调。在相同指令微调预算下，经过前置任务推理训练的模型优于仅做指令微调的模型。完整方案在十二个基准上平均比基座模型提升 11.33 个准确率点。这些结果表明，源自图像的监督能够构建交错推理所需的视觉技能，并改善从任务特定演示中的学习。
items.highlight_zh: 用图像自监督作前置任务，免人工演示训练交错多模态推理
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】人解几何题会在纸上画辅助线，用图帮助想问题。让模型也具备这种“边画边想”的能力，叫交错多模态推理：模型先生成中间图像，再用这张图引导下一步推理。问题是训练这种能力通常要给大量“标准思考示范”（先画什么、再说什么），这类数据人工收集代价很高。

【用了什么方法】作者提出 ThinkMorph-SSL，两阶段训练方案，核心思路是拿图像本身当监督信号。第一阶段叫“前置任务推理”：把图像上色、去噪这类经典的视觉自监督任务，改写成没有任何人工指令的交错推理轨迹——模型先描述一张被损坏或变换过的图，再生成复原后的（或规范化的）图像，最后解读自己产出的结果。这样“看图—画图—说图”的完整链条可以从数据里自动获得，无需人写示范。第二阶段则用自动构建的演示做问题驱动的指令微调，把第一阶段的视觉技能接到具体问答任务上。

【得到什么结果】在相同的指令微调预算下，先做前置任务推理的模型明显优于只做指令微调的模型。两阶段完整方案在十二个基准上平均比基座模型高 11.33 个准确率点。

【为何重要】它说明视觉技能可以从图像本身“自举”出来，而不必依赖昂贵的人工示范，为扩展交错多模态推理提供了一条低成本路径。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
items.title_zh: 从部分配对的小规模数据中学习多模态表示
items.abstract_en: Modeling multimodal data from partially paired samples is critical for advancing domains like biomedicine, where vast unimodal datasets and foundation models exist but paired data remains scarce. Existing fusion methods rely on large-scale paired datasets, limiting their use in scenarios with incomplete pairing. We introduce CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based modality fusion framework that integrates modalities from small, partially paired datasets. Combining any pre-trained unimodal encoder with a cross-modal latent alignment mechanism, CAMEO learns shared representations requiring only minimal paired samples. Evaluated on computational pathology tasks such as niche classification and cell type composition prediction, CAMEO achieves superior data efficiency, outperforming contrastive approaches like CLIP in low paired-data regimes, and highlighting the benefits of adversarial alignment when paired annotations are scarce. To facilitate further research, we additionally release a fully annotated HuggingFace dataset comprising three organs and paired image and gene expression modalities. By extending fusion methods to address limited pairing and small-scale datasets, we provide a framework that advances multimodal learning and broadens its applicability to real-world biomedical problems.
items.abstract_zh: 从部分配对的样本中建模多模态数据，对生物医学等领域至关重要：这些领域拥有海量单模态数据集与基础模型，但配对数据依然稀缺。现有融合方法依赖大规模配对数据集，在不完全配对的情形下难以适用。我们提出 CAMEO，一个基于对抗学习的模态融合框架，可从规模小、仅部分配对的数据集中整合模态。CAMEO 将任意预训练单模态编码器与跨模态潜在对齐机制结合，只需极少量配对样本即可学习共享表示。在计算病理学的生态位分类与细胞类型组成预测等任务上，CAMEO 展现出更优的数据效率，在配对数据稀少的条件下优于 CLIP 等对比方法，凸显了配对标注稀缺时对抗对齐的优势。为便于后续研究，我们还发布了一个覆盖三个器官、包含配对图像与基因表达模态的全标注 HuggingFace 数据集。
items.highlight_zh: 对抗对齐让少量配对样本即可融合多模态
items.digest_zh:
「研究了什么问题」：生物医学等领域有海量单一模态数据（比如大量病理切片、大量基因表达谱）以及相应的基础模型，但同一样本同时具备图像与基因表达的“配对数据”非常稀缺。现有的大部分多模态融合方法都假设有大规模配对数据，一旦配对不全、规模很小就不适用。
「用了什么方法」：作者提出 CAMEO，一个基于对抗学习的模态融合框架。它可以外挂任意已预训练的单模态编码器，再通过“跨模态潜在对齐”机制把不同模态映射到共享表示空间，关键在于对齐是用对抗的方式完成的，而不是像 CLIP 那样依赖大量正负样本对的对比学习。因此只需极少量配对样本就能学到可用的共享表示。
「有什么结果」：在计算病理学的生态位（niche）分类与细胞类型组成预测任务上，CAMEO 的数据效率明显更好，在配对数据很少时超过 CLIP 等对比方法，说明配对标注稀缺时对抗对齐更划算。作者还额外发布了一个 HuggingFace 数据集，覆盖三种器官、包含配对的图像与基因表达模态且带完整标注。
「为何重要」：真实世界的多模态数据往往“不齐不齐、小而不全”，CAMEO 把融合方法从“大数据 + 全配对”的理想条件推广到现实条件，降低了多模态学习的门槛，也让这类方法更容易在生物医学等实际问题中落地。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Packing the Bragg sphere: complete three-dimensional photonic band gaps at the refractive index of polymers (1.55)
items.title_zh: 填满布拉格球：在聚合物折射率（1.55）下实现完全三维光子带隙
items.abstract_en: Complete 3D photonic band gaps have so far been found only at refractive-index contrasts of about 1.9 and above, reached by rod-connected diamond lattice structures. Reciprocal-space design of quasiperiodic structures recently achieved considerable emission attenuation at much lower contrasts [L. Maiwald et al., Adv. Optical Mater. 10, 2100785 (2022)]. Here we implement systematic search and reciprocal-space design of periodic 3D structures with complete band gaps, solving a discrete optimization problem on an integer lattice. A gap above a high band needs the strongest Fourier components of the dielectric close to the Bragg sphere of that band. Crystals with large cells, started from Fourier peaks at the vertices of a polyhedron on this sphere and optimized against densely refined band edges, open complete gaps down to an index contrast of 1.55, that of common polymers against air. A rational approximant of an icosidodecahedron gave the most efficient location of the Fourier peaks among the polyhedra tested. Numerical calculations confirm the gaps over a resolution series, with band edges searched over the whole Brillouin zone. The best designs are connected porous networks, suited to a microwave test with printed polymer. A rigorous bound, valid for any structure, does not exclude gaps at lower index, and the next rational approximants of the icosidodecahedron, whose Bragg zones match bands 576 and 2440 almost exactly, point to where gaps at even lower contrast may be sought.
items.abstract_zh: 迄今完全三维光子带隙只在折射率对比度约1.9以上的棒连接金刚石晶格结构中被发现。近年基于倒空间设计的准周期结构在低得多的对比度下已实现显著的辐射衰减。本文通过在整数格点上求解离散优化问题，对具有完全带隙的周期性三维结构开展系统搜索与倒空间设计。高能带之上的带隙要求介电函数最强的傅里叶分量靠近该能带的布拉格球。从该球面上多面体顶点处的傅里叶峰出发构造大晶胞晶体，并针对密集细化的带边进行优化，可将完全带隙的折射率对比度下限降至1.55，即常见聚合物与空气的对比度。在测试的多面体中，截角二十面体（icosidodecahedron）的有理逼近给出了最有效的傅里叶峰布局。数值计算在一系列分辨率下确认了带隙，且带边在整个布里渊区内搜索。最佳设计为连通多孔网络，适合用打印聚合物做微波验证。一个适用于任意结构的严格界并不排除更低折射率下的带隙，而截角二十面体的后续有理逼近（其布拉格区几乎精确匹配第576与2440能带）指明了寻找更低对比度带隙的方向。
items.highlight_zh: 倒空间优化把完全三维光子带隙的折射率门槛降到1.55
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】三维光子晶体要想拥有「完全带隙」——即某个频率范围内的光在任何方向都无法传播——通常需要构成材料之间折射率差别足够大。此前只有棒连接金刚石结构在折射率对比度约1.9以上才做到。而常见聚合物与空气的对比度只有约1.55，如果能在这个水平上做出完全带隙，就可以用廉价、易加工的聚合物来制备三维光子器件。

【用了什么方法】作者把「设计晶体结构」变成一个可计算的数学问题：在整数格点上做离散优化。核心直觉是，若想让某条高能带之上出现带隙，介电常数（即折射率分布）最强的那些傅里叶分量必须靠近这条能带对应的「布拉格球」。他们从这个球面上某个多面体的顶点出发放置傅里叶峰，构造大晶胞的周期结构，再对密集细化的带边反复优化；整个布里渊区都被搜索，并通过一系列数值分辨率验证结果不是计算假象。

【有什么结果】带隙的折射率对比度下限被压到1.55，正好是聚合物对空气的水平。在试过的多种多面体中，截角二十面体（icosidodecahedron）的有理逼近效率最高。最佳结构是连通的多孔网络，可以用打印聚合物做成样品在微波波段实测。此外作者给出一个适用于任意结构的严格数学界，它并不排除更低折射率下存在带隙；截角二十面体的下一批有理逼近的布拉格区几乎精确对准第576与2440能带，提示了继续下探对比度的搜索方向。

【为何重要】这意味着光子晶体不再必须依赖高折射率半导体材料；用聚合物甚至可打印结构就可能获得完全带隙，为可见光/近红外波段的三维光子器件、低成本微波验证与自下而上的制备路线打开了空间。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: InducedTFMs: A Family of Sub-Quadratic Tabular Foundation Models Using Induced Attention
items.title_zh: InducedTFM：基于诱导注意力的次二次复杂度表格基础模型族
items.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a serious competitor to gradient-boosted trees, predicting on a new table in a single forward pass by in-context learning. However, their attention is quadratic in the number of samples and features, which caps pretraining at small synthetic tables and forces inference on large ones to rely on chunking or subsampling. Row-compression models reduce the feature-wise cost, but only by discarding the cell-level representation, and remain quadratic in the number of samples. We introduce InducedTFM, which replaces both attention stages of a bidimensional TFM with the induced attention of the Set Transformer, preserving cell-level representations while making its cost linear in both samples and features. Under a training budget matched to a full-attention TabICLv2 reimplementation, InducedTFM matches its accuracy on TabArena and on a benchmark of larger datasets, and clearly outperforms a kernel linear-attention baseline of the same asymptotic cost. It overtakes TabICLv2 in inference time on narrow tables, reaching a 30x speed-up at 640K rows, although row compression remains preferable on wide tables.
items.abstract_zh: 表格基础模型（TFM）已成为梯度提升树的有力竞争者，它通过上下文学习在单次前向传播中预测新表格。然而其注意力对样本数与特征数均为二次复杂度，这使预训练只能局限于小型合成表格，对大型表格的推理不得不依赖分块或下采样。行压缩类模型降低了特征维度的开销，但代价是丢弃单元格级表示，且在样本数上仍是二次的。我们提出 InducedTFM，用 Set Transformer 的诱导注意力替换二维 TFM 的两个注意力阶段，在保留单元格级表示的同时使计算代价对样本与特征均为线性。在与全注意力 TabICLv2 复现版匹配的训练预算下，InducedTFM 在 TabArena 及一个更大型数据集基准上达到与之相当的精度，并明显优于同等渐近代价的核线性注意力基线。在窄表上其推理时间超过 TabICLv2，在 64 万行时实现 30 倍加速；不过在宽表上行压缩方法仍更可取。
items.highlight_zh: 用诱导注意力把表格基础模型代价降到对样本和特征都线性
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】表格数据（如 Excel 表、数据库记录）的机器学习长期由梯度提升树主导。近年出现的「表格基础模型」（TFM）可以在不做任何训练的情况下，把一张新表连同其标注一起放进模型，一次前向传播就给出预测，效果已可与梯度提升树抗衡。但这类模型内部用的是 Transformer 式注意力，计算量随样本数和特征数的平方增长：预训练时只能用很小的合成表，遇到大表只能分块或抽样，既慢又损失信息。已有的「行压缩」方案能减轻特征维度的负担，但丢掉了每个单元格的精细表示，而且在样本数上仍然是平方复杂度。

【用了什么方法】作者提出 InducedTFM，借鉴 Set Transformer 中的「诱导注意力」（induced attention）：用少量可学习的诱导点去汇总信息，从而把原本两阶段的注意力（先跨样本、再跨特征，或反之）都换成线性代价的版本。关键之处是它不像行压缩那样把一整行压成一个向量，而是保留单元格级别的表示，只是改变注意力的计算方式。

【有什么结果】在与全注意力版本 TabICLv2 复现模型相当的训练预算下，InducedTFM 在 TabArena 基准和一组更大的数据集上精度持平，并明显好于同样线性代价的核线性注意力基线。推理速度上，在窄表（特征少、行数多）中它反超 TabICLv2，64 万行时快 30 倍。作者也诚实指出局限：在宽表（特征很多）上，行压缩方法依然更划算。

【为何重要】这为表格基础模型走向真实规模的数据提供了可行的效率路径——既保住单元格级信息，又把训练和推理代价压到线性，使在大表上的直接部署成为可能。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
items.title_zh: 光学上下文压缩何时才划算？推理型 VLM 的解码感知成本分析
items.abstract_en: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.
items.abstract_zh: 把长文本渲染成图像，可让视觉语言模型（VLM）以更少的输入 token 读取文档，但以往评测往往主要统计这些 prefill token；本文指出，对推理模型而言，这种核算并不完整。在 5 个模型、2 个长上下文基准上，图像输入会使模型“想得更久”：4 个通用 VLM 的解码长度增长 1.5–3.5 倍；在典型输出定价下，这种“解码税”使 2 个模型在 QuALITY 上图像反而比文本更贵。中等压缩率下的信息损失不足以解释该现象（OCR 可恢复 98.7% 的词）。压缩是否划算可归结为汇率 (1-1/c)/(r-1) 是否超过工作负载的输出/输入价格加权比，这解释了 Kimi-K3 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 能获益而 Qwen 与 GLM 不能。据此提出的图像优先启发式策略可降低 6–14% 费用，准确率仅损失 0.3–1.2 点。
items.highlight_zh: 图像输入存在“解码税”，是否省钱要按价格汇率判断
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：把长文档渲染成图片喂给 VLM 以节省输入 token，是常见做法，但评测通常只关注 prefill token 变少，忽略了推理模型面对图像时可能“想得更久”，从而带来额外的输出（decode）开销。
2) 方法：在 5 个模型、2 个长上下文基准上对比文本与图像两种输入的 prefill 长度、解码长度与真实成本；用 OCR 结果以及“把模型自己的转写当作文本喂回”来区分“信息丢失”与“解码税”；再做成本核算分解，推导判断压缩是否划算的判据。
3) 结果：4 个通用 VLM 的图像输入使解码长度增至 1.5–3.5 倍；在典型输出定价下，5 个模型中有 2 个在 QuALITY 上图像输入反而更贵。信息损失并非主因：Qwen 的 OCR 可还原 98.7% 的单词，Kimi-K3 读取自身转写文本后推理长度与准确率均恢复。关键在于汇率 (1-1/c)/(r-1) 是否超过工作负载中输出与输入 token 的价格加权比，这解释了 Kimi-K3、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 获益而 Qwen、GLM 不获益。生成前，作者测试的所有免训练信号都无法预测这笔“解码税”。
4) 实用策略与意义：图像优先策略（压缩比≥1.6 才转图像，一旦图像模式的推理成本超过省下的 prefill 就回退文本）可省 6–14% 费用，准确率仅降 0.3–1.2 点；在 QuALITY 上，两条路径都设推理预算更有效。其意义在于提醒成本核算必须把“想得更久”计入，并给出可直接套用的判断公式。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接的 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。基于高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波，FAST-LIO2 有两项关键创新，使其实现快速、鲁棒且精确的 LiDAR 导航与建图。第一是直接将原始点配准到地图（并随之更新地图，即建图），无需提取特征。这使其能利用环境中的细微特征从而提高精度；取消人工设计的特征提取模块也让它天然适配不同扫描模式的新型 LiDAR。第二项创新是用增量式 k-d 树数据结构 ikd-Tree 维护地图，支持增量更新（点的插入、删除）与动态重平衡。与现有动态数据结构（八叉树、R*-树、nanoflann k-d 树）相比，ikd-Tree 总体性能更优，并天然支持在树上进行降采样。作者在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 条序列上做了详尽基准对比，FAST-LIO2 以低得多的计算量稳定取得更高精度。还针对小视场固态 LiDAR 开展了多项真实实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2 计算高效（大型室外场景中里程计与建图可达 100 Hz）、鲁棒（在杂乱室内环境、高达 1000 deg/s 旋转下仍可靠估计位姿）、通用（适用于多线旋转与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器），且精度高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 直接配准原始点加增量 k-d 树，实现百赫兹 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】LiDAR-惯性里程计要让机器人在运动中实时估计自身位姿并同时建图。传统做法分两步：先从每帧激光点云中提取边缘、平面等「特征」，再把特征与地图匹配。这一步既依赖人工设计的规则，在结构稀疏或特征不明显的地方容易失效，也拖慢了整个流程；此外，不同扫描方式的 LiDAR（如多线旋转式与固态式）往往需要各自定制特征提取。地图维护本身也是瓶颈——每次插入新点都要重建或更新数据结构。

【用了什么方法】FAST-LIO2 有两个核心改动。其一，跳过特征提取，把原始点云直接配准到地图上，并在配准后直接用这些点更新地图。好处是环境里细微的几何结构也能被利用，精度更高，而且不依赖特定扫描模式，换一种 LiDAR 也能直接用。其二，用一个自研的增量式 k-d 树（ikd-Tree）来管理地图，支持点的增量插入与删除，并能动态重新平衡，避免每次更新都大动干戈；它还能顺带在树上完成降采样。整个系统基于紧耦合的迭代卡尔曼滤波，把 LiDAR 与 IMU 数据融合在一起。

【有什么结果】作者在多个公开数据集的 19 条序列上做了详尽对比，FAST-LIO2 的精度一致更高，而计算负担却低得多。在大型室外场景中里程计与建图可达 100 Hz；在杂乱的室内环境、角速度高达 1000 deg/s 的剧烈旋转下仍能可靠估计位姿。系统还专门在视场很小的固态 LiDAR 上做了真实实验，并在无人机、手持平台以及 Intel 与 ARM 处理器上都跑得通。

【为何重要】它把「特征工程」这一手工环节从 LiDAR 里程计中移除，同时解决了地图增量维护的效率问题，使高频率、跨平台、跨传感器的实时导航成为可能，对机器人、自动驾驶与无人机都有直接的工程价值。

items.title_en: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
items.title_zh: ViDiHand2：融合视频扩散先验与手部几何，实现野外场景中的三维手部运动重建
items.abstract_en: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The code is available at https://github.com/NTUYWANG103/ViDiHand.
items.abstract_zh: 从第一视角人类视频中学习机器人操作，需要精确的度量级三维手部运动。现有方法利用预训练视频扩散模型（VDM）先验，直接从全帧视频恢复被遮挡的手，但这类基于外观的深度回归在面对未见相机时泛化能力很差。本文提出 ViDiHand2——一个几何驱动的框架，把基于 VDM 的手部深度估计由直接回归改写为细粒度几何约束求解。具体而言，作者提出细粒度几何提升与片段级射线拟合，通过强制像素对齐的二维关节与 MANO 手部度量结构之间的几何一致性，并结合整段片段的时序观测来恢复度量深度。由于提升过程依赖二维关节，为提升遮挡与图像截断下的鲁棒性，作者进一步设计置信度门控融合，按定位置信度自适应地组合几何提升关节与 MANO 预测。此外还增强了 VDM 主干以更好地捕捉时空表征。在 7 个公开数据集上的实验表明，ViDiHand2 一致优于 18 个基线，野外绝对关节误差降低 42%，检测失败减少 8.82 倍，运行速度 57 FPS。
items.highlight_zh: 把深度回归改为几何约束求解，野外关节误差降 42%
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：要让机器人通过观看人类第一视角视频来学习操作，前提是知道手在三维空间中的真实尺度和位置。现有做法借助预训练视频扩散模型，从画面“猜”出被遮挡的手的深度，但这种依赖外观的回归一旦换成没见过的相机就失效，误差很大。
2）用了什么方法：ViDiHand2 换了一条思路——不直接回归深度，而是把问题转化为几何求解。首先增强 VDM 主干，让它输出每帧的二维手部关节和 MANO 手模型的预测；然后让二维关节与 MANO 提供的度量结构保持几何一致，把关节“提升”为三维；再利用整段视频的时序信息做片段级射线拟合，得到稳定的度量深度。挡手或手出画时二维关节不可靠，于是用置信度门控融合，根据定位置信度在几何提升结果与 MANO 预测之间自适应加权。
3）有什么结果：在 7 个公开数据集、18 个基线的对比中全面领先：野外场景的绝对关节误差比各指标最优基线降低 42%，检测失败率降低 8.82 倍，同时保持 57 FPS 的运行速度。
4）为何重要：这项工作说明“几何约束”比“外观回归”更能抵抗相机变化与遮挡，为从人类视频中大规模获取可用的度量级手部运动数据提供了实用方案，对机器人模仿学习具有直接价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: Bayesian Learning of Spatially Heterogeneous Causal Structure in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 空间转录组学中空间异质因果结构的贝叶斯学习
items.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics preserves the location of each expression profile, making it possible to study how gene regulatory networks differ within a tissue. Across regions of a tissue, regulatory relationships may vary and even reverse direction, so identifying the causal relationships in a specific pathological region can provide insight into therapeutic targets. We propose SpaDAG, a Bayesian method for learning spatially varying causal directed acyclic graphs. By defining the graphs on a triangulation of the tissue, SpaDAG allows each edge to have its own spatial pattern and even to reverse direction across regions. We show that the graphs nonetheless remain fully identifiable, and develop an MCMC sampler that explores them efficiently by reversing an edge over an entire connected region in a single move. SpaDAG outperforms competing methods in simulations with and without direction reversals. In a section spanning a renal cell carcinoma and the adjacent kidney, SpaDAG finds largely different relationships in the two tissues, with those in the tumor concentrated on genes associated with therapeutic targets. Between two of these genes, it identifies a relationship whose direction reverses across the tumor boundary, generating hypotheses about their region-specific coupling. Supplementary materials and code for this article are available online.
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学保留了每个表达谱的位置，使得研究基因调控网络在组织内如何不同成为可能。在组织的不同区域，调控关系可能变化甚至方向反转，因此识别特定病理区域中的因果 relationships 可为治疗靶点提供见解。我们提出 SpaDAG，一种用于学习空间变化的因果有向无环图的贝叶斯方法。通过在组织的三角剖分上定义这些图，SpaDAG 允许每条边具有自己的空间模式，甚至在不同区域间反转方向。我们证明这些图仍然完全可识别，并开发了一种 MCMC 采样器，通过单次移动在整个连通区域上反转一条边来高效探索它们。在有方向反转和无方向反转的模拟中，SpaDAG 均优于竞争方法。在跨越肾细胞癌及邻近肾脏的一个切片中，SpaDAG 发现两种组织中的关系 largely 不同，其中肿瘤中的关系集中在与治疗靶点相关的基因上。在其中两个基因之间，它识别出一种方向在肿瘤边界两侧反转的关系，从而生成关于其区域特异性耦合的假设。本文的补充材料和代码可在线获取。

items.title_en: Dynamic tuning of anisotropy-induced quasi-bound-states-in-the-continuum in liquid-crystal integrated dielectric metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 液晶集成介质超表面中各向异性诱导连续域准束缚态的动态调谐
items.abstract_en: Symmetry-protected quasi-bound states in the continuum (qBICs) in all-dielectric metasurfaces can be excited either by introducing a geometrical asymmetry into the unit cell or by illuminating the metasurface under oblique incidence. To date, tuning the coupling strength of such qBICs to the continuum has mainly relied on control of the geometrical asymmetry. Here, we show that qBICs can also be induced in a symmetric dielectric metasurface by embedding the latter into an anisotropic birefringent medium, and that they can be actively tuned by either rotating the anisotropy axis of the medium or by varying the degree of anisotropy. We experimentally implement a corresponding system by embedding a highly symmetric silicon nanocylinder metasurface into a nematic liquid crystal (LC) cell. Importantly, the LC does not only provide the desired birefringence, but also dynamic control of its strength as well as of the orientation of its anisotropy axis in response to different external stimuli. Specifically, applying voltage across the LC cell, where the LC molecules are pre-aligned along one of the lattice directions of the metasurface, enables out-of-plane rotation of the anisotropy axis of the LC medium. Meanwhile, its birefringence can be tuned by changing the temperature. In our experiments, the coupling of the qBICs to the radiation continuum is first maximized by the application of 25 V across the LC cell at room temperature. We then systematically tune the temperature and show that the resonance depth of the qBIC modes, which is associated with their coupling strength to the continuum, of the qBIC modes increases monotonously with birefringence. Our findings establish anisotropy-induced qBICs in LC integrated dielectric metasurfaces as a promising platform for actively reconfigurable metasurfaces and their applications in displays, optical modulation and tunable photonic devices.
items.abstract_zh: 全介质超表面中的对称保护连续域准束缚态（qBIC）可通过在单元胞中引入几何不对称或在斜入射下照射超表面来激发。迄今为止，此类 qBIC 与连续域耦合强度的调谐主要依赖对几何不对称的控制。本文表明，通过将对称介质超表面嵌入各向异性双折射介质，也可在其中诱导 qBIC，并且可通过旋转介质各向异性轴或改变各向异性程度来主动调谐。我们通过将高度对称的硅纳米圆柱超表面嵌入向列相液晶（LC）盒中，实验实现了相应系统。重要的是，LC 不仅提供所需双折射，还可响应不同外部刺激动态控制其强度以及各向异性轴的取向。具体而言，在 LC 分子沿超表面一个晶格方向预对齐的情况下，对 LC 盒施加电压可实现 LC 介质各向异性轴的面外旋转。同时，其双折射可通过改变温度来调谐。在我们的实验中，首先通过在室温下对 LC 盒施加 25 V 电压，使 qBIC 与辐射连续域的耦合最大化。随后我们系统调谐温度，并表明 qBIC 模式的共振深度（与其到连续域的耦合强度相关）随双折射单调增加。我们的发现确立了液晶集成介质超表面中各向异性诱导 qBIC 作为主动可重构超表面及其在显示器、光调制和可调谐光子器件中应用的有前景平台。

items.title_en: See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight
items.title_zh: 看见答案，学会嵌入：从后见之明学习通用多模态嵌入
items.abstract_en: Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) models map heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space, where pairwise similarity supports diverse downstream tasks. Recent reasoning-driven UME approaches use intermediate reasoning to generate additional context for embedding, but often incur extra computation at inference. In this paper, we explore the matched candidate (i.e., the paired target) as an alternative source of context, asking whether a model can "see the answer" during training and "learn to embed" without it at inference. However, direct conditioning on this privileged context can introduce candidate-specific information unavailable from the query alone or cause the candidate-conditioned query representation to collapse toward the candidate embedding. To address this, we introduce Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings (HEME), which learns query-grounded hindsight representations from such candidate context. HEME first trains a hindsight teacher with a hindsight attention mask, mismatched-candidate conditioning, and query-token alignment to limit excessive reliance on the candidate. It then freezes the teacher and distills its hindsight representation and similarity distribution into a standalone student embedder. At inference, the student independently encodes queries and candidates without candidate conditioning or the hindsight teacher. Experiments on MMEB-V2 and the agent and text tasks of MMEB-V3 demonstrate the effectiveness of HEME and show that it enables more efficient inference than explicit reasoning-driven methods.
items.abstract_zh: 通用多模态嵌入（UME）模型将异构多模态输入映射到共享嵌入空间，其中成对相似度支持多种下游任务。近期推理驱动的 UME 方法使用中间推理为嵌入生成额外上下文，但通常在推理时产生额外计算。本文探索匹配候选（即配对目标）作为上下文的替代来源，询问模型能否在训练时“看见答案”，并在推理时无需答案“学会嵌入”。然而，直接以这一特权上下文为条件可能引入仅凭查询无法获得的候选特定信息，或导致以候选为条件的查询表示向候选嵌入坍缩。为解决此问题，我们提出后见增强多模态嵌入（HEME），从这种候选上下文中学习以查询为基础的后见表示。HEME 首先使用后见注意力掩码、不匹配候选条件化和查询词元对齐来训练后见教师，以限制对候选的过度依赖。然后冻结教师，将其后见表示和相似度分布蒸馏到独立的学生嵌入器。推理时，学生独立编码查询和候选，无需候选条件化或后见教师。在 MMEB-V2 以及 MMEB-V3 的智能体和文本任务上的实验证明了 HEME 的有效性，并表明它比显式推理驱动方法实现更高效的推理。

items.title_en: Tool-to-Self: Internalizing Visual Tool Capabilities via Scaffolded Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Tool-to-Self：通过脚手架式强化学习内化视觉工具能力
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on external visual tools to access fine-grained visual evidence, but repeated tool execution incurs substantial inference overhead and deployment dependencies. Moreover, conventional tool-use RL can improve visual-task performance, yet the resulting tool gains are often unstable. Motivated by this, we propose Tool-to-Self (T2S), a tool-scaffolded reinforcement learning framework that turns external visual tools into temporary training scaffolds. T2S cold-starts tool-use ability and observation prediction from tool-repairable examples, then progressively anneals tool execution on a per-tool basis during RL. By combining answer-correctness and observation-consistency rewards with privileged on-policy self-distillation from actual tool observations, T2S effectively teaches the model both to reproduce tool outputs and to reason from them. Experiments across diverse visual perception and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over both explicit tool-use models and implicit zooming models while enabling tool-free inference with reduced latency.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）越来越依赖外部视觉工具来获取细粒度视觉证据，但重复执行工具会带来显著的推理开销和部署依赖。此外，传统的工具使用强化学习可以提升视觉任务性能，但由此获得的工具收益往往不稳定。受此启发，我们提出 Tool-to-Self（T2S），一个工具脚手架式强化学习框架，将外部视觉工具转变为临时训练脚手架。T2S 从可由工具修复的示例中冷启动工具使用能力和观测预测，然后在强化学习过程中按工具逐个逐步退火工具执行。通过将答案正确性和观测一致性奖励与来自实际工具观测的特权同策略自蒸馏相结合，T2S 有效地教会模型既复现工具输出，又基于其进行推理。在多种视觉感知与推理基准上的实验表明，相较于显式工具使用模型和隐式缩放模型，T2S 均取得一致提升，同时实现无工具推理并降低延迟。

items.title_en: ReFocus: Progress-Guided Adaptive Practice for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: ReFocus：面向长时程机器人操作强化学习的进度引导自适应练习
items.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables vision-language-action policies to improve through environmental interaction. However, in long-horizon manipulation, sparse success/failure feedback provides little information about where policies encounter bottlenecks. Moreover, repeated full-task rollouts also leave these bottlenecks weakly analyzed and insufficiently practiced. To this end, we introduce ReFocus, a progress-guided multi-round RL framework that alternates between Global and Local RL to identify task-specific bottlenecks and allocate additional practice to them. Specifically, during Global RL, we decompose each task into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of subtasks. Then a DAG-based Progress Reward is leveraged for both policy training and bottleneck diagnosis. Based on the identified bottlenecks, ReFocus selects Adaptive Practice Windows, defining task segments from an entry stage to a target stage. It allocates additional interaction to these segments during Local RL while updating the entire policy. After that, it evaluates the policy to perform the full task for the next round of RL, forming an iteration between Global and Local RL. Experiments on LIBERO-Long and RoboCasa365 show that ReFocus achieves success rates of 97.8% and 51.3%, respectively, compared with 90.6% and 39.3% for the $π_{0.5}$ baseline. Furthermore, we evaluate a real-world adaptation on three long-horizon tasks. On BreadBaker, ReFocus achieves 95% success, compared with 30% for the $π_{0.5}$. Project page: https://refocus-robotics.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 在线强化学习（RL）使视觉-语言-动作策略能够通过环境交互得到改进。然而，在长时程操作中，稀疏的成功/失败反馈几乎不能提供策略在何处遇到瓶颈的信息。此外，重复的完整任务 rollout 也使得这些瓶颈分析不足且练习不充分。为此，我们提出 ReFocus，一种进度引导的多轮 RL 框架，在全局与局部 RL 之间交替，以识别任务特定瓶颈并为这些瓶颈分配额外练习。具体而言，在全局 RL 期间，我们将每个任务分解为子任务的有向无环图（DAG）。然后，基于 DAG 的进度奖励同时用于策略训练和瓶颈诊断。基于识别出的瓶颈，ReFocus 选择自适应练习窗口，定义从进入阶段到目标阶段的任务片段。它在局部 RL 期间为这些片段分配额外交互，同时更新整个策略。之后，它评估策略执行完整任务，用于下一轮 RL，形成全局与局部 RL 之间的迭代。在 LIBERO-Long 和 RoboCasa365 上的实验表明，ReFocus 分别达到 97.8% 和 51.3% 的成功率，而 π_{0.5} 基线为 90.6% 和 39.3%。此外，我们在三个长时程任务上评估了真实世界适配。在 BreadBaker 上，ReFocus 达到 95% 的成功率，而 π_{0.5} 为 30%。项目页面：https://refocus-robotics.github.io。

items.title_en: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
items.title_zh: 让视觉语言模型通过其表征生成图像
items.abstract_en: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.
items.abstract_zh: 近期的统一多模态模型旨在将视觉理解与生成结合到单一模型中，但有效整合这两种能力仍具挑战性。利用预训练视觉语言模型为基于已学习到的多模态知识提供了途径，但使这些知识可被视觉生成有效利用仍然并非易事。我们发现，核心挑战在于理解与生成所使用的异构视觉表征。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Integral，它通过在这两种能力之间构建共享视觉表征空间，将预训练视觉语言模型转换为统一多模态模型。Integral 通过两个互补组件实现该设计。Abstraction Fusion 通过聚合来自冻结视觉编码器的分层表征来构建共享视觉 token，而 Block-wise MoT 引入轻量生成流，仅在块边界处与视觉语言模型交互。我们的方法有效保留了预训练的理解能力，同时将其扩展到强视觉生成。受控比较进一步表明，尽管重建保真度相当，与使用独立视觉表征空间相比，在理解与生成之间共享视觉表征显著改善了生成学习。这些结果表明，预训练视觉语言模型学习到的表征已为视觉生成提供了有效基础。

items.title_en: Cell and nuclear shapes predict confined motility
items.title_zh: 细胞与细胞核形状预测受限迁移
items.abstract_en: Cancer metastasis relies on an enhanced property of cells to migrate efficiently even through constrictions smaller than their nucleus. Both cell and nuclear morphology may influence this process. How these morphologies relate to the likelihood that a cell will transit through a constriction remains unclear. Here we combine microfluidic experiments with machine learning to predict whether MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells are able to transit through narrow constrictions. Cells migrate within vertically confined boxes, and may migrate into neighboring boxes by transiting through constrictions, requiring a deformation of the nucleus. Defining a set of 12 geometrical features derived from cell and nuclear contours, we find that their average values are not statistically indicative of whether or not a cell will transit. To overcome this limitation, we use trajectories to train classifiers and evaluate their ability to predict future transit events. We find that the cell area and cell circularity carry most of the predictive information and less circular cells are more likely to transit. Without retraining, the models also predict transit through narrower constrictions and in more adhesive substrates. Morphological features of cells about 30 minutes before a transit event proved most informative about future transit events occurring or not. Together, our results show that cell shape, readable from simple contour descriptors, contains a transferable but condition-dependent signature of imminent transit.
items.abstract_zh: 癌症转移依赖于细胞增强的特性，即使通过小于其细胞核的收缩处也能高效迁移。细胞和细胞核形态均可能影响这一过程。这些形态与细胞穿越收缩处可能性之间的关系仍不清楚。在此，我们将微流控实验与机器学习相结合，预测 MDA-MB-231 乳腺癌细胞能否穿越狭窄收缩处。细胞在垂直受限的盒子内迁移，并可能通过穿越收缩处迁移到相邻盒子，这需要细胞核发生形变。定义一组由细胞和细胞核轮廓导出的 12 个几何特征后，我们发现其平均值在统计上并不能指示细胞是否会穿越。为克服这一限制，我们使用轨迹训练分类器，并评估其预测未来穿越事件的能力。我们发现细胞面积和细胞圆度携带了大部分预测信息，且较不圆（圆度较低）的细胞更可能穿越。无需重新训练，模型也能预测穿越更窄收缩处以及在更具黏附性的基底上的穿越。穿越事件前约 30 分钟的细胞形态特征对未来是否发生穿越事件最具信息量。综上，我们的结果表明，可从简单轮廓描述符读取的细胞形状包含即将发生穿越的可迁移但依赖条件的特征。

items.title_en: Tweezing microparticles by tightly focused optical skyrmionic fields
items.title_zh: 利用紧聚焦光学斯格明子场镊取微粒
items.abstract_en: The concept of skyrmions, once translated to the optical domain, provides a topological framework to investigate structured light-matter interactions. However, their practical use for the manipulation of material systems remains barely explored. Here, we experimentally demonstrate trapping and tunable orbital motion of dielectric microparticles in tightly focused skyrmionic polarization textures prepared using a compact spin-orbit optical element. We explore the tweezing capabilities at fixed topology either by varying the relative weights of the orthogonally polarized components or by switching between skyrmion and bimeron polarization textures. Vectorial focusing and optical-force calculations qualitatively reproduce the experimental observations. These results motivate extending skyrmionic light to the manipulation of micro-objects, including birefringent and chiral samples.
items.abstract_zh: 斯格明子概念一旦转换到光学领域，就为研究结构光与物质相互作用提供了拓扑框架。然而，其在操控材料系统方面的实际应用仍鲜有探索。在此，我们实验演示了在利用紧凑型自旋-轨道光学元件制备的紧聚焦斯格明子偏振纹理中，对介电微粒的捕获和可调谐轨道运动。我们通过改变正交偏振分量的相对权重，或在斯格明子与双半子（bimeron）偏振纹理之间切换，探索固定拓扑下的光镊能力。矢量聚焦和光力计算定性再现了实验观测。这些结果推动将斯格明子光扩展到微观物体操控，包括双折射与手性样品。

items.title_en: Towards Global Counterfactual-Based Self-Explainable Graph Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 迈向全局反事实的自解释图神经网络
items.abstract_en: Graph Counterfactual Explanations (GCEs) have emerged as an effective approach for interpreting Graph Neural Network (GNN) predictions by identifying minimal graph modifications needed to change predictions. However, existing methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) They rely on a post-hoc explanation paradigm, where a separate explainer is trained after the GNN. This sequential optimization prevents the explainer from leveraging how the GNN learned its representations, often resulting in lower-quality explanations. (2) They are largely local, generating counterfactual explanations only for individual samples. Consequently, they fail to capture generalizable patterns across the data distribution, a crucial gap for applications like drug discovery, where global principles enable systematic decision-making across thousands of cases. To address these limitations, we propose GCSGNN (Global Counterfactual-based Self-explainable GNN), a unified framework that integrates counterfactual generation into the GNN architecture, encouraging explanations that faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. Beyond local explanations, GCSGNN discovers shared latent patterns influencing predictions across graphs, yielding global (i.e., model-level) counterfactual explanations. We further introduce an efficient latent-space counterfactual mechanism that avoids the combinatorial complexity of discrete graph manipulation, enabling scalable discovery of generalizable modification patterns. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GCSGNN outperforms existing methods in generating effective counterfactual explanations. Our code is available at https://github.com/wendyzheng22/gcsgnn.
items.abstract_zh: 图反事实解释（GCEs）通过寻找改变预测所需的最小图修改来解释 GNN 的预测，但现有方法存在两个根本局限：（1）依赖事后解释范式，即在 GNN 训练完成后单独训练解释器，这种顺序优化使解释器无法利用 GNN 学习表示的过程，解释质量往往偏低；（2）大多为局部解释，只针对单个样本生成反事实，无法捕捉跨数据分布的通用模式——而这对药物发现等需要从数以千计案例中总结全局规律的应用至关重要。为此作者提出 GCSGNN，一个将反事实生成整合进 GNN 架构的统一框架，使解释忠实反映模型的决策过程；同时挖掘跨图共享的潜在模式，给出模型级（全局）反事实解释。作者还设计了高效的隐空间反事实机制，避开离散图操作的组合复杂度，使可泛化修改模式的发现具备可扩展性。在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，GCSGNN 生成的反事实解释优于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 把反事实生成融入 GNN，兼顾局部与全局自解释
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】图神经网络（GNN）广泛用于分子、社交网络等图数据，但它的预测难以理解。反事实解释的思路很直观：对输入图做尽可能小的改动，使模型预测发生翻转，从而告诉用户“改哪里会改变结论”。现有图反事实方法有两个短板：一是“事后解释”——先训好 GNN，再单独训一个解释器，解释器看不到模型内部如何形成表示，解释质量受影响；二是“只看单样本”，缺乏跨样本的普适规律，而像药物发现这类任务恰恰需要从上万案例中总结通用规则来做系统决策。
【用了什么方法】作者提出 GCSGNN，把反事实生成直接嵌入 GNN 架构，做成“自解释”模型，使解释与模型决策过程保持一致；同时在多张图之间寻找共享的潜在模式，得到模型级（全局）的反事实解释。为避开在离散图结构上搜索带来的组合爆炸，他们把反事实操作放到连续的隐空间中进行，从而高效、可扩展地发现有普遍意义的修改模式。
【得到什么结果】在多个真实数据集上的实验显示，GCSGNN 在生成有效反事实解释方面优于现有方法，代码已开源。
【为何重要】它把图解释从“一条样本一个解释”的个案层面，推进到能反映整个模型决策规律的全局层面，并用隐空间技巧解决了可扩展性问题；对于需要可信、可复用的模型解释的高风险应用，这是关键的一步。

items.title_en: From Reward Engineering to Data-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Effective Agentic Visual Tool Use
items.title_zh: 从奖励工程到以数据为中心的强化学习：实现有效的智能体视觉工具使用
items.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly use external visual tools to acquire evidence during reasoning, yet learning when to invoke these tools remains challenging. Existing tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) methods often rely on call-contingent rewards to encourage beneficial tool use, but such reward engineering can distort the task objective and lead to degenerate calling behaviors. We argue that effective tool-use learning requires identifying not merely which questions are difficult, but which failures are attributable to missing visual evidence and can therefore be corrected through tool observations. We propose AOVO, a data-centric framework that enables MLLMs to learn effective tool use through perception attribution and policy-adaptive data sampling (PADS), without introducing tool-specific rewards. It counterfactually probes the model's reasoning states to identify observation-sensitive questions, distinguishing them from reasoning-dominated ones. PADS then periodically estimates category-level observation effects from recent policy rollouts and dynamically reallocates the training distribution toward questions where visual observations provide informative learning signals, while optimizing solely for final-answer correctness. Experiments across diverse visual perception and multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over competitive tool-use MLLMs, with causal analysis further validating the data-centric perspective for learning effective visual tool use.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在推理过程中越来越多地使用外部视觉工具来获取证据，但学习何时调用这些工具仍具挑战性。现有的工具使用强化学习（RL）方法通常依赖与调用相关的奖励来鼓励有益的工具使用，但此类奖励工程可能扭曲任务目标并导致退化的调用行为。我们认为，有效的工具使用学习不仅需要识别哪些问题困难，还需要识别哪些失败可归因于缺失的视觉证据，因而可以通过工具观测加以纠正。我们提出 AOVO，一个以数据为中心的框架，通过感知归因和策略自适应数据采样（PADS）使 MLLMs 学习有效的工具使用，且不引入工具特定奖励。它对模型的推理状态进行反事实探测，以识别对观测敏感的问题，并将其与推理主导的问题区分开。随后，PADS 从最近的策略 rollout 中周期性估计类别级观测效应，并动态地将训练分布重新分配到视觉观测能提供有信息学习信号的问题上，同时仅针对最终答案正确性进行优化。在多样化的视觉感知和多模态推理基准上的实验表明，相较于有竞争力的工具使用 MLLMs 取得一致提升，因果分析进一步验证了以数据为中心视角在有效视觉工具使用学习中的作用。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control
items.title_zh: ACAP：用于高效机器人控制的异步编码智能体
items.abstract_en: Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each member reasons and acts for a configurable control group, such as an arm with its gripper or the torso and chassis, enabling asynchronous reasoning and execution. However, different robot components often have physical dependencies that require coordination. To address this challenge, ACAP introduces a hyper-agent that assigns tasks, coordinates dependencies, and dynamically allocates control between the lead and member agents. This allows independent work to progress concurrently while supporting tightly coupled manipulation when necessary. Across 72 real-world rollouts covering 25 task/platform settings, ACAP reduces task-balanced time cost by 28.2% compared with a single-agent Direct Policy, with improvements across Fully Parallel, Parallel-Sequential, and Collaborative tasks. Across all eight Collaborative settings, ACAP also achieves lower mean time cost than Fixed Delegation, where only member agents can control their assigned groups. An additional 90-rollout study shows lower mean 30-minute-capped time cost than Direct on all six tasks. We further demonstrate mobile manipulation using the same member interface for chassis and torso control. We present the framework and a real-world rollout dataset containing observations, generated programs, actions, and feedback to support research on how coding agents reason and act in the physical world.
items.abstract_zh: 编码智能体可以在执行过程中构建和修改机器人行为，但让单个智能体控制整个机器人可能会延误原本可独立进行的工作。我们提出异步编码智能体即策略（ACAP），这是一个异步框架，将单个机器人组织为一组持久智能体团队。每个成员为可配置的控制组进行推理与行动，例如带夹爪的手臂或躯干与底盘，从而实现异步推理与执行。然而，不同机器人组件通常存在需要协调的物理依赖关系。为应对这一挑战，ACAP 引入一个超智能体（hyper-agent），负责任务分配、协调依赖关系，并在主导智能体与成员智能体之间动态分配控制权。这使独立工作能够并发推进，同时在必要时支持紧耦合的操作。在覆盖 25 种任务/平台设置的 72 次真实世界 rollout 中，与单智能体 Direct Policy 相比，ACAP 将任务均衡时间成本降低 28.2%，并在完全并行、并行-顺序和协作任务上均有改善。在所有八种协作设置中，ACAP 的平均时间成本也低于 Fixed Delegation（仅成员智能体可控制其分配组）。另一项 90 次 rollout 的研究显示，在全部六个任务上，其平均时间成本（上限 30 分钟）均低于 Direct。我们进一步演示了移动操作，使用相同的成员接口控制底盘和躯干。我们提出该框架以及一个真实世界 rollout 数据集，包含观测、生成的程序、动作和反馈，以支持关于编码智能体如何在物理世界中推理与行动的研究。

items.title_en: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
items.title_zh: WeMM-Ecom：推进微信电子商务的多模态内容理解
items.abstract_en: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 WeMM-Ecom，一系列多模态大语言模型，在各自规模上提供前沿的电子商务能力，同时达到最先进的通用性能。该系列涵盖五种规模，从 0.8B 稠密模型到 35B 混合专家模型（激活参数 3B）。我们的训练流程首先进行两阶段持续预训练，在多样化的多模态数据混合中逐步提高电子商务数据的比例；随后进行混合思维后训练，结合同策略蒸馏与强化学习，以同时支持非思考模式和思考模式。在评估方面，我们构建了涵盖 28 个电子商务基准（23 个内部基准和 5 个开源基准）的综合套件，覆盖八个业务场景，并辅以 64 个公开通用基准。在电子商务套件上，WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B 超越了规模显著更大的开源旗舰模型，包括 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、HY4 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。在通用套件上，每个 WeMM-Ecom 模型都超越了同等规模的 Qwen3.5 对应模型，其中轻量变体（如 WeMM-Ecom-2B）相较 Qwen3.5-2B、MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B 和 LFM3-VL-2B 等领先轻量模型显示出明显优势。在基准之外，WeMM-Ecom 目前已支持微信中数百个生产用例，包括商品目录管理、多模态商品搜索和直播电商，每日处理十亿级请求。我们公开所有模型权重，并详述数据整理、训练方案和基准构建，以促进未来面向领域专用的多模态模型研究。我们已在 https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom 发布模型权重和代码，以促进后续研究。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Protein Structure Tokenizers as Generation Targets for Language Models
items.title_zh: 将蛋白质结构分词器作为语言模型生成目标进行基准评测
items.abstract_en: Discrete structure tokenizers are the standard way to give a language model access to protein three-dimensional structure, yet they are selected on how accurately they can be read, their reconstruction fidelity, while the property that governs generation is how well a model can write them. We measure this property, writability, directly: holding the base model, data, recipe and compute fixed, we swap only the tokenizer and train the same 9B model to emit structure tokens residue by residue, over eight tokenizers, four compute budgets and three evaluation sets (96 cells). At 2B tokens final writability runs from TM 0.662 down to 0.378 under identical conditions, with five of the eight arms clearing the TM 0.5 mark at which a fold is usually called correct and three falling short of it. Neither codebook size nor reconstruction ceiling explains where an arm lands; the best and worst both use 8192 codewords. What does explain the spread is local structure preservation of the code space. In DPLM-2 a one-bit codeword error costs 0.019 TM where a random codeword costs 0.347, and the trained model's own errors are correspondingly local, at 0.51 of the random Hamming expectation; FoldToken4 fails both tests at the same codebook size and is 0.13 TM less writable. Three controls discipline how such a benchmark may be read. A same-recipe rerun puts the noise floor at $σ=0.0067$ TM, which collapses an apparent six-way ranking into four tiers. A reference-free geometry panel turns out to be nearly orthogonal to TM (Pearson $-0.58$), with the worst arm by TM producing the most physically valid backbones. And two pre-registered interventions are null for a reason the mechanism measurements reveal: the quantity they target saturates at 1.5B tokens while TM is still rising. All 131 evaluation cells, including raw generated token streams, are released.
items.abstract_zh: 离散结构分词器是让语言模型获取蛋白质三维结构的标准方式，然而它们通常依据可被读取的准确程度（即重建保真度）来选择，而支配生成的属性是模型能够多好地写出它们。我们直接测量这一属性，即可写性：在固定基础模型、数据、配方和计算资源的情况下，仅替换分词器，并在八个分词器、四种计算预算和三个评估集（96 个单元）上训练同一个 9B 模型逐残基地输出结构 token。在 2B token 时，相同条件下最终可写性从 TM 0.662 降至 0.378，八个分支中有五个超过通常将折叠判定为正确的 TM 0.5 阈值，三个未达到。码本大小和重建上限均不能解释某分支所处的位置；最好和最差的分支都使用 8192 个码字。能够解释这种差异的是码空间的局部结构保持性。在 DPLM-2 中，一个比特的码字错误造成 0.019 TM 的损失，而随机码字造成 0.347 的损失；训练模型自身的错误相应地也是局部的，为随机汉明期望的 0.51；FoldToken4 在相同码本大小下两项测试均失败，可写性低 0.13 TM。三项对照约束了应如何解读此类基准。相同配方的重跑将噪声下限置于 σ=0.0067 TM，这使表面上的六路排名缩减为四个层级。无参考几何面板结果几乎与 TM 正交（Pearson −0.58），并且按 TM 最差的分支产生了物理上最有效的骨架。两项预注册干预为零结果，其原因由机制测量揭示：它们所针对的量在 1.5B token 时饱和，而 TM 仍在上升。所有 131 个评估单元，包括原始生成 token 流，均已发布。

items.title_en: QuOptLab: Advancing Quantum Optics Experiments with an AI Agent
items.title_zh: QuOptLab：利用 AI 智能体推进量子光学实验
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI-assisted theoretical research suggest that AI agents can contribute to research-level problems. Whether they can also advance experimental research by conducting experiments, analyzing the results, and proposing better experimental designs remains an open question. To address this question, we build a simulated quantum optics laboratory and integrate it with an AI agent in QuOptLab. The laboratory includes optical instruments, a robotic arm, and cameras, enabling the agent to carry out and iteratively refine experiments. We consider two complementary tasks: thin-film thickness measurement in free-space optics and edge-coupler design in integrated photonics. In the thin-film thickness measurement task, the agent repeatedly analyzes measurement results and revises its measurement method, including calibration and data analysis, reducing thickness-estimation error from 7.13 to 0.066~nm$^2$ over six epochs in a classical-interference run. For edge-coupler design, the agent iteratively proposes structural modifications, evaluates the resulting coupling performance, and uses the feedback to guide subsequent revisions, increasing simulated coupling efficiency from 85.81% to 91.98%.
items.abstract_zh: 近期 AI 辅助理论研究的进展表明，AI 智能体可以解决研究级问题。它们是否也能通过执行实验、分析结果并提出更好的实验设计来推进实验研究，仍是一个开放问题。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个模拟量子光学实验室，并在 QuOptLab 中将其与 AI 智能体集成。该实验室包括光学仪器、机械臂和相机，使智能体能够执行并迭代改进实验。我们考虑两个互补任务：自由空间光学中的薄膜厚度测量和集成光子学中的边缘耦合器设计。在薄膜厚度测量任务中，智能体反复分析测量结果并修改其测量方法，包括校准和数据分析，在经典干涉运行中经过六个 epoch 将厚度估计误差从 7.13 降至 0.066 nm²。对于边缘耦合器设计，智能体迭代提出结构修改，评估所得耦合性能，并利用反馈指导后续修改，将模拟耦合效率从 85.81% 提高到 91.98%。
