items.title_en: NoHairCache: Calibrate-Once KV Cache Eviction with One Power-Law Exponent
items.title_zh: NoHairCache：以单一幂律指数实现一次校准的 KV 缓存驱逐
items.abstract_en: The decay exponent $α$ in KV-cache eviction is an intrinsic property of the model: calibrated once on a single corpus, it transfers directly across domains. Attention-based accumulation (H2O) and recency-based sliding windows (StreamingLLM) are two dominant eviction frameworks, often treated as unrelated, but we show that they are the two endpoints of a single power-law family: by scoring each token as $s_i = A_i \cdot (t-i)^{-α}$, where $A_i$ is cumulative attention and $α$ controls the age penalty, H2O and StreamingLLM correspond to $α=0$ and $α\to\infty$, respectively (with StreamingLLM additionally hard-coding an attention-sink patch). The no-hair mechanism of \citet{xiang2026nohair} bounds the admissible range of $α$, and the measured exponents agree: calibrating once on WikiText yields $[0.556, 0.822]$ for a representative model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct). The per-model ranges are consistent across five models (410M--1.5B) and independently match the optimal regions from perplexity sweeps. \textsc{NoHairCache} achieves the lowest perplexity across three datasets (WikiText, PG19, and arXiv) without per-dataset tuning, outperforming both H2O and StreamingLLM ($p < 0.05$ on all three datasets, with $0.06$--$0.10$ PPL gains over StreamingLLM at budget $512$). On downstream four-way multiple-choice QA, it matches or outperforms StreamingLLM across all nine (task, budget) cells, retaining $98.2\%$ of full-cache accuracy on NarrativeQA at $25\%$ retention versus $91.1\%$ for StreamingLLM; per-cell McNemar tests are not significant, so QA is corroborating only. We release our calibration script and drop-in scorer upon publication.
items.abstract_zh: KV 缓存驱逐中的衰减指数 α 是模型的内在属性：在单一语料上校准一次后，它可直接跨领域迁移。基于注意力的累积（H2O）和基于近因的滑动窗口（StreamingLLM）是两种主流驱逐框架，常被视为互不相关，但我们表明它们是同一幂律族的两个端点：通过将每个 token 评分为 s_i = A_i · (t−i)^(−α)，其中 A_i 是累积注意力，α 控制年龄惩罚，H2O 和 StreamingLLM 分别对应 α=0 和 α→∞（StreamingLLM 还额外硬编码了一个 attention-sink 补丁）。文献 Xiang 等（2026）的 no-hair 机制界定了 α 的允许范围，且测得的指数与之相符：在 WikiText 上校准一次，对代表性模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct）得到 [0.556, 0.822]。各模型的范围在五个模型（410M–1.5B）间一致，并独立匹配困惑度扫描得到的最优区域。NoHairCache 在三个数据集（WikiText、PG19 和 arXiv）上无需按数据集调参即取得最低困惑度，优于 H2O 和 StreamingLLM（在三个数据集上均 p < 0.05；在预算 512 时相对 StreamingLLM 的 PPL 增益为 0.06–0.10）。在下游四选一多项选择问答中，它在全部九个（任务、预算）单元上达到或超过 StreamingLLM，在 NarrativeQA 上以 25% 保留率保持全缓存准确率的 98.2%，而 StreamingLLM 为 91.1%；逐单元 McNemar 检验不显著，因此 QA 仅起佐证作用。我们将在发表时发布校准脚本和即插即用评分器。

items.title_en: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios from Role-Typed Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Drafted by Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 从大型语言模型起草的角色类型化信号时序逻辑规范生成安全关键驾驶场景
items.abstract_en: Safety-critical scenarios are rare in recorded driving and must be generated to test and train motion planners of automated vehicles. In guided diffusion models, each scenario type needs its own weighted objective, separate from the validity check. Optimized together with the attacker, the vehicle under test can cancel the attack or draw it toward itself. We state each scenario as a signal temporal logic specification with clauses typed by role. Every clause names the agent it may change and the agents it may read, and the vehicle under test reads the attacker only from the attack onset. A large language model drafts the specification from a description, and a type checker accepts it. A compiler derives the optimization: it edits a diffusion model's samples by the smallest change that satisfies the specification, each clause moves only its owner, the attacker is solved against the unreacted vehicle under test before its response, and the monitor of the same specification decides acceptance. On nuScenes and CommonRoad, judged independently of the specification, one parameter set produced valid scenarios at a rate 0.14 above a weighted objective tuned per scenario type, and descriptions yielded at least one valid scenario for 11 of the 16 pre-crash types expressible in the public data. Learned planners fail more often on the generated scenarios than on their seeds. Fine-tuning on them lowers a planner's failure rate on critical scenarios, and the time headway one clause of the label requires, not the generator, sets the size of the gain.
items.abstract_zh: 安全关键场景在记录驾驶中很少见，必须生成这些场景以测试和训练自动驾驶车辆的运动规划器。在引导扩散模型中，每种场景类型需要自己的加权目标，并与有效性检查分开。与攻击者一起优化时，被测车辆可以取消攻击或将其吸引到自身。我们将每种场景表述为信号时序逻辑规范，其子句按角色类型化。每个子句指定它可以改变的智能体以及它可以读取的智能体，并且被测车辆仅从攻击开始时刻读取攻击者。大型语言模型根据描述起草规范，类型检查器接受该规范。编译器推导优化：它通过满足规范的最小更改来编辑扩散模型的样本，每个子句只移动其所有者，攻击者在被测车辆响应之前针对未反应的被测车辆求解，同一规范的监视器决定接受。在nuScenes和CommonRoad上，独立于规范进行评判，一组参数产生的有效场景率比按场景类型调优的加权目标高0.14，并且描述为公共数据中可表达的16种碰撞前类型中的11种至少产生了一个有效场景。学习到的规划器在生成场景上比在其种子上更频繁地失败。在这些场景上微调会降低规划器在关键场景上的失败率，而标签中一个子句所需的时间车头时距（而非生成器）决定了增益的大小。

items.title_en: MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research
items.title_zh: MORSE：通过开放世界自动研究优化流式记忆设计
items.abstract_en: A streaming video system must decide in a single pass what evidence to retain under bounded frame storage, before it knows which details a future question will require. Recent recursive self-improvement methods automate the design of the harness that stores and retrieves this evidence. They revise the harness in response to failures, but the editor must still devise each repair from its prior knowledge and a predefined set of tools. A failure that recurs across videos, however, may point to a problem that prior work has already addressed. We introduce MORSE (Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement), an open-world auto-research framework that uses recurring failures to guide an online search for solutions. Its editor groups failures in training traces by cause, then searches papers, model cards, and code for methods it can adapt or pretrained perception models it can use. When the editor introduces a new perceptual capability, it can also revise how the harness stores and retrieves the resulting evidence for a frozen video-language model. On held-out validation streams, MORSE first selects revisions that improve answer quality, then seeks faster revisions that preserve those gains within a specified tolerance. Across three streaming video benchmarks, MORSE consistently achieves the highest answer accuracy within each frozen-backbone comparison. On OVO-Bench, our Qwen3-VL-8B harness answers queries in 0.30 seconds on average while achieving 75.1% accuracy, 3.1 percentage points ahead of the next-best evaluated harness using the same frozen backbone.
items.abstract_zh: 流式视频系统必须在单遍处理中、在有界帧存储下决定保留哪些证据，而此时它尚不知道未来问题会需要哪些细节。近期的递归自我改进方法自动化设计用于存储和检索这些证据的运行框架。它们根据失败修订运行框架，但编辑器仍须依据先验知识和预定义工具集来设计每一次修复。然而，在不同视频中反复出现的失败可能指向先前工作已经解决的问题。我们提出 MORSE（Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement），一个开放世界自动研究框架，利用反复出现的失败来指导在线搜索解决方案。其编辑器按原因对训练轨迹中的失败进行分组，然后检索论文、模型卡和代码，寻找可适配的方法或可使用的预训练感知模型。当编辑器引入新的感知能力时，它还可以针对冻结的视频-语言模型修订运行框架存储和检索所得证据的方式。在留出验证流上，MORSE 首先选择能提升答案质量的修订，然后寻求在指定容差内保持这些收益的更快速修订。在三个流式视频基准上，MORSE 在每个冻结骨干比较中始终取得最高答案准确率。在 OVO-Bench 上，我们的 Qwen3-VL-8B 运行框架平均在 0.30 秒内回答查询，同时达到 75.1% 准确率，比使用相同冻结骨干的次优已评估运行框架领先 3.1 个百分点。

items.title_en: One-Step Self-Assembling Lipopolymer Coatings Enable Direct Longitudinal Biosensing in Native Biological Matrices
items.title_zh: 一步自组装脂质聚合物涂层实现天然生物基质中的直接纵向生物传感
items.abstract_en: Sample-driven cross-reactivity remains a fundamental bottleneck for sensitive and selective biosensing in complex biological environments, particularly in microfluidic systems where high surface-to-volumes ratios amplify non-specific interactions. Here, we address this challenge with a one-step, biomimetic surface functionalization strategy based on engineered lipid-based nanocarriers that self-assemble within minutes into immunoassay-ready, antifouling interfaces that couple pegylated-lipid passivation with biorthogonal, site-specific probe conjugation. This approach enables rapid, tuneable, and reproducible surface functionalization, which suppresses sample-specific cross-reactivity even in undiluted serum, and supports direct, label-free digital biosensing assays directly in native biological environments. When integrated into an optofluidic platform combining digital in-line holography and microfluidics, this approach allows time-resolved quantification of tetraspanin-positive extracellular vesicle secretion dynamics from two-dimensional and three-dimensional lung cancer cell models using 50 μL of sample within 10 min, without isolation or purification. Because the presented surface functionalization proceeds via self-assembly rather than covalent surface modification, this one-step modular-approach is intrinsically decoupled from device fabrication and applies to both glass and PDMS, coating the entire microfluidic channel, thereby establishing a general route for integrating biomimetic nanostructures into robust, high-performance immunoassays, advancing biosensing beyond end-point measurements, and towards rapid and continuous real-time monitoring.
items.abstract_zh: 样品驱动的交叉反应性仍是复杂生物环境中灵敏且选择性生物传感的基本瓶颈，尤其是在微流体系统中，高表面积与体积比会放大非特异性相互作用。在此，我们通过一步仿生表面功能化策略应对这一挑战，该策略基于工程化脂质基纳米载体，这些载体在数分钟内自组装成可直接用于免疫测定的防污界面，将聚乙二醇化脂质钝化与生物正交、位点特异性探针偶联相结合。该方法可实现快速、可调且可重复的表面功能化，即使在未稀释血清中也能抑制样品特异性交叉反应，并支持直接在天然生物环境中进行直接、无标记的数字生物传感测定。当集成到结合数字同轴全息与微流体的光流控平台中时，该方法可利用50 μL样品在10分钟内，对二维和三维肺癌细胞模型分泌的四跨膜蛋白阳性细胞外囊泡动态进行时间分辨定量，无需分离或纯化。由于所提出的表面功能化通过自组装而非共价表面修饰进行，这一一步模块化方法本质上与器件制造解耦，并适用于玻璃和PDMS，涂覆整个微流体通道，从而为将仿生纳米结构集成到稳健、高性能免疫测定中建立通用途径，推动生物传感超越终点测量，迈向快速连续实时监测。

items.title_en: Anatomy of orbital and spin responses in GaAs and Si: Hall, inverse Faraday, and magneto-optical Kerr effects
items.title_zh: GaAs 与 Si 中轨道与自旋响应的解剖：霍尔、逆法拉第与磁光克尔效应
items.abstract_en: Magneto-optical signals in nonmagnetic semiconductors entangle spin and orbital contributions, both in angular-momentum generation and magneto-optical detection. We calculate these contributions for electron-doped GaAs and Si using density-functional theory, linear-response theory, and a second-order density-matrix treatment of the inverse Faraday effect. At small electron doping, the intrinsic orbital Hall conductivity exceeds its spin counterpart in magnitude, while the orbital contribution to light-induced magnetization dominates over broad photon-energy ranges. We show that orbital- and spin-resolved optical Hall and polar Kerr coefficients exhibit stronger sensitivity to orbital moments than to equal spin moments. This contrast reflects direct electric-dipole coupling to orbital motion versus spin-orbit-mediated coupling to spin polarization. Consequently, Si maintains a substantial orbital magneto-optical response despite its weak spin-orbit interaction. At probe energies of 1.5 eV in GaAs and 3.0 eV in Si, the magnitude of the Kerr rotation per unit orbital moment is approximately 5 and 13 times larger than that per unit spin moment, respectively. Combining the calculated Hall conductivities and Kerr coefficients with a phenomenological drift-diffusion model yields predominantly orbital edge signals for the assumed diffusion constants and relaxation lengths. These results indicate that optical detection of induced magnetization in doped semiconductors such as GaAs and Si can be dominated by orbital signals, and therefore cannot be interpreted solely in terms of spin polarization.
items.abstract_zh: 非磁性半导体中的磁光信号在角动量产生与磁光检测两方面都将自旋与轨道贡献纠缠在一起。我们使用密度泛函理论、线性响应理论以及对逆法拉第效应的二阶密度矩阵处理，计算了电子掺杂 GaAs 和 Si 中的这些贡献。在低电子掺杂下，本征轨道霍尔电导率在量值上超过其自旋对应量，而轨道对光致磁化的贡献在较宽光子能量范围内占主导。我们表明，轨道与自旋分辨的光学霍尔系数和极向克尔系数对轨道矩的敏感性高于对等量自旋矩的敏感性。这一对比反映了电偶极直接耦合到轨道运动与通过自旋-轨道介导耦合到自旋极化的差异。因此，尽管 Si 的自旋-轨道相互作用较弱，其仍保持可观的轨道磁光响应。在 GaAs 的 1.5 eV 和 Si 的 3.0 eV 探测能量下，单位轨道矩的克尔旋转幅度分别约为单位自旋矩的 5 倍和 13 倍。将计算得到的霍尔电导率和克尔系数与唯象漂移-扩散模型结合，在假设的扩散常数与弛豫长度下主要得到轨道边缘信号。这些结果表明，在 GaAs 和 Si 等掺杂半导体中，对感生磁化的光学检测可能由轨道信号主导，因此不能仅用自旋极化来解释。

items.title_en: Measuring Counterfactual Credit in a Replayable Wildfire-Suppression Benchmark
items.title_zh: 在可重放的野火抑制基准中测量反事实信用
items.abstract_en: In cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, learned critics are usually evaluated by how well they predict the team's return. Yet predicting a team's return and assigning credit to individual actions are distinct tasks. To test credit directly, we introduce FLARE (Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment), a stochastic wildfire suppression benchmark in which any moment of a fire can be replayed with different actions under the same random events. Replaying one step measures the immediate effect of each agent's suppression, which we call simulator credit and use for training. Replaying to the end of the episode measures the effect of each action, which we use for grading critics. In a comparison over eight seeds with multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO), simulator credit reduces the interquartile mean burn score (each cell's burning time, capped and averaged over the map; lower is better) from 26.6% with shared reward to 20.9%. Learned credit from a centralized COMA-style critic does no better than the shared reward. Four trained critics predict the team's return well, yet the credit they assign is 9 to 42 times larger than the credit measured by replay. The critics also give heterogeneous agents nearly identical action rankings. These results show that a good fit to the team's return is a weak test of a critic's credit.
items.abstract_zh: 在合作多智能体强化学习中，学习到的评论家通常按其对团队回报的预测效果来评估。然而预测团队回报与将信用分配给个体动作是不同任务。为直接检验信用，我们引入FLARE（可重放环境中的火线学习智能体），一个随机野火抑制基准，其中火灾的任一时刻都可在相同随机事件下用不同动作重放。重放一步测量每个智能体抑制动作的即时效果，我们称之为模拟器信用并用于训练。重放到回合结束测量每个动作的效果，我们用于评分评论家。在与多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）比较的八个种子上，模拟器信用将四分位均值燃烧分数（每个单元的燃烧时间，截断后在地图上平均；越低越好）从共享奖励的26.6%降至20.9%。来自集中式COMA风格评论家的学习信用并不优于共享奖励。四个训练后的评论家能很好地预测团队回报，但它们分配的信用比通过重放测得的信用大9至42倍。这些评论家还对所有异质智能体给出几乎相同的动作排序。这些结果表明，对团队回报的良好拟合是对评论家信用的弱检验。

items.title_en: SALSA: Sampling Adversarial Suffixes from Learned Distributions for LLM Safety Assessment
items.title_zh: SALSA：从学习分布中采样对抗后缀用于LLM安全评估
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where adversaries append optimized suffixes to otherwise benign looking prompts to bypass safety alignment. Existing optimization-based GCG-style attacks can be effective, but they are expensive at inference time, and suffer from poor transfer. We present, SALSA, a generative framework that learns a distribution over jailbreak suffixes from optimization-derived attack corpora. Once trained, the model supports efficient sampling-based attacks. On open-source targets, it achieves attack success rates comparable to state-of-the-art optimization baselines, while reducing generation time from 3.46s to 0.04s per prompt. In black-box transfer, it remains highly effective against proprietary systems, including 99% ASR on GPT-3.5-Turbo, and reaches 45% ASR on the substantially harder GPT-4o, more than doubling the strongest baseline at an equal sampling budget. We further offer an intuition for why generative sampling can preserve high attack success, when the learned suffix distribution is close to the distribution of optimization outputs. Overall, our results show that learning adversarial suffix distributions yields a scalable, and practically efficient foundation for continuous LLM vulnerability discovery.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）仍然容易受到越狱攻击，攻击者会在看似良性的提示后附加优化后缀以绕过安全对齐。现有的基于优化的GCG风格攻击虽然有效，但在推理时成本高且迁移性差。我们提出SALSA，一种从优化推导出的攻击语料中学习越狱后缀分布的生成式框架。训练完成后，该模型支持高效的基于采样的攻击。在开源目标上，它达到与最先进优化基线相当的攻击成功率，同时将每个提示的生成时间从3.46秒降至0.04秒。在黑盒迁移中，它对专有系统仍然高度有效，包括在GPT-3.5-Turbo上达到99% ASR，并在难度显著更高的GPT-4o上达到45% ASR，在相同采样预算下超过最强基线的两倍以上。我们进一步给出一种直觉，解释当学习到的后缀分布接近优化输出分布时，生成式采样为何能保持高攻击成功率。总体而言，我们的结果表明，学习对抗后缀分布为持续的LLM漏洞发现提供了可扩展且实际高效的基础。

items.title_en: Seeing to Drive on a Single Board: Attention-Free Depth for Onboard Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 在单板上看见以驾驶：面向机载机器人导航的无注意力深度
items.abstract_en: A small ground robot can carry one camera and a few watts of compute, but the depth foundation models that could turn that camera into a range sensor are vision transformers sized for GPUs. We bring one to a Raspberry Pi 5 with the Hailo-8L, an accelerator that runs every layer in integer arithmetic, attention included. Quantised for it, Depth Anything V2 loses large parts of the scene, and we measure why: at 449 tokens, 91% of softmax weights fall below one int8 step while carrying 17-33% of the attention mass. Our answer is to distil, not quantise. An attention-free ResNet-34 U-Net student of Depth Anything V2-Large (24.5M parameters) runs at 27.1 FPS on the chip, its int8 output matches its float twin (Pearson 0.99993), and on held-out scenes of its simulated yard it is the most accurate depth network on the chip (AbsRel 0.269 against 0.354-0.530). On 1,000 stereo-verified points of a real outdoor drive it is not resolvably different from the vendor's Depth Anything V2-Small build, while running faster (27.1 vs 21.6 FPS). Ranging obstacles by where they meet the floor needs only the camera height, so mapping, hybrid-A* planning and SLAM run on the Pi's own CPU. In real-time hardware-in-the-loop tests in a Gaussian-splat reconstruction of a real yard, the stack reaches the goal without contact in 7.9$\pm$1.1 of 10 scenes, against 9.2$\pm$0.4 with exact obstacles, and in 7.7$\pm$0.7 on its own pose with simulated wheel odometry (ten seeds each; 8.2$\pm$0.4 with the real Pi and Hailo-8L in the loop, five seeds). The source code, pre-trained models and data are available at https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL.
items.abstract_zh: 小型地面机器人可以携带一个相机和几瓦计算资源，但能将相机变为测距传感器的深度基础模型是面向GPU规模的视觉Transformer。我们将其中一个部署到搭载Hailo-8L的Raspberry Pi 5上，该加速器以整数算术运行每一层，包括注意力。为其量化后，Depth Anything V2丢失场景的大部分，我们测量了原因：在449个token时，91%的softmax权重低于一个int8步长，却承载17%至33%的注意力质量。我们的答案是蒸馏，而非量化。Depth Anything V2-Large（2450万参数）的无注意力ResNet-34 U-Net学生模型在该芯片上以27.1 FPS运行，其int8输出与其浮点孪生模型匹配（Pearson 0.99993），在其模拟场地的留出场景中，它是该芯片上最准确的深度网络（AbsRel 0.269，对比0.354至0.530）。在真实户外行驶的1000个经立体验证的点上，它与厂商的Depth Anything V2-Small构建没有可分辨差异，同时运行更快（27.1 vs 21.6 FPS）。通过障碍物与地面相交位置测距仅需相机高度，因此建图、混合A*规划和SLAM在Pi自身CPU上运行。在真实场地的Gaussian-splat重建中进行的实时硬件在环测试中，该栈在10个场景中的7.9±1.1个场景中无接触到达目标，对比使用精确障碍物时的9.2±0.4，并在使用模拟轮式里程计和自身位姿时为7.7±0.7（各十个种子；真实Pi和Hailo-8L在环时为8.2±0.4，五个种子）。源代码、预训练模型和数据可在https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL获取。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为神经辐射场以进行视图合成
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏输入视图优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视角方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5维坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视角相关发射辐射亮度。我们通过沿相机射线查询5维坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影为图像。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何和外观的场景的照片级真实感新视角，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以获得有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Learning effective stochastic predator and prey dynamics across physical and biological systems from limited data
items.title_zh: 从有限数据中学习跨物理与生物系统的有效随机捕食者-猎物动力学
items.abstract_en: Constructing an effective low-dimensional stochastic model from sparse observations requires separating deterministic drift from state-dependent fluctuations when the governing interaction law is unknown. We formulate an adaptive neural stochastic differential equation with topology constraints (TC-AdaNSDE) for two-variable predator--prey dynamics. To regularize the inverse problem when data are scarce, the model combines flexible drift and correlated diffusion fields with density-adaptive local Kramers--Moyal moment estimates and soft phase-space constraints reflecting boundary saddle behavior near extinction and local stability near coexistence. Using a known nonlinear stochastic system, we first show that short-time trajectory error cannot assess diffusion accuracy on its own and must be paired with distributional measures of one-step transitions and long-time phase-space occupancy. We then apply this framework to macroscopic turbulence and zonal flow energies reduced from Hasegawa--Wakatani plasma simulations and to short ecological time series. In the sparse-data regime, TC-AdaNSDE reproduces both short-horizon evolution and long-time invariant energy distributions where deterministic reductions collapse and unconstrained stochastic fits diverge, while recovering physically interpretable drift and fluctuation fields across both physical and biological systems.
items.abstract_zh: 在支配性相互作用规律未知时，从稀疏观测中构建有效的低维随机模型需要将确定性漂移与状态依赖涨落分离。我们针对二变量捕食者-猎物动力学，提出一种带拓扑约束的自适应神经随机微分方程（TC-AdaNSDE）。为在数据稀缺时对反问题进行正则化，该模型将灵活的漂移场和相关扩散场与密度自适应的局部 Kramers--Moyal 矩估计以及软相空间约束相结合，这些约束反映灭绝附近的边界鞍行为和共存附近的局部稳定性。利用一个已知的非线性随机系统，我们首先表明，短时轨迹误差本身不能评估扩散精度，必须与一步转移的分布度量和长时相空间占据度量配合使用。随后，我们将该框架应用于从 Hasegawa--Wakatani 等离子体模拟约化得到的宏观湍流和纬向流能量，以及短生态时间序列。在稀疏数据情形下，TC-AdaNSDE 能够再现短时程演化和长时不变能量分布，而确定性约化会失效、无约束随机拟合会发散；同时，它在物理和生物系统中都能恢复具有物理可解释性的漂移场和涨落场。

items.title_en: Polarization switching of double azimuthal backflow in two transverse orbital angular momentum superpositions
items.title_zh: 两个横向轨道角动量叠加中双方位角回流的偏振切换
items.abstract_en: Optical backflow in the azimuthal direction can be generated by the interference of two rotating-wave structured light beams with distinct transverse topological charges and equal intensity. Here we show that the interference reverses both azimuthal components of the Poynting and the canonical momenta. Although these two momenta are not generally tied, they reverse jointly here: both acquire azimuthal backflow in a common angular sector, while their radial intervals can differ. The double backflow is switched solely by the polarizations of the two beams, without amplitude tuning. A single polarization overlap enters the interference terms of both momenta but not the single-beam terms of either, so that matched polarizations switch the double backflow on whereas mismatched ones switch it off. The double backflow is periodic in the azimuthal direction, with its angular period locked to the topological charge difference and independent of the individual charges. Our results establish a vectorial mechanism for polarization-gated azimuthal backflow, with potential applications in polarization-switchable optical manipulation.
items.abstract_zh: 方位角方向的光学回流可由两束具有不同横向拓扑电荷且强度相等的旋转波结构光束干涉产生。这里我们表明，干涉使坡印廷动量和正则动量的两个方位角分量均反转。尽管这两种动量通常并不绑定，但在此处它们共同反转：两者在共同角扇区中获得方位角回流，而其径向间隔可以不同。双回流仅由两束光的偏振切换，无需幅度调谐。单一偏振重叠进入两种动量的干涉项，但不进入任一单光束项，因此匹配偏振开启双回流，而不匹配偏振将其关闭。双回流在方位角方向具有周期性，其角周期锁定于拓扑电荷差，且与各电荷无关。我们的结果建立了一种用于偏振门控方位角回流的矢量机制，并可能在偏振可切换光操控中具有应用。

items.title_en: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
items.title_zh: 线性方法能走多远？BiPert：单细胞扰动建模的统一框架
items.abstract_en: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. Predicting perturbation responses in unseen cell types and identifying perturbed genes from their transcriptional effects therefore remain challenging. Here, we show that both tasks can be addressed through a common linear decomposition of transcriptional responses into shared and perturbation-specific components. Building on this principle, we introduce BiPert, a simple linear framework for both forward perturbation prediction and inverse identification. For forward prediction, BiPert outperforms existing methods that use no external biological knowledge when predicting gene expression changes in unseen cell lines. Its few-shot extension, BiPert-FS, adapts to new cell lines using as few as ten measured perturbations. For inverse identification, BiPert-ID identifies perturbed genes from single-cell expression profiles, outperforming deep-learning methods in unseen cell lines and donors. We further show that perturbations whose effects transfer more consistently across cellular contexts are also easier to identify, even after controlling for perturbation effect size. Together, these results establish a connection between perturbation transfer and identification, and demonstrate that simple linear models provide strong, interpretable baselines for both tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 理解遗传扰动如何影响细胞行为对于研究基因功能和调控机制至关重要。大规模 CRISPR 筛选在数千个基因上测量这些效应，但覆盖的细胞情境相对较少。因此，在未见细胞类型中预测扰动响应，以及从转录效应中识别被扰动基因，仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们表明这两个任务都可以通过将转录响应共同线性分解为共享成分和扰动特异成分来解决。基于这一原理，我们提出 BiPert，一个用于正向扰动预测和逆向识别的简单线性框架。在正向预测方面，BiPert 在预测未见细胞系中的基因表达变化时，优于不使用外部生物学知识的现有方法。其少样本扩展 BiPert-FS 仅使用十个已测量扰动即可适应新细胞系。在逆向识别方面，BiPert-ID 从单细胞表达谱中识别被扰动基因，在未见细胞系和供体中优于深度学习方法。我们进一步表明，即使在控制扰动效应量之后，效应在细胞情境间迁移更一致的扰动也更容易被识别。总之，这些结果建立了扰动迁移与识别之间的联系，并表明简单线性模型为这两个任务提供了强大且可解释的基线。

items.title_en: Avalon-M1: Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards
items.title_zh: Avalon-M1：从集体奖励中进行强化学习
items.abstract_en: We introduce reinforcement learning from collective rewards (RLCR), a recipe for jointly training language models to act as agent organisations under latency constraints. A CEO and up to eight specialists share one policy, co-ordinate through a message board and workspace, and are trained with a common outcome-derived advantage. The deadline makes parallel work valuable when it increases the return earned before the cap. We train Avalon-M1-Mini (120B) across 147 environments. For the trained model, eight-hire organisational execution raises IMO-ProofBench-Advanced scores from 23.8% to 39.0% relative to single-agent execution. Across 12 benchmarks, organisations achieve similar average scores at approximately one-third the derived latency of token-matched single-agent execution and just over half that of eight independent attempts followed by selection. The trained model also outperforms Nemotron 3 Super, post-trained from the same base model, across all evaluations when comparing each model's best tested configuration. On EdgeBench, organisations overtake the single agent after approximately 0.4 derived hours. Over the course of training, organisations develop hierarchies to manage communication costs, invest more in peer review, and alter how work is divided. Safety evaluations find near-universal refusal of harmful actions but sustained declines in external reporting in two of three oversight scenarios. These results establish a shared-advantage baseline for studying organisational learning, performance-latency trade-offs, and collective oversight.
items.abstract_zh: 我们引入从集体奖励中进行强化学习（RLCR），这是一种在延迟约束下联合训练语言模型作为智能体组织的配方。一名CEO和最多八名专家共享一个策略，通过留言板和工作区协调，并使用共同的结果推导优势进行训练。截止时间使并行工作有价值，当它增加在截止前获得的回报时。我们在147个环境中训练Avalon-M1-Mini（120B）。对于训练后的模型，雇佣八名专家的组织执行相对于单智能体执行将IMO-ProofBench-Advanced分数从23.8%提高到39.0%。在12个基准上，组织以约为token匹配的单智能体执行三分之一、以及八次独立尝试后选择的一半略多的折算延迟，取得相似的平均分数。在比较每个模型最佳测试配置时，训练后的模型在所有评估中也优于从同一基础模型后训练的Nemotron 3 Super。在EdgeBench上，组织在约0.4折算小时后超过单智能体。在训练过程中，组织发展出层级以管理通信成本，增加对同行评审的投入，并改变工作划分方式。安全评估发现对有害行动几乎普遍拒绝，但在三种监督场景中的两种中，外部报告持续下降。这些结果为研究组织学习、性能-延迟权衡和集体监督建立了共享优势基线。

items.title_en: MRCT: An Object-Centric Two-Layer Control Architecture for Heavy-Payload Multi-Robot Transportation
items.title_zh: MRCT：一种面向重载多机器人运输的以物体为中心的两层控制架构
items.abstract_en: Cooperative transportation of heavy payloads by heterogeneous mobile manipulators requires coordinated payload motion, force distribution, and compliant physical interaction. This paper presents MRCT, an object-centric two-layer control architecture for multi-robot transportation. At the object level, a model predictive controller (MPC) generates a coordinated contact-force reference for the payload. At the robot level, whole- body impedance control (WBIC) modules on individual robots realise the reference through a confidence-based blending of velocity-tracking and impedance torques. The blending mechanism emphasises tracking when the joint-velocity error is small and increases compliance when tracking degrades because of abrupt reference changes or physical disturbances. Simulation and hardware experiments with a heterogeneous team comprising a single-arm and a dual-arm mobile manipulator transporting a near-rated table payload demonstrate accurate object tracking, regulated contact forces, and stable payload orientation. Parameter sensitivity studies, obstacle-avoidance transportation, and step-load disturbance experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of MRCT for reliable cooperative transportation under the evaluated conditions
items.abstract_zh: 异构移动操作机器人对重载物体进行协同运输，需要协调的物体运动、力分配以及柔顺的物理交互。本文提出 MRCT，一种用于多机器人运输的以物体为中心的两层控制架构。在物体层，模型预测控制器（MPC）为物体生成协调的接触力参考。在机器人层，各机器人上的全身阻抗控制（WBIC）模块通过基于置信度的速度跟踪与阻抗力矩融合来实现该参考。该融合机制在关节速度误差较小时强调跟踪，并在因参考突变或物理扰动导致跟踪性能下降时增加柔顺性。使用由一个单臂和一个双臂移动操作机器人组成的异构团队运输接近额定负载的桌子物体的仿真与硬件实验表明，其具有准确的对象跟踪、受调节的接触力和稳定的物体姿态。参数敏感性研究、避障运输和阶跃负载扰动实验进一步证明了 MRCT 在所评估条件下实现可靠协同运输的有效性。

items.title_en: PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement
items.title_zh: PartAgent：通过专家集成和闭环细化实现的智能体式3D部件分割
items.abstract_en: Segmenting a 3D object into semantically meaningful parts requires joint reasoning about geometric structure and semantic context. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. The challenge is to integrate these complementary capabilities into a framework that can both produce meaningful part segmentations and progressively refine them. We present PartAgent, a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation built upon two complementary modules: (i) Structural-Semantic Expert Integration combines regions predicted by the 3D expert with multiview semantic evidence from the 2D expert through image-to-surface correspondences, constructing compositional part partitions at multiple granularities. (ii) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement observes the current partition and its supporting evidence to select targeted inspection, evidence repair, composition, or reselection actions. It verifies proposed changes and uses the updated state and action outcomes to guide subsequent decisions. On PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent achieves 68.41 mIoU, outperforming the strongest competing method by 8.53 points. Across 3DCoMPaT200, PartNeXt, PartNetE, and PartObjaverse-Tiny, PartAgent achieves the highest mIoU on each dataset, averaging 69.36 across the four datasets, 7.28 points above the highest mean among competing methods.
items.abstract_zh: 将三维物体分割为语义上有意义的部件，需要对几何结构和语义上下文进行联合推理。预训练的三维专家提供具有空间定位的区域提议，而二维专家提供用于识别物体部件的语义线索。挑战在于将这些互补能力集成到一个既能产生有意义的部件分割又能逐步细化它们的框架中。我们提出 PartAgent，一个免训练、基于智能体的三维部件分割框架，建立在两个互补模块之上：(i) 结构-语义专家集成通过图像到表面对应关系，将三维专家预测的区域与来自二维专家的多视图语义证据相结合，构建多粒度的组合式部件划分。(ii) 观测驱动的闭环划分细化观察当前划分及其支持证据，以选择有针对性的检查、证据修复、组合或重新选择动作。它验证所提出的更改，并使用更新后的状态和动作结果来指导后续决策。在 PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT 上，PartAgent 达到 68.41 mIoU，比最强的竞争方法高出 8.53 个点。在 3DCoMPaT200、PartNeXt、PartNetE 和 PartObjaverse-Tiny 上，PartAgent 在每个数据集上均取得最高 mIoU，四个数据集的平均值为 69.36，比竞争方法中的最高平均值高 7.28 个点。

items.title_en: Evolutionary constraints on protein fold diversity
items.title_zh: 蛋白质折叠多样性的进化约束
items.abstract_en: Arrangements of secondary structures in proteins yield a wide variety of possible topologies, yet the protein folds observed in nature are limited in their diversity. Is the number of protein folds limited by biophysical constraints or by evolutionary contingency? In recent years, the development of new methods for protein structure prediction and comparison, molecular design, and the rapid progress of cryo-electron microscopy revealed new insights into the protein fold space. Here, we present recent findings demonstrating that natural proteins adopt only a small fraction of all possible folds and discuss how evolutionary processes limit the diversity of evolving protein folds.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质中二级结构的排列会产生多种可能的拓扑结构，然而自然界中观察到的蛋白质折叠在多样性上是有限的。蛋白质折叠的数量是受生物物理约束限制还是受进化偶然性限制？近年来，蛋白质结构预测与比较、分子设计新方法的发展，以及冷冻电子显微镜的快速进展，为蛋白质折叠空间带来了新的见解。在此，我们介绍近期发现，这些发现表明天然蛋白质仅采用所有可能折叠中的一小部分，并讨论进化过程如何限制演化中的蛋白质折叠多样性。

items.title_en: Domain advantage in two-dimensional quantum-device design with multi-modal agentic harness
items.title_zh: 多模态智能体执行框架在二维量子器件设计中的领域优势
items.abstract_en: High-quality two-dimensional quantum devices are commonly fabricated from mechanically exfoliated crystals, whose irregular shapes and placement require a lithographic layout tailored to each specimen. Drawing these layouts remains largely manual. We introduce qlaybench, a benchmark that tests whether language-model agents can turn microscope images and experimental requirements into device layouts that fit the specimen. Agents with conventional tools often construct devices when material outlines are supplied, but struggle to identify those outlines from images. Modelled on the human workflow, qlaybot, a multimodal agentic harness, connects image interpretation to the tools used to align images, draw device features and inspect the resulting layout. We evaluate each layout with checks drawn from practical design experience, asking whether it fits the specimen and connects its intended components. With greater computational effort, an agent using qlaybot passes 81.5% of the benchmark tasks, compared with 24.1% when it uses conventional tools. This domain advantage highlights the importance of connecting scientific interpretation of a specimen to geometric design and provides a route towards reducing manual effort in two-dimensional quantum-device fabrication.
items.abstract_zh: 高质量二维量子器件通常由机械剥离晶体制备，其不规则形状和放置位置要求为每个样品定制光刻布局。绘制这些布局在很大程度上仍是手工完成。我们引入 qlaybench，一个基准，用于测试语言模型智能体能否将显微镜图像和实验要求转化为适合样品的器件布局。使用传统工具的智能体在提供材料轮廓时通常能构建设备，但难以从图像中识别这些轮廓。受人类工作流程启发，qlaybot 是一个多模态智能体执行框架，将图像解释与用于对齐图像、绘制器件特征和检查所得布局的工具连接起来。我们使用来自实际设计经验的检查项评估每个布局，询问其是否适合样品并连接其预期组件。在更大的计算投入下，使用 qlaybot 的智能体通过了 81.5% 的基准任务，而使用传统工具时为 24.1%。这一领域优势凸显了将样品的科学解释与几何设计连接起来的重要性，并为减少二维量子器件制造中的手工工作提供了一条途径。

items.title_en: PHM-ensemble: Scalable and Stable Probabilistic Multiresolution Clustering via Ensemble Density Estimation
items.title_zh: PHM-ensemble：通过集成密度估计实现可扩展且稳定的概率多分辨率聚类
items.abstract_en: Clustering is a foundational tool for exploratory data analysis across the sciences. We argue that clustering methods should be evaluated along four dimensions: fidelity to the data's underlying structure, interpretability of the recovered groups, stability under data perturbations and algorithmic randomness, and scalability to modern scientific datasets. Yet existing methods rarely satisfy all four criteria. To address this gap, we introduce PHM-ensemble, a general probabilistic framework for multiresolution clustering that estimates the underlying data density by pooling mixture models from an ensemble of fits and subsequently constructs a clustering hierarchy through hierarchical merging of the mixture components. On simulated datasets and the MNIST benchmark, PHM-ensemble matches or outperforms widely used clustering algorithms in agreement with ground truth, produces more stable results across runs, and reveals complex underlying structures. Applied to 1.82 million peripheral blood cells from the Human Immune Health Atlas, PHM-ensemble achieves higher agreement with expert-curated major cell-type annotations than the Leiden clustering used in the original study (adjusted Rand index 0.965 versus 0.789), while requiring only half the computing time. Beyond identifying major immune lineages, it reveals biologically coherent relationships among cell types and resolves finer structure within individual lineages, uncovering subtypes and cellular states consistent with known biology.
items.abstract_zh: 聚类是跨科学领域探索性数据分析的基础工具。我们认为，聚类方法应沿四个维度进行评估：对数据底层结构的保真度、所恢复群体的可解释性、在数据扰动和算法随机性下的稳定性，以及对现代科学数据集的可扩展性。然而现有方法很少同时满足这四个标准。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 PHM-ensemble，一个用于多分辨率聚类的通用概率框架，它通过汇集来自一组拟合的混合模型来估计底层数据密度，随后通过混合成分的层次合并构建聚类层次结构。在模拟数据集和 MNIST 基准上，PHM-ensemble 在与真实标签的一致性方面匹配或优于广泛使用的聚类算法，在多次运行中产生更稳定的结果，并揭示复杂的底层结构。应用于 Human Immune Health Atlas 中的 182 万个外周血细胞时，PHM-ensemble 与专家整理的主要细胞类型注释的一致性高于原研究使用的 Leiden 聚类（调整兰德指数 0.965 对 0.789），而所需计算时间仅为其一半。除了识别主要免疫谱系外，它还揭示细胞类型之间生物学上连贯的关系，并解析单个谱系内的更精细结构，发现与已知生物学一致的亚型和细胞状态。

items.title_en: ArabFake: A multitask deep learning framework for Arabic fake news Detection, Categorization, and risk prediction
items.title_zh: ArabFake：用于阿拉伯语假新闻检测、分类和风险预测的多任务深度学习框架
items.abstract_en: The spread of fake news among Arabic media including social media represents a great challenge to the integrity of information and the trust of the public in it. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive deep-learning framework, named ArabFake, that goes beyond the binary classification on Arabic fake news detection. ArabFake, built over MARBERTv2 (a state-of-the-art model for multi-dialectal Arabic tweets), proficiently address the complexity of the Arabic language while performing three unified tasks which are fake news detection, content categorization and its risk assessment. The framework promotes efficiency and performance both by enabling multi-task learning through shared knowledge representation across tasks. In order to facilitate development and evaluation, we present the ArabFake Dataset consisting of 2,495 manually labelled news items with labels that are verified by experts regarding fake news categories and risk levels. ArabFake demonstrates robust performance, achieving an F1 score of 94.12% for fake news detection, 84.92% for categorization, and 88.91% for risk zone assessment, highlighting its reliability and effectiveness across multiple tasks. We improve interpretability and extract insight into manipulative techniques by integrating valence scoring as part of the framework that emphasizes misleading linguistic cues used to disseminate fake news within the produced image. The results show that ArabFake is a holistic Arabic fake news detection framework that has practical implications on news organizations and fact checking projects.
items.abstract_zh: 假新闻在包括社交媒体在内的阿拉伯语媒体中传播，对信息完整性以及公众对信息的信任构成重大挑战。本文介绍一个全面的深度学习框架 ArabFake，它超越了阿拉伯语假新闻检测中的二分类。ArabFake 构建在 MARBERTv2（一种面向多方言阿拉伯语推文的最先进模型）之上，在执行假新闻检测、内容分类及其风险评估这三项统一任务时，能够有效应对阿拉伯语的复杂性。该框架通过跨任务共享知识表示来实现多任务学习，从而同时提升效率和性能。为便于开发与评估，我们提出 ArabFake 数据集，包含 2,495 条人工标注的新闻项，其假新闻类别和风险等级标签由专家核验。ArabFake 展现出稳健性能，假新闻检测的 F1 分数为 94.12%，分类为 84.92%，风险区域评估为 88.91%，突显了其在多个任务上的可靠性和有效性。我们通过将效价评分集成到框架中，提高了可解释性并提取对操纵技术的洞察，该评分强调在生成的图像中用于传播假新闻的误导性语言线索。结果表明，ArabFake 是一个整体性的阿拉伯语假新闻检测框架，对新闻组织和事实核查项目具有实际意义。

items.title_en: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
items.title_zh: ReWeave：面向具身执行框架优化与跨任务元蒸馏的新兴物理任务拓扑
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups ($0.34\times$ full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning. ReWeave improves held-out success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and from 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo, while uncovering retained progress in 89% of 159 failed RoboDojo development trials and translating stronger offline reasoning into higher online performance. On eight unseen LIBERO-PRO tasks, the shared harness reaches 51.3% success versus 41.3% for direct distillation, rising to 75.0% after continual learning.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程具身任务涉及可能只有通过交互才能明确的物理依赖关系。随着任务理解加深，过去的试验可以揭示用于适应和迁移的新信息。然而，粗粒度进展反馈无法识别哪些物理前提条件成立，使搜索缺乏引导；而任务特定优化容易过拟合到单个场景，使跨任务迁移变得脆弱。我们提出ReWeave，一个在不更新策略权重的情况下，从交互中联合优化具身智能体执行框架和新兴物理任务拓扑的框架。在保持执行策略和感知冻结的情况下，ReWeave协同优化耦合上下文、工作流和控制循环。当新证据修正拓扑时，ReWeave将过去的试验重新投影到更新后的任务理解上，揭示保留的进展、回退和瓶颈，以指导父代选择和搜索宽度。跨任务时，将已验证的局部机制与未满足的前提条件匹配，将72个专家单元整合为44个可复用组（为完全拼接的0.34×），并纳入一个能够持续学习的紧凑共享执行框架。ReWeave在LIBERO-PRO上将留出成功率从89.00%提高到98.75%，在RoboDojo上从25.50%提高到58.25%，同时在159次失败的RoboDojo开发试验中，有89%揭示了保留的进展，并将更强的离线推理转化为更高的在线性能。在八个未见过的LIBERO-PRO任务上，共享执行框架达到51.3%成功率，而直接蒸馏为41.3%，在持续学习后升至75.0%。

items.title_en: E-MAPS: Event-Based Promptable Video Segmentation with Memory-as-Prompt
items.title_zh: E-MAPS：基于事件的、以记忆为提示的可提示视频分割
items.abstract_en: RGB-based video object segmentation (VOS) remains brittle under fast motion and adverse illumination. Event cameras preserve signal under blur and challenging exposure, but provide little evidence when motion slows. Interaction can restore object state for subsequent propagation, yet promptable event methods merely address single windows. We formalize event-based Promptable Video Segmentation (ePVS), where prompts at arbitrary windows initialize, correct, or introduce objects and predictions. We present Event Memory-As-Prompt Segmentation (E-MAPS), which transfers a pretrained promptable segmenter to event streams and learns propagation and correction. Event-to-Token (E2T) aligns recurrent event features with pretrained representations while preserving prompt-conditioning priors. Memory-Aware Prompting (MAP) converts object-conditioned history into sparse prompts, allowing memory and user inputs to share one decoder pathway efficiently. We construct Event-View Masklets (EViM) from 206K aligned RGB-event pairs and 620K masks for two-stage representation transfer and native event-video learning, and establish three training-disjoint benchmarks. E-MAPS leads prompt-once and interactive ePVS across all three benchmarks while being more efficient. It further demonstrates strong performance on zero-shot object tracking benchmarks. Project page: https://github.com/adonaydem/emaps-wacv
items.abstract_zh: 基于 RGB 的视频对象分割（VOS）在快速运动和不利光照下仍然脆弱。事件相机在模糊和具有挑战性的曝光下能够保留信号，但在运动变慢时提供的证据很少。交互可以为后续传播恢复对象状态，然而可提示的事件方法仅处理单个窗口。我们将基于事件的可提示视频分割（ePVS）形式化，其中任意窗口处的提示可以初始化、纠正或引入对象和预测。我们提出事件记忆作为提示的分割（Event Memory-As-Prompt Segmentation，E-MAPS），它将预训练的可提示分割器迁移到事件流，并学习传播和纠正。事件到令牌（Event-to-Token，E2T）将循环事件特征与预训练表示对齐，同时保留提示条件先验。记忆感知提示（Memory-Aware Prompting，MAP）将对象条件历史转换为稀疏提示，使记忆和用户输入能够高效地共享一个解码器通路。我们利用 206K 对齐的 RGB-事件对和 620K 掩码构建事件视图掩码片段（Event-View Masklets，EViM），用于两阶段表示迁移和原生事件视频学习，并建立了三个训练不相交的基准。E-MAPS 在所有三个基准上领先于一次性提示和交互式 ePVS，同时更高效。它进一步在零样本对象跟踪基准上展现出强大性能。项目页面：https://github.com/adonaydem/emaps-wacv

items.title_en: Lattice models of chiral random motion: A short review
items.title_zh: 手性随机运动的格点模型：简要综述
items.abstract_en: Chirality, a systematic rotational bias, is ubiquitous in many random motion patterns, from bacteria cells, that swim in circles near surfaces and spinning colloids, to charged particles diffusing under the influence of magnetic fields. In two dimensions, chirality renders random transport \textit{odd}: the diffusion tensor acquires an antisymmetric part that leaves the mean-squared displacement invariant but modifies fluxes and boundary currents. Lattice models for random motion are a natural setting to study chirality, since they are exactly solvable, connect directly to heterogeneous media, cellular automata, and programmable robots, and in discrete time admit fully chiral limits with a localised bulk and edge transport. Lattice walks with a rotational bias have been introduced in different communities several times since 1960, yet without a common language or conceptual connection between them. Here we review these models from the perspective that on the lattice, chirality requires memory. Taking the recently introduced chiral random walk model as a template, we describe the walker with an internal degree of freedom. With a chiral biased updating rule, the full diffusion tensor of this chiral walker turns odd. Within this picture, we can unite persistent and chiral walks, run-and-tumble motion, and cyclic random motions in one framework. We discuss how the memory is followed into the environment; in Lorentz lattice gases, kinetic and rotor walks, and random odd environments; and into the path; in spiral self-avoiding walks.
items.abstract_zh: 手性是一种系统性旋转偏置，普遍存在于许多随机运动模式中，从在表面附近绕圈游动的细菌细胞和旋转胶体，到在磁场影响下扩散的带电粒子。在二维中，手性使随机输运呈现奇性（odd）：扩散张量获得一个反对称部分，该部分保持均方位移不变，但改变通量和边界流。随机运动的格点模型是研究手性的自然框架，因为它们可精确求解，直接联系到非均匀介质、元胞自动机和可编程机器人，并且在离散时间中允许具有局域体输运和边缘输运的完全手性极限。自1960年以来，不同领域多次引入具有旋转偏置的格点行走，但彼此之间缺乏共同语言或概念联系。本文从“在格点上，手性需要记忆”的视角综述这些模型。以最近引入的手性随机行走模型为模板，我们用内部自由度描述行走者。在手性偏置更新规则下，该手性行走者的完整扩散张量变为奇性。在此图景中，我们可以将持久行走与手性行走、run-and-tumble 运动以及循环随机运动统一在一个框架内。我们讨论记忆如何被追踪到环境中：在洛伦兹格点气体、动力学行走和转子行走以及随机奇性环境中；以及追踪到路径中：在螺旋自回避行走中。

items.title_en: Non unitary and nonlinear quantum generative large model design and fast large-scale training without back propagation
items.title_zh: 非酉与非线性量子生成大模型设计及无需反向传播的快速大规模训练
items.abstract_en: Transformer-based large models require huge computational and storage costs. Quantum computation is expected to address that due to its potential to speed up classical algorithms exponentially. Key challenges of implementing quantum large models include the linear, unitary nature of qubit evolutions contrast with the non-unitary matrices and nonlinear functions in classical Transformers, as well as the difficulty of implementing gradient back-propagation on quantum hardware. Here we propose a fully quantum large model containing all the Transformer layers, implementing the non-unitary transformations through SVD-decomposition-based quantum circuits, and approximated nonlinear activation functions through pre-trained parameterized quantum circuits. We also propose a quantum circuit training algorithm based on multi-agent Reinforcement Learning, which can train large-scale parameterized quantum circuits without back-propagation. The dependency between the inference time complexity and the model's hidden dimension has been reduced from polynomial to logarithmic, showing an exponential advantage. The inference executions on the quantum hardware verify our model's 300-1000 times speed-up, and the measurements on the sequence-to-sequence tasks shows its learning ability. The training algorithm achieves only 25% complexity of the best SOTA quantum circuit training algorithms, especially this ratio decreases fast as the parameter scale increases. Our work not only proposes a quantum large model that can significantly reduce the computational cost, but also promotes the quantum computation towards general computing.
items.abstract_zh: 基于Transformer的大模型需要巨大的计算和存储成本。量子计算有望通过指数级加速经典算法的潜力来解决这一问题。实现量子大模型的关键挑战包括：量子比特演化的线性、酉性质与经典Transformer中的非酉矩阵和非线性函数形成对比，以及在量子硬件上实现梯度反向传播的困难。在此，我们提出一种包含所有Transformer层的全量子大模型，通过基于SVD分解的量子电路实现非酉变换，并通过预训练的参数化量子电路近似非线性激活函数。我们还提出一种基于多智能体强化学习的量子电路训练算法，可在无需反向传播的情况下训练大规模参数化量子电路。推理时间复杂度与模型隐藏维度之间的依赖关系已从多项式降低到对数，显示出指数优势。在量子硬件上的推理执行验证了我们的模型具有300–1000倍加速，序列到序列任务上的测量显示了其学习能力。该训练算法仅达到最佳SOTA量子电路训练算法复杂度的25%，尤其随着参数规模增加，该比例快速下降。我们的工作不仅提出了一种可显著降低计算成本的量子大模型，也推动了量子计算向通用计算发展。

items.title_en: PtychoFM: A Foundation Model for Ptychographic Imaging
items.title_zh: PtychoFM：用于叠层衍射成像的基础模型
items.abstract_en: Ptychography provides high-resolution lensless imaging across X-ray, electron, and optical microscopy, but reconstructing images from diffraction measurements generally requires computationally intensity iterative phase retrieval. These methods often require experiment-specific analysis, limiting real-time feedback as data acquisition rates increase. Here, we demonstrate PtychoFM, a physics-aware foundation model for ptychographic imaging that combines large-scale pre-training with experiment-specific fine-tuning to reconstruct complex object images directly from individual diffraction patterns. Trained using a differentiable forward model without object-space labels, PtychoFM transfers from step-scan training data on one sample to fly-scan measurements of other samples with different feature sizes, morphologies, and refraction indices. At a synchrotron beamline, diffraction frames were streamed from the detector to a single GPU for inference at up to 200 frames per second and returned for real-time visualization. PtychoFM provides a practical route to rapid, transferable ptychographic reconstruction and live experimental feedback under nonideal conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 叠层衍射成像（ptychography）可在 X 射线、电子和光学显微术中实现高分辨率无透镜成像，但从衍射测量重建图像通常需要计算密集的迭代相位恢复。这些方法往往需要针对具体实验进行分析，随着数据采集速率提高，限制了实时反馈。在此，我们展示 PtychoFM，一个用于叠层衍射成像的物理感知基础模型，它将大规模预训练与针对具体实验的微调相结合，以从单个衍射图案直接重建复杂物体图像。PtychoFM 使用可微分前向模型训练，无需物体空间标签，并能从一个样本的步进扫描训练数据迁移到具有不同特征尺寸、形貌和折射率的其他样本的飞行扫描测量。在同步辐射光束线上，衍射帧从探测器流式传输到单个 GPU 进行推理，速度最高达每秒 200 帧，并返回用于实时可视化。PtychoFM 为在非理想条件下实现快速、可迁移的叠层重建和实时实验反馈提供了一条实用途径。

items.title_en: RightDiff: Learning Generative Reward Models to Judge by the Right Differences
items.title_zh: RightDiff：学习生成式奖励模型以依据正确差异进行评判
items.abstract_en: Generative reward models typically rely on generic query-level rubrics or unconstrained rationales, overlooking the fact that pairwise preference is driven by response-specific differences. Moreover, optimizing solely for outcome correctness encourages models to exploit superficial shortcuts such as verbosity and formatting, triggering rationale drift. To address this, we propose RightDiff, which structures pairwise evaluation into an evidence-grounded evaluation trajectory executed in a single autoregressive generation. RightDiff explicitly discovers contrastive differences between candidates, categorizes them into material or immaterial factors, and induces pair-specific rubrics before final adjudication. To train this process without post-hoc rationalization, we synthesize demonstration data via response-isolated prompts and optimize the reward model with a difference-alignment reward regularized by budget-constrained one-to-one matching and multiplicative gating. RightDiff achieves state-of-the-art preference modeling performance on RewardBench and RM-Bench, surpassing all open-source reward models and leading proprietary LLM judges. Downstream, it provides reliable supervision for direct preference optimization on Arena-Hard and AlpacaEval while effectively resisting length shortcuts.
items.abstract_zh: 生成式奖励模型通常依赖通用的查询级评分标准或无约束的理由，忽视了成对偏好是由响应特定差异驱动的事实。此外，仅针对结果正确性进行优化会促使模型利用冗长和格式等表面捷径，引发理由漂移。为解决这一问题，我们提出 RightDiff，它将成对评估结构化为在单次自回归生成中执行的、基于证据的评估轨迹。RightDiff 显式发现候选之间的对比差异，将其归类为实质性或非实质性因素，并在最终裁决前归纳出针对特定对的评分标准。为了在没有事后合理化的情况下训练这一过程，我们通过响应隔离提示合成演示数据，并使用由预算约束的一对一匹配和乘法门控正则化的差异对齐奖励来优化奖励模型。RightDiff 在 RewardBench 和 RM-Bench 上取得了最先进的偏好建模性能，超越所有开源奖励模型和领先的专有 LLM 评判器。在下游，它为 Arena-Hard 和 AlpacaEval 上的直接偏好优化提供可靠监督，同时有效抵抗长度捷径。

items.title_en: AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
items.title_zh: AXE：AlpaSim端到端闭环挑战技术报告
items.abstract_en: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告介绍了一个用于Physical AI AV Track的端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型开发的完整流水线。该框架包括数据整理、HD地图自动标注、数据驱动的模仿学习和基于模拟器的强化学习。为确保闭环环境中的安全性，我们引入一种基于选择的E2E规划方法，利用目标检测和BEV分割来过滤掉可能导致碰撞或偏离道路的轨迹候选。在NVIDIA NuRec和NVIDIA PAI-AV数据集上训练，我们的方法对固定词汇表的轨迹候选在碰撞、可行驶区域合规性和从模拟推演中学习到的进度方面进行评分，并选择通过过滤器的最佳候选。这一设计突显了将E2E规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，对于安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶的有效性。

items.title_en: FewRef-5: Fixed-Reference Test-Time Adaptation for Virtual Staining
items.title_zh: FewRef-5：用于虚拟染色的固定参考测试时自适应
items.abstract_en: Virtual staining synthesizes special-stain images from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), extending the information available from an existing digital slide. However, a fixed inference rule can leave available real target-stain references unused, limiting query-specific correction of stain appearance at deployment. Test-time adaptation (TTA) provides a mechanism for this reference-guided, query-specific refinement without retraining the generator. We therefore propose FewRef-5, a reference-assisted TTA method for virtual staining built on StainPromptInversion. We extract tissue-masked optical-density means and standard deviations from five real Masson's trichrome (MAS) training patches and average them into a fixed stain target. A scheduled statistic-matching loss introduces this target into per-query visual-prompt optimization alongside our edge/Gram consistency penalties and the inherited reconstruction objectives. The target remains unchanged across queries, avoiding recursive dependence on earlier generated outputs while the pretrained generator stays fixed. On recorded H&E-to-MAS outputs for 1,989 queries, FewRef-5 reduces target-set FID from 183.201 to 166.904 and increases source-referenced SSIM from 0.92787 to 0.94996 relative to our Edge+Gram variant. Source PSNR and MS-SSIM decrease, showing an endpoint trade-off rather than uniformly better reconstruction.
items.abstract_zh: 虚拟染色从常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色合成特殊染色图像，扩展了现有数字切片可获得的信息。然而，固定推理规则可能使可用的真实目标染色参考未被使用，限制了部署时针对查询的染色外观校正。测试时自适应（TTA）提供了一种无需重新训练生成器即可进行参考引导、针对查询的细化机制。因此，我们提出 FewRef-5，一种基于 StainPromptInversion 的参考辅助虚拟染色 TTA 方法。我们从五个真实 Masson 三色（MAS）训练图像块中提取组织掩膜后的光密度均值和标准差，并将其平均为固定染色目标。一种按计划安排的统计匹配损失将该目标引入每个查询的视觉提示优化中，同时结合我们的边缘/Gram 一致性惩罚和继承的重建目标。该目标在所有查询间保持不变，避免对先前生成输出的递归依赖，同时预训练生成器保持固定。在 1,989 个查询的已记录 H&E 到 MAS 输出上，相对于我们的 Edge+Gram 变体，FewRef-5 将目标集 FID 从 183.201 降至 166.904，并将源参考 SSIM 从 0.92787 提高至 0.94996。源 PSNR 和 MS-SSIM 下降，表明这是端点权衡，而非重建在所有方面都更好。

items.title_en: Normative and neural network models of multisensory integration
items.title_zh: 多感官整合的规范模型与神经网络模型
items.abstract_en: Animals continuously detect scents, sights and sounds, which their brains combine into diverse multisensory streams. Multisensory integration accelerates learning, increases reaction speeds and helps to resolve sensory ambiguities. In studying this process, the field has developed a continuum of models; from concise mathematical equations, with a handful of variables, to artificial neural networks, with billions of parameters. In this review, we divide this spectrum into two classes: normative models start from a hypothesis about how multisensory signals should be integrated, while neural network models aim to emulate how circuits could integrate them. Together, these models demonstrate that observers can integrate cues in a statistically optimal fashion, and help to explain experimental findings, including the diversity of multisensory neuron response profiles and network architectures. In this review, we provide a didactic overview of multisensory models, complete with accessible equations and Python code, and compare their assumptions and explanatory power. We detail what has been learned from these models. Finally, we discuss how the ideas and insights from classical theoretical models can be reconciled with those from artificial neural networks, and how this convergence should shape future research.
items.abstract_zh: 动物持续检测气味、景象和声音，大脑将它们组合成多样化的多感官流。多感官整合加速学习、提高反应速度，并帮助解决感官歧义。在研究这一过程时，该领域已发展出一系列模型：从仅含少量变量的简洁数学方程，到具有数十亿参数的人工神经网络。在这篇综述中，我们将这一谱系分为两类：规范性模型从关于多感官信号应如何整合的假设出发，而神经网络模型旨在模拟神经回路可能如何整合这些信号。这些模型共同表明，观察者能以统计最优方式整合线索，并有助于解释实验发现，包括多感官神经元反应曲线和网络架构的多样性。在这篇综述中，我们提供多感官模型的教学式概述，配有易于理解的方程和 Python 代码，并比较它们的假设和解释力。我们详细说明已从这些模型中学到什么。最后，我们讨论经典理论模型中的思想和洞见如何与人工神经网络中的思想和洞见相协调，以及这种趋同应如何塑造未来研究。

items.title_en: Conceptual Design of a 5 MV High-Voltage System for a Compact Orbitron Fusion Device
items.title_zh: 紧凑型Orbitron聚变装置5 MV高压系统的概念设计
items.abstract_en: The high-voltage system is a key part of the puzzle toward achieving net-positive fusion power in a compact Orbitron device. This paper presents a conceptual engineering design for a 5 MV, 20 mA, 100 kW HV system for a next-generation Orbitron, serving as an upper-bound design point for the HV system. The MC-TRANS++ 0-D code is used to set the load requirements: a 1 m long, 0.45 m first-wall-radius central cell, 2.5 T on-axis and 10 T mirror-throat fields, and a 5 MV radial potential drop sustaining supersonic rotation ($M = 4.8$). This delivers a triple product of $5.8 \times 10^{21}$ keV s /m3 and $Q_{sci}$ = 8.5. The HV power supply integrates an AC-DC converter, a SiC full-bridge inverter, a CLLC resonant network with an air-core step-up transformer, and feeds a 120-stage parallel-fed series-cascaded rectifier operating at 250 kHz. At full load, this architecture yields an end-to-end efficiency of 85%, much higher than the 60% typical of triode-driven MV-class power supplies. The 5 MV voltage is delivered to a radially nested 50-gap bushing system that interfaces pressurized insulating gas to high vacuum, using brazed alumina spacers with a corrugated profile. The design draws directly on the measured behavior of a previously demonstrated 300 kV prototype, from which six quantitative lessons are extracted and mapped onto the 5 MV design. Electrostatic simulations of the complete assembly at rated voltage show maximum surface fields of 30.3 MV/m on the corona rings, 7.7 MV/m at the cathode triple junction, and average vacuum-gap fields ranging from 5.5 to 40 MV/m. These field strengths remain below breakdown thresholds due to the implementation of triple-junction shielding, insulation corrugation, and axial magnetic insulation at 2.5-10 T. The conceptual system has a form factor of 2.7 meters in diameter and 6.5 meters in length, projected to deliver a net power output of 86-171 kWe.
items.abstract_zh: 高压系统是紧凑型Orbitron装置实现净正能量聚变功率这一难题的关键部分。本文提出下一代Orbitron的5 MV、20 mA、100 kW高压系统的概念工程设计，作为该高压系统的上限设计点。使用MC-TRANS++零维代码设定负载要求：1 m长、第一壁半径0.45 m的中心室，2.5 T轴上磁场和10 T磁镜喉部磁场，以及维持超声速旋转（$M = 4.8$）的5 MV径向电势降。这给出5.8 × 10^21 keV s/m3的三乘积和$Q_{sci}$ = 8.5。高压电源集成AC-DC变换器、SiC全桥逆变器、带空芯升压变压器的CLLC谐振网络，并为工作在250 kHz的120级并联馈电串联级联整流器供电。在满载下，该架构实现85%的端到端效率，远高于三极管驱动的MV级电源典型的60%。5 MV电压被输送到径向嵌套的50间隙套管系统，该系统将加压绝缘气体与高真空衔接，使用具有波纹轮廓的钎焊氧化铝隔件。该设计直接依据先前已演示的300 kV原型的实测行为，从中提取六项定量经验并映射到5 MV设计。额定电压下完整组件的静电仿真显示：电晕环上的最大表面场强为30.3 MV/m，阴极三结合点处为7.7 MV/m，真空间隙平均场强为5.5至40 MV/m。由于实施了三结合点屏蔽、绝缘波纹化和2.5–10 T轴向磁绝缘，这些场强仍低于击穿阈值。该概念系统的外形尺寸为直径2.7米、长度6.5米，预计可提供86–171 kWe的净功率输出。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: NCPU: Towards Cell-Inspired Spatial Computing
items.title_zh: NCPU：迈向细胞启发的空间计算
items.abstract_en: Simple cellular automata (CAs) can be computationally universal, but their rules are designed by hand. We train Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs), which learn a local update rule by gradient descent, to compute exact digital logic. Bits are encoded as clusters of cells on a 2D grid, and a result reaches the output only by propagating through intermediate cells. One model is trained per task: logic gates, 4- and 8-bit ripple-carry adders, and a preliminary 8-bit arithmetic logic unit (ALU). All gate and adder models reach 100% bit correctness in 10 of 10 seeds, and exhaustive tests over all input pairs find at most 1 error in 256 (4-bit) and 7 in 65,536 (8-bit). Adders trained on operands of up to 3 bits generalize to 8 bits. The adders propagate the carry as a wave, with a delay of about 3.5 steps per bit of the carry chain. Outputs are correct only within the trained rollout length.
items.abstract_zh: 简单的元胞自动机（CA）可以在计算上通用，但其规则是手工设计的。我们训练神经元胞自动机（NCA），其通过梯度下降学习局部更新规则，以计算精确的数字逻辑。比特被编码为二维网格上的细胞簇，结果仅通过中间细胞传播到达输出。每个任务训练一个模型：逻辑门、4 位和 8 位行波进位加法器，以及一个初步的 8 位算术逻辑单元（ALU）。所有门和加法器模型在 10/10 个随机种子中达到 100% 比特正确率，对所有输入对进行穷举测试发现，最多在 256 个（4 位）中有 1 个错误，在 65,536 个（8 位）中有 7 个错误。在最多 3 位操作数上训练的加法器可泛化到 8 位。加法器以波的形式传播进位，进位链每比特约延迟 3.5 步。输出仅在训练时的展开长度内正确。

items.title_en: TACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents
items.title_zh: TACT-Bench：测试针对工具使用智能体的自适应对话威胁
items.abstract_en: The growing autonomy of AI agents in using external tools and making decisions has created an urgent need for comprehensive safety benchmarks. Existing benchmarks test compromised tool channels or adaptive multi-turn attacks, though they may not capture the unique capabilities of policy-governed tool-use agents, which must resist unauthorized requests without abandoning the legitimate work embedded in the same interaction. To fill this gap, we introduce TACT-Bench, a stateful benchmark built around scenario-specific stories, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation. Each adversarial task targets an action explicitly prohibited by the policy provided to the assistant, while the policy remains hidden from the attacking user. TACT pairs each adversarial task with at least one benign counterpart, and its adversarial tasks retain authorized ground-truth actions when a compliant resolution remains available. We define these base tasks as TACT-Base. We additionally introduce TACT-TrustPrime, which places an independent benign task before an unrelated attack in the same conversation. We also propose Paired Selective Trustworthiness (PST), which combines explicit safe refusal with demonstrated capability on matched benign tasks, to analyze an agent's overcautiousness and practicality. Averaged across 6 different models as assistants, TACT-Base raises Attack-Induced Failure Rate (AFR) by 17.53% over four compatible attack baselines, and TACT-TrustPrime raises it by a further 17.01%. The two evaluated defense methods reduce AFR by only 8.35%--9.41% on average and do not consistently improve PST, underscoring the need for stronger policy-enforcement methods.
items.abstract_zh: AI 智能体在使用外部工具和做出决策方面的自主性不断增强，这迫切需要全面的安全基准。现有基准测试被攻陷的工具通道或自适应多轮攻击，但它们可能无法捕捉受策略约束的工具使用智能体的独特能力，这类智能体必须在不放弃同一交互中嵌入的合法工作的前提下抵御未授权请求。为填补这一空白，我们提出 TACT-Bench，一个围绕场景特定故事、人物设定、操纵策略和响应自适应升级构建的有状态基准。每个对抗任务都针对助手所获策略明确禁止的动作，同时该策略对攻击用户保持隐藏。TACT 为每个对抗任务配对至少一个良性对应任务，并且其对抗任务在仍存在合规解决方案时保留授权的真实动作。我们将这些基础任务定义为 TACT-Base。我们还引入 TACT-TrustPrime，它在同一对话中把一个独立的良性任务置于一个无关攻击之前。我们还提出配对选择性可信度（Paired Selective Trustworthiness, PST），它将明确的安全拒绝与在匹配良性任务上展示的能力相结合，以分析智能体的过度谨慎和实用性。在 6 个不同模型作为助手的平均结果中，TACT-Base 相比四个兼容攻击基线将攻击诱导失败率（Attack-Induced Failure Rate, AFR）提高了 17.53%，TACT-TrustPrime 进一步将其提高 17.01%。两种评估的防御方法平均仅将 AFR 降低 8.35%--9.41%，并且不能持续改善 PST，这凸显了对更强策略执行方法的需求。

items.title_en: ROSE-Drive: Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution for Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: ROSE-Drive：自动驾驶的运行时编排与系统演化
items.abstract_en: End-to-end driving models have made substantial progress, yet reliable closed-loop driving in complex traffic remains challenging. Beyond improving individual models, system-level orchestration offers a complementary approach by coordinating driving capabilities and computation. We introduce ROSE-Drive (Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution), a model-agnostic framework that jointly orchestrates driving execution and computation. It coordinates frozen driving models with driving skills, perception tools, and feedback controllers. A distilled vision-language model (VLM) proposes driving tasks and scene relations. Shared physical state and persistent tasks support capability composition, task continuity, and adaptive scheduling. The orchestrator combines model and skill outputs across control channels, maintains task responsibility through handover, and uses execution feedback to select controllers, reuse valid motion references, and schedule model inference. Offline revisions use execution records to refine skills and their coordination through a stable task interface. Successive system stages inherit these revisions while model, perception, and VLM weights remain fixed. Evaluations with four driving models on Bench2Drive v0.0.3, Bench2Drive v0.0.4, and Fail2Drive show accumulated capability and transfer before target-benchmark revision. On held-out Longest6, driving score (DS) rises from 25 to 52 for AutoMoT and from 22 to 47 for SimLingo across system stages, while both systems skip new model inference on over 71% of control steps.
items.abstract_zh: 端到端驾驶模型已取得实质性进展，但在复杂交通中实现可靠的闭环驾驶仍然具有挑战性。除了改进单个模型之外，系统级编排通过协调驾驶能力与计算提供了一种互补方法。我们提出 ROSE-Drive（Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution），一个模型无关框架，联合编排驾驶执行与计算。它协调冻结的驾驶模型与驾驶技能、感知工具和反馈控制器。一个蒸馏的视觉-语言模型（VLM）提出驾驶任务和场景关系。共享物理状态和持久任务支持能力组合、任务连续性和自适应调度。编排器跨控制通道组合模型和技能输出，通过交接维持任务责任，并利用执行反馈选择控制器、复用有效运动参考并调度模型推理。离线修订利用执行记录，通过稳定任务接口改进技能及其协调。连续的系统阶段继承这些修订，而模型、感知和 VLM 权重保持固定。在 Bench2Drive v0.0.3、Bench2Drive v0.0.4 和 Fail2Drive 上使用四个驾驶模型进行评估，显示在目标基准修订前具有累积能力和迁移。在留出的 Longest6 上，跨系统阶段，AutoMoT 的驾驶分数（DS）从 25 升至 52，SimLingo 从 22 升至 47，同时两个系统在超过 71% 的控制步骤上跳过新模型推理。

items.title_en: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
items.title_zh: 通过互信息最大化进行自监督数据集蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.
items.abstract_zh: 数据集蒸馏（DD）旨在将大型数据集压缩为小型合成数据集，且该合成数据集仍能有效用于训练神经网络。尽管在监督学习中取得了成功，DD在自监督学习（SSL）中仍研究不足；在SSL中，蒸馏数据必须保留学习在数据增强下保持一致的表示所需的信息。为弥合这一差距，我们提出互信息原型对齐（MIPA），一种高效的SSL数据集蒸馏方法，它优化合成图像以保留增强不变信息。具体而言，MIPA将合成图像视为可学习原型，并使用冻结编码器根据特征相似度将真实样本分配给这些原型。一个保留这种增强不变性的合成数据集，应在同一真实图像的多个增强视图上产生稳定的原型分配。MIPA通过最大化跨视图分配之间的互信息来鼓励这一点，同时避免所有真实样本仅被分配给少数合成原型的平凡解。在图像分类基准上的评估表明，MIPA生成的合成数据比现有蒸馏方法产生更高质量的表示，同时减少蒸馏过程中的时间和存储需求。

items.title_en: Network topology imposes spectral constraints on collective nonequilibrium responses
items.title_zh: 网络拓扑对集体非平衡响应施加谱约束
items.abstract_en: Collective nonequilibrium dynamics in Langevin systems depend on both network topology and stochastic driving. Understanding the role of topology in responses to stochastic driving and in the emergence of nonequilibrium is essential. Starting from the principle of microscopic reversibility and linear Langevin dynamics on networks, we derive a mode decomposition for both the asymmetry of short-time cross-correlations and heat currents at steady state. This decomposition reveals two sources of nonequilibrium---fluctuations of individual modes and correlated fluctuations between distinct modes. For reciprocal networks with independent local driving, we derive two nonequilibrium response operators that yield explicit expressions for the global asymmetry intensity and the entropy production rate. These operators are weighted Laplacians independent of stochastic driving. Their spectra determine attainable upper and lower bounds on nonequilibrium at fixed driving heterogeneity. These bounds are exact for asymmetry intensity at arbitrary deviations from equilibrium and hold to leading order near equilibrium for entropy production rate. Finally, we find that the hierarchical modular organization of human structural connectomes broadens the brain's nonequilibrium operating range, with resting-state brain activity supporting this topological advantage for sustaining a lower nonequilibrium level. Our study provides a basis for understanding biological network organization and designing networks with targeted nonequilibrium operating points.
items.abstract_zh: Langevin 系统中的集体非平衡动力学既依赖于网络拓扑，也依赖于随机驱动。理解拓扑在随机驱动响应以及非平衡出现中的作用至关重要。我们从微观可逆性原理和网络上的线性 Langevin 动力学出发，推导出短时互相关不对称性和稳态热流的模式分解。该分解揭示了非平衡的两个来源——单个模式的涨落以及不同模式之间的相关涨落。对于具有独立局部驱动的互易网络，我们推导出两个非平衡响应算子，它们给出全局不对称强度和熵产生率的显式表达式。这些算子是与随机驱动无关的加权 Laplacian。在固定驱动异质性下，它们的谱决定非平衡可达到的上界和下界。这些界对于任意偏离平衡时的不对称强度是精确的，并且对于熵产生率在平衡附近至主导阶成立。最后，我们发现人类结构连接组的分层模块化组织拓宽了大脑的非平衡运行范围，而静息态大脑活动支持这种拓扑优势以维持较低的非平衡水平。我们的研究为理解生物网络组织和设计具有目标非平衡工作点的网络提供了基础。

items.title_en: Robust growth of $α$-tantalum on sapphire at room temperature using atomically thin titanium seed layer
items.title_zh: 使用原子级薄钛种子层在室温下在蓝宝石上稳健生长 α-钽
items.abstract_en: Tantalum (Ta) based superconducting circuits have attracted attention for their low microwave loss. However, reproducible growth of high-quality $α$-phase Ta films remains challenging because film properties are highly sensitive to growth conditions. We present a robust, room-temperature route for $α$-Ta growth on sapphire substrates using an ultrathin Ti seed layer, which significantly widens the accessible deposition parameter space. We compare this approach to Ta films grown at high temperature without a seed layer and at room temperature with a Nb seed. We assess films using structural and surface characterization and quantify microwave loss with coplanar-waveguide (CPW) resonators measured in the quantum regime. We obtain two-level-system (TLS)-limited quality factors comparable to the state of the art for Ta-on-sapphire CPW resonators with similar geometries. In addition, temperature-dependent measurements reveal that high-temperature-grown films and films subjected to extended buffered-oxide etch treatment exhibit additional temperature activated loss, highlighting the role of growth route and post-processing in microwave performance. Our results establish ultrathin seed-layer engineering as a reliable alternative route to reproducible, low-loss $α$-Ta films and motivate closer study of the interfacial mechanisms that govern Ta phase formation.
items.abstract_zh: 基于钽（Ta）的超导电路因其低微波损耗而受到关注。然而，高质量 α 相 Ta 薄膜的可重复生长仍然具有挑战性，因为薄膜特性对生长条件高度敏感。我们提出一种稳健的室温路线，使用超薄 Ti 种子层在蓝宝石衬底上生长 α-Ta，这显著拓宽了可及的沉积参数空间。我们将该方法与在高温下无种子层生长的 Ta 薄膜以及在室温下使用 Nb 种子层生长的 Ta 薄膜进行比较。我们通过结构和表面表征评估薄膜，并用在量子区域测量的共面波导（CPW）谐振器量化微波损耗。我们获得了与类似几何结构的蓝宝石上 Ta CPW 谐振器当前最佳水平相当的两能级系统（TLS）限制的品质因数。此外，温度相关测量表明，高温生长的薄膜和经过延长缓冲氧化物刻蚀处理的薄膜表现出额外的温度激活损耗，突出了生长路线和后处理在微波性能中的作用。我们的结果确立了超薄种子层工程作为一种可靠替代路线，用于可重复、低损耗的 α-Ta 薄膜，并推动对控制 Ta 相形成的界面机制进行更深入研究。

items.title_en: Fractal Neural Synthesis: Constant-Storage Procedural Weight Derivation via Complex Quadratic Boundary Dynamics
items.title_zh: 分形神经合成：通过复二次边界动力学的恒定存储过程化权重推导
items.abstract_en: Conventional neural networks store synaptic parameters as explicit tensors whose persistent Flash footprint scales linearly (O(W)) with parameter count, constraining resource-limited edge microcontrollers. We formulate and systematically evaluate Fractal Neural Synthesis (FNS), a procedural weight derivation architecture that replaces hidden-layer matrices with a constant 24-byte coordinate seed Theta = (c_x, c_y, ell) in F_64^3 anchored near the complex quadratic bifurcation boundary dM of f_c(z) = z^2 + c. We introduce a large-bailout (R = 256) smooth escape kernel, four zero-overhead geometric sampling apertures--Cartesian Grid, coprime 3x3 Rule-of-Thirds (Z/9Z), phi-Vogel spiral, and multi-scale Harmonic Tripod--and prove conditional Kolmogorov (K_Kolm <= 192 + c_0 bits) and Shannon entropy bounds. Across magnifications zeta in [10^0, 10^8], C^1 Fourier and lattice-noise bases collapse to post-standardization rank ~2.25 and SHA-256 PRNG exhibits avalanche discontinuity (rho ~ 0.019, 50.6% micro-step retention), whereas dM uniquely sustains both rank (~10.0) and local continuity (rho in [0.81, 0.97], 89.2% retention). Under leak-free 10-fold CV across four zero-scaler-byte non-linear benchmarks, FNS with an INT8 readout surpasses 0-hidden Linear-INT8 by +3.6 to +10.8 pp while delivering 10.7x-129x total Flash reduction (725x-2,773x hidden reduction) relative to converged Float32 MLPs (90.30% Ionosphere in 285 B; 97.22% Optical Digits in 2,598 B; 97.90% PenDigits in 2,598 B; 87.00% Satimage in 1,570 B).
items.abstract_zh: 传统神经网络将突触参数存储为显式张量，其持久 Flash 占用随参数数量线性增长（O(W)），限制了资源受限的边缘微控制器。我们形式化并系统评估了分形神经合成（Fractal Neural Synthesis, FNS），一种过程化权重推导架构，它用位于 F_64^3 中、锚定在 f_c(z) = z^2 + c 的复二次分岔边界 dM 附近的恒定 24 字节坐标种子 Theta = (c_x, c_y, ell) 替代隐藏层矩阵。我们引入大逃逸阈值（R = 256）的平滑逃逸核、四种零开销几何采样孔径——笛卡尔网格、互质 3×3 三分法（Z/9Z）、phi-Vogel 螺旋以及多尺度谐波三脚架——并证明条件 Kolmogorov 界（K_Kolm <= 192 + c_0 比特）和 Shannon 熵界。在放大倍数 zeta 属于 [10^0, 10^8] 范围内，C^1 Fourier 基和晶格噪声基坍缩到标准化后秩 ~2.25，SHA-256 伪随机数生成器表现出雪崩不连续性（rho ~ 0.019，50.6% 微步保留率），而 dM 独特地同时维持秩（~10.0）和局部连续性（rho 在 [0.81, 0.97] 内，89.2% 保留率）。在四个零缩放器字节非线性基准上的无泄漏 10 折交叉验证下，带有 INT8 读出的 FNS 以 +3.6 至 +10.8 个百分点超越 0 隐藏层 Linear-INT8，同时相对于收敛的 Float32 MLP 实现 10.7 倍至 129 倍的总 Flash 减少（隐藏层减少 725 倍至 2,773 倍）（90.30% Ionosphere，285 B；97.22% Optical Digits，2,598 B；97.90% PenDigits，2,598 B；87.00% Satimage，1,570 B）。

items.title_en: Tablassert: Declarative Extraction of Knowledge Graphs from Biomedical Tables
items.title_zh: Tablassert：从生物医学表格中声明式提取知识图谱
items.abstract_en: Tables published in biomedical research papers, particularly supplemental tables, capture knowledge assertions that may not be in the main text of the manuscript for several reasons, including low statistical significance, space limitations, and narrative scope. These tables include data (e.g., association statistics, assay readouts, curated gene lists, and omics) encoding relationships between biological entities. Tablassert converts such tabular data (Excel, CSV, TSV, Parquet) into knowledge graphs ready for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator (Fecho et al. 2025). A user declares in YAML how each table's data map to subject-predicate-object-qualifier statements; Tablassert resolves free text (e.g., ''lung cancer'') to standard identifiers, attaches provenance and statistics, and emits graph files conforming to Translator standards (D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022).
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学研究论文中发表的表格，尤其是补充表格，记录了可能因多种原因而未出现在手稿正文中的知识断言，包括统计显著性低、篇幅限制和叙述范围。这些表格包含编码生物实体之间关系的数据（例如关联统计量、测定读数、整理过的基因列表和组学数据）。Tablassert 将此类表格数据（Excel、CSV、TSV、Parquet）转换为可供 NCATS Biomedical Data Translator 使用的知识图谱（Fecho et al. 2025）。用户在 YAML 中声明每个表格的数据如何映射到主语-谓语-宾语-限定符语句；Tablassert 将自由文本（例如“肺癌”）解析为标准标识符，附加来源和统计信息，并输出符合 Translator 标准的图文件（D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022）。

items.title_en: At the Limit: Autonomous Vehicle Drifting under Generative Policies
items.title_zh: 在极限处：生成策略下的自动驾驶车辆漂移
items.abstract_en: Autonomous drifting requires agile control despite tire-force saturation and highly nonlinear vehicle dynamics. We propose an online reinforcement learning method for flow policies that combines stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling for exploration with value-based policy optimization. This method supports both training from scratch and fine-tuning a policy pretrained on expert demonstrations. After training, control actions can be generated using either SDEs or ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Experiments on circular and eight-shaped drifting in an F1TENTH digital twin platform show that both training strategies can achieve effective real-time drift control, with tighter tracking, higher success rates, and better robustness under noisy conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶漂移需要在轮胎力饱和和高度非线性车辆动力学下实现敏捷控制。我们提出一种用于流策略的在线强化学习方法，它将用于探索的随机微分方程（SDE）采样与基于价值的策略优化相结合。该方法既支持从头训练，也支持微调在专家演示上预训练的策略。训练后，可以使用 SDE 或常微分方程（ODE）生成控制动作。在 F1TENTH 数字孪生平台上的圆形和八字形漂移实验表明，两种训练策略都能实现有效的实时漂移控制，并具有更紧的跟踪、更高的成功率以及在噪声条件下更好的鲁棒性。

items.title_en: DualSpec: Spectral Reconstruction with Optimized Stereo Cameras
items.title_zh: DualSpec：使用优化立体相机进行光谱重建
items.abstract_en: Spectral imaging captures information that ordinary RGB sensors cannot, but dedicated spectral cameras can be expensive and bulky. Recovering dense spectra from RGB images offers an accessible alternative, but distinct spectra can produce the same camera response, generating an ambiguity that even more advanced recovery algorithms cannot always resolve. Therefore, increasing the spectral information captured at acquisition is essential. We propose DualSpec, a stereo acquisition framework that jointly optimizes two external optical filters and a reconstruction network. Each filter is placed in front of a standard RGB camera, and the two are designed to produce six responses that provide complementary information for the network. Experiments across reconstruction architectures and spectral ranges show that DualSpec reduces mean spectral angle error by 36-72% relative to a single RGB camera and by 11-29% relative to stereo pairs selected from commercial filters. Cross-dataset evaluations, including a new benchmark of spectral images captured from displaced viewpoints, show that the method generalizes and remains robust to viewpoint misalignment, while analyses of thin-film approximations support optical feasibility.
items.abstract_zh: 光谱成像能够捕获普通RGB传感器无法捕获的信息，但专用光谱相机可能昂贵且笨重。从RGB图像中恢复密集光谱提供了一种易于获得的替代方案，但不同光谱可能产生相同的相机响应，从而产生歧义，即使更先进的恢复算法也无法总能解决。因此，增加采集时捕获的光谱信息至关重要。我们提出DualSpec，一种立体采集框架，联合优化两个外部光学滤光片和一个重建网络。每个滤光片置于标准RGB相机前，二者被设计为产生六种响应，为网络提供互补信息。跨重建架构和光谱范围的实验表明，DualSpec相对于单个RGB相机将平均光谱角误差降低36-72%，相对于从商用滤光片中选择的立体对降低11-29%。跨数据集评估（包括一个由位移视点捕获的光谱图像新基准）表明，该方法具有泛化性，并对视点失配保持稳健，而薄膜近似分析支持光学可行性。
