items.title_en: Rapid, behaviorally timed increases in blood-brain barrier permeability are predicted by endothelial calcium events and driven by histaminergic axons
items.title_zh: 血脑屏障通透性的快速且行为定时的增加由内皮钙事件预测并由组胺能轴突驱动
items.abstract_en: Survival requires a detailed understanding of body state, and the vasculature provides a continuous conduit of this information to the brain. Yet the blood-brain barrier (BBB) is canonically viewed as a stable boundary, and any passage across it as pathological leak, because sustained exposure carries real risk. How the forebrain resolves these competing needs for information versus safety remains unknown. Here we show that the healthy barrier opens briefly and locally at moments when body-state information may be worth the risk. Using two-photon imaging of an intravascular dextran in the somatosensory neocortex of mice performing a cued reward task, we identified Plume Events: transient, focal increases in permeability at penetrating arterioles that were locked to the cue and reward, persisted on trials without detectable dilation, and shifted earlier with training. Endothelial calcium events preceded and predicted Plume Events within seconds and within 15 micrometers of the vessel wall. Histaminergic axons from the tuberomammillary nucleus were active before Plume Events, and their optogenetic stimulation drove Plume Events that waned across repeated trains while dilation persisted. Together, these findings reframe the blood-brain barrier as a dynamic interface whose openings are immediate, local and transactional, granting the forebrain access to body-state signals at behaviorally relevant moments. Such events may also support brain health through locally timed metabolic supply and waste clearance.
items.abstract_zh: 生存需要详细理解身体状态，而血管系统为大脑提供了这种信息的连续通道。然而，血脑屏障（BBB）通常被视为稳定的边界，任何通过它的通道都被视为病理性渗漏，因为持续暴露会带来真实风险。前脑如何解决信息与安全之间这些相互竞争的需求仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明健康的屏障在身体状态信息可能值得冒险的时刻短暂且局部地打开。使用双光子成像对执行提示奖励任务的小鼠体感新皮层中的血管内右旋糖酐进行成像，我们识别出羽流事件（Plume Events）：穿透性小动脉处通透性的短暂、局灶性增加，这些增加与提示和奖励锁定，在无可检测扩张的试次中持续存在，并随训练提前。内皮钙事件先于并预测羽流事件，在数秒内和血管壁15微米范围内。来自结节乳头体核的组胺能轴突在羽流事件之前活跃，其光遗传学刺激驱动了羽流事件，这些事件在重复刺激序列中减弱而扩张持续存在。总之，这些发现将血脑屏障重新定义为动态界面，其开放是即时的、局部的和交易性的，使前脑在行为相关时刻获得身体状态信号。此类事件还可能通过局部定时的代谢供应和废物清除支持大脑健康。

items.title_en: Signatures of Kitaev quantum spin liquid states in $α$-RuCl$_3$ revealed by nitrogen-vacancy spin-noise spectroscopy
items.title_zh: 氮空位自旋噪声谱揭示α-RuCl3中Kitaev量子自旋液体态的特征
items.abstract_en: Bond-dependent magnetic interactions, strong spin-orbit coupling, and quantum fluctuations in $α$-RuCl$_3$ make it an archetypical candidate for exotic Kitaev quantum spin liquid (QSL) states. While electronic transport, neutron scattering, optical and tunneling spectroscopies were used to probe global QSL signatures in large scale $α$-RuCl$_3$ samples, nanoscale evidence of local QSL behavior via a non-invasive experimental probe is still missing. Here, we use diamond nitrogen-vacancy (NV) spin-noise spectroscopy to probe QSL states in α-RuCl3 nanoflakes with thicknesses ranging from 8 to 150 nm over a temperature range of 4.3-250 K. Our measurements reveal a pronounced decrease in the NV spin-lattice relaxation time ($T_{1}$) below ~100 K in proximity to the $α$-RuCl$_3$ flakes, indicating enhanced GHz-frequency magnetic fluctuations. This temperature scale is consistent with the energy scale associated with Kitaev interactions (~8 meV) and the emergence of low-energy fractionalized excitations. Below 50 K, thicker (> 90 nm) flakes exhibit a distinct bi-exponential $T_{1}$ decay, unlike the single-exponential behavior observed for off-flake and thinner (8 nm) flake measurements, suggesting an increasingly heterogeneous magnetic noise environment. These results establish NV spin-noise spectroscopy as a local, non-invasive probe of low-energy spin dynamics in $α$-RuCl$_3$ nanoflakes and open a route to testing predicted noise signatures of fractionalized excitations in atomically thin QSL candidates.
items.abstract_zh: α-RuCl3中键依赖的磁相互作用、强自旋轨道耦合和量子涨落使其成为奇异Kitaev量子自旋液体（QSL）态的原型候选。虽然电子输运、中子散射、光学和隧穿光谱已被用于探测大规模α-RuCl3样品中的全局QSL特征，但通过非侵入性实验探针获得的局部QSL行为的纳米尺度证据仍然缺失。在这里，我们使用金刚石氮空位（NV）自旋噪声光谱在4.3-250 K温度范围内探测厚度为8至150 nm的α-RuCl3纳米片中的QSL态。我们的测量显示，在接近α-RuCl3薄片处，NV自旋-晶格弛豫时间（T1）在约100 K以下显著降低，表明GHz频率的磁涨落增强。这一温度尺度与Kitaev相互作用相关的能量尺度（约8 meV）以及低能分数化激发的出现相一致。在50 K以下，较厚（>90 nm）的薄片表现出明显的双指数T1衰减，不同于在薄片外和较薄（8 nm）薄片测量中观察到的单指数行为，表明磁噪声环境日益异质。这些结果确立了NV自旋噪声光谱作为α-RuCl3纳米片中低能自旋动力学的局部、非侵入性探针，并为在原子级薄QSL候选物中检验分数化激发的预测噪声特征开辟了途径。

items.title_en: Optimal Transport Meets t-SNE: Integrated Visualization without Batch Effects in OT-tSNE
items.title_zh: 最优传输遇上t-SNE：OT-tSNE中无批次效应的集成可视化
items.abstract_en: Visual exploration is an integral step in understanding the structure of datasets. However, systematic variation between datasets collected under different conditions, known as batch effects, can obscure shared structure and complicate their joint visualization. Existing methods often rely on cross-batch nearest-neighbor relations to integrate the batches. Yet, these local correspondences can be unreliable for challenging cross-batch geometries. We propose optimal-transport t-SNE (OT-tSNE), which replaces nearest-neighbor-based matching with globally coupled affinities derived from entropic optimal transport. Controlled synthetic experiments demonstrated that nearest-neighbor-based methods can deteriorate, while optimal-transport affinities and OT-tSNE embeddings remain robust. Across seven real single-cell datasets, we benchmarked OT-tSNE against a broad range of integration and visualization methods and found that it achieves a Pareto-efficient trade-off between batch mixing and biological conservation, and integrates batches particularly well.
items.abstract_zh: 可视化探索是理解数据集结构不可或缺的一步。然而，在不同条件下收集的数据集之间的系统性变异（称为批次效应）会掩盖共享结构并使它们的联合可视化复杂化。现有方法通常依赖跨批次最近邻关系来整合批次。然而，对于具有挑战性的跨批次几何结构，这些局部对应关系可能不可靠。我们提出最优传输t-SNE（OT-tSNE），它用源自熵最优传输的全局耦合亲和度取代基于最近邻的匹配。受控合成实验表明，基于最近邻的方法可能退化，而最优传输亲和度和OT-tSNE嵌入保持稳健。在七个真实单细胞数据集上，我们将OT-tSNE与广泛的整合和可视化方法进行基准比较，发现它在批次混合和生物保守性之间实现了帕累托高效权衡，并且对批次的整合特别好。

items.title_en: Detectable Epistemic Attack Layers: A Coverage Theorem and Standardized Harness for Conversation-History Integrity
items.title_zh: 可检测的认知攻击层：对话历史完整性的覆盖定理与标准化测试框架
items.abstract_en: Conversation history is infrastructure: deployed language models rely on application layers to store and reinject prior turns, and that stored state is writable. We formalize session-level contamination by attack layer, state a coverage theorem, and measure its scope: each deployment-layer verification tier covers exactly its layer and is sound with respect to the others; instruction overrides are not detectable without false positives; and composite vectors evade per-fragment verification. A standardized harness applied to eight mechanism families across 3,249 sessions and three model families makes these claims checkable. First, pattern-based detection pays a measured false-positive price: the classic defenses flag 35 to 50 percent of benign sessions, and the naive refusal floor reaches only 2.4 percent attack-cell adoption while destroying 33 to 100 percent of benign turns, whereas provenance-gated channel separation achieves adoption at or below 1.2 percent with zero false positives and zero utility loss. Second, in the exploratory instruction-override extension, the gates' boundary is a cliff: directives rephrased without shape markers bypass them at control-equivalent rates, 47.7 to 49.5 percent against 0.0 percent for the shaped class, placing that class in the model-internal lane. Third, the deterministic core is storage-layer detection at 126 of 126 per model with zero false positives. External anchors reproduce published attack pressure, with PoisonedRAG falling from 70 to 0 percent under the full stack. For practitioners: authenticate stored history and content provenance with deterministic tiers, scope instruction-layer mitigation to provenance-gated designs whose measured benign cost is zero, and monitor composition at the trajectory level rather than per fragment. All protocols and acceptance criteria are pre-registered; the stack and harness are released.
items.abstract_zh: 对话历史是基础设施：已部署的语言模型依赖应用层存储并重新注入先前的轮次，而该存储状态是可写的。我们按攻击层对会话级污染进行形式化，陈述一个覆盖定理，并测量其范围：每个部署层验证层级恰好覆盖其自身层，并且相对于其他层是可靠的；指令覆盖无法在不产生假阳性的情况下被检测到；组合向量可规避逐片段验证。一个标准化测试框架应用于8个机制族、涵盖3,249个会话和3个模型族，使这些主张可被检验。第一，基于模式检测付出了经测量的假阳性代价：经典防御将35%至50%的良性会话标记为异常，而朴素拒绝下限仅达到2.4%的攻击单元采纳率，同时破坏33%至100%的良性轮次，相比之下，来源门控的通道分离实现采纳率不高于1.2%，且零假阳性和零效用损失。第二，在探索性指令覆盖扩展中，门控的边界呈断崖式：不含形状标记的改写指令以与对照相当的比例绕过门控，为47.7%至49.5%，而有形状类别为0.0%，这将后者置于模型内部通道。第三，确定性核心是存储层检测，每个模型126/126，零假阳性。外部锚点复现了已发表的攻击压力，在全栈下PoisonedRAG从70%降至0%。对实践者而言：使用确定性层级对已存储历史和内容来源进行认证，将指令层缓解限定于经测量良性成本为零的来源门控设计，并在轨迹层面而非逐片段层面监测组合。所有协议和验收标准均已预注册；该技术栈和测试框架已发布。

items.title_en: ContinualDrive: A Deployment-Anchored, Multi-Axis Benchmark for Continual Updates of Learned Driving Planners
items.title_zh: ContinualDrive：面向学习型驾驶规划器持续更新的部署锚定多轴基准
items.abstract_en: Learned driving planners keep being updated after deployment as new logs arrive, yet continual learning evaluations rarely ask whether an update improves on the deployed model, and their verdicts rest on unstated evaluation choices. We present ContinualDrive, a deployment-anchored benchmark for post-deployment continual learning of driving planners. It updates a deployed planner on real-world nuPlan logs one scenario-type group at a time, evaluates the same checkpoints in open and closed loop, makes four measurement axes explicit (evaluation loop, reference checkpoint, temporal aggregation and stream protocol), and anchors a three-valued release verdict to the deployed checkpoint. We study two planners (PlanTF and Diffusion Planner) under full fine-tuning and adapter or LoRA updates, with and without replay or gradient projection, in three task orders. Verdicts can reverse or vanish when one axis changes: open-loop ADE ranks the final PlanTF model above the deployed one in half of its core-suite runs, whereas every closed-loop score ranks it below; backward transfer misses this loss, which on average is already present when each group has just been learned; and regime rankings vary far less across training seeds than across task orders. In the core suite of full and adapter updates, no regime measurably improved on the deployed planner in closed loop; on a panel more than ten times larger every evaluated final checkpoint trails it, and joint training on all groups recovers much of the loss without exceeding its nuPlan closed-loop score. We distill these findings into a reporting contract and will release the code and all checkpoints.
items.abstract_zh: 学习型驾驶规划器在部署后随着新日志的到来不断被更新，然而持续学习评估很少询问更新是否改进了已部署模型，而且其结论依赖于未明说的评估选择。我们提出ContinualDrive，一个面向驾驶规划器部署后持续学习的部署锚定基准。它在真实世界nuPlan日志上按场景类型组一次更新一个已部署规划器，在开环和闭环中评估相同的检查点，明确四个测量轴（评估循环、参考检查点、时间聚合和流协议），并将三值发布判定锚定到已部署检查点。我们在三种任务顺序下，研究两个规划器（PlanTF和Diffusion Planner）在全微调和适配器或LoRA更新下，在有/无回放或梯度投影时的表现。当一个轴改变时，结论可能反转或消失：开环ADE在其核心套件运行的一半中将最终PlanTF模型排在已部署模型之上，而每个闭环分数都将其排在之下；后向迁移错过了这一损失，该损失平均在每个组刚被学习时就已经存在；而训练机制排名在训练种子之间的变化远小于任务顺序之间的变化。在全量和适配器更新的核心套件中，没有任何训练机制在闭环中可测量地改进已部署规划器；在规模超过十倍的评估面板上，每个被评估的最终检查点都落后于它，而对所有组进行联合训练恢复了大部分损失，但未超过其nuPlan闭环分数。我们将这些发现提炼为报告契约，并将发布代码和所有检查点。

items.title_en: Part-Set Prototypes for Explainable Mountain Gazelles Sex Classification
items.title_zh: 用于可解释山地瞪羚性别分类的部件集合原型
items.abstract_en: Self-explainable visual models for fine-grained recognition are often hindered by rigid geometric constraints that cannot capture diverse semantic shapes in unconstrained "in-the-wild" imagery. Real-world camera-trap data introduces challenges, including non-optimal poses, lighting variations, occlusions, animal camouflage, and environmental shortcuts. To address this, we introduce set prototypes, a general architecture where both part cardinality and unconstrained spatial layouts are mined directly from data. Our joint-matching formulation places parts simultaneously on a frozen DINOv3 token grid via truncated Sinkhorn competition, allowing unsupported parts to abstain without spatial collapse. We evaluate our approach on Mountain Gazelle sex classification, a camera-trap benchmark, where our model achieves 0.878 macro-F1--outperforming prior architectures and at par with an unconstrained linear probe. The strongest prototypes localize to distinctive biological areas such as horns, neck and body, allowing ecologists to visually verify decisions before trusting the metric. This formulation generalizes naturally to diverse ecological monitoring challenges beyond a single species.
items.abstract_zh: 用于细粒度识别的自解释视觉模型通常受到刚性几何约束的阻碍，这些约束无法捕捉无约束“野外”图像中的多样语义形状。真实世界的相机陷阱数据带来了挑战，包括非最佳姿态、光照变化、遮挡、动物伪装和环境捷径。为解决这一问题，我们引入集合原型（set prototypes），一种通用架构，其中部件基数和无约束空间布局均直接从数据中挖掘。我们的联合匹配公式通过截断Sinkhorn竞争将部件同时放置在冻结的DINOv3 token网格上，允许不支持的部件弃权而不发生空间塌缩。我们在山地瞪羚性别分类（一个相机陷阱基准）上评估我们的方法，其中我们的模型达到0.878宏F1——优于先前架构，并与无约束线性探针相当。最强的原型定位到诸如角、颈和身体等独特生物区域，使生态学家能够在信任指标之前视觉验证决策。该公式自然推广到超越单一物种的多样生态监测挑战。

items.title_en: The neural basis of unfamiliar face recognition in humans with fMRI frequency-tagging
items.title_zh: 使用fMRI频率标记的人类陌生面孔识别的神经基础
items.abstract_en: Faces provide the most diagnostic information for identifying individuals in humans. Understanding the neural mechanisms involved in face identity recognition (FIR) is particularly important for unfamiliar faces, for which identity cannot rely on encoded multimodal semantic associations. Here, we investigated the neural basis of FIR using an original frequency-tagging fMRI approach providing objective, sensitive, and reliable measures of face recognition. Ten human participants were presented within a rapid 6 Hz stream of natural images of a single unfamiliar identity in two conditions: (1) with the same face image across low-level changes (size, luminance, contrast) only, or (2) with images varying in background, size, head orientation, gaze direction, etc. Every 9 s during a 243 s run, seven images of different unfamiliar identities were introduced in bursts. For each participant and each condition, we recorded runs with upright and inverted faces. Analyses were performed within face-selective regions (defined from a frequency-tagging localizer) and in the Fourier domain, where individual face discrimination responses were objectively identified and quantified at the identity-change frequency (0.111 Hz). We observed robust image-based individual face discrimination responses across both conditions in core face-selective ventral regions (LatMidFG and IOG). In contrast, responses in early visual cortex and the pSTS were negligible in our second condition, which required generalization across viewpoint variations. In addition, the LatMidFG showed a reliable inversion effect, confirming that the observed responses cannot be attributed solely to low-level image differences. Overall, these findings highlight the value of fMRI frequency-tagging for objectively characterizing the cortical network underlying unfamiliar FIR, providing evidence for high-level discrimination and generalization of unfamiliar face identity in the human ventral occipito-temporal face-selective network.
items.abstract_zh: 面孔为人类识别个体提供了最具诊断性的信息。理解面孔身份识别（FIR）所涉及的神经机制对于陌生面孔尤为重要，因为陌生面孔的身份不能依赖已编码的多模态语义关联。在此，我们使用一种原创的频率标记fMRI方法研究FIR的神经基础，该方法提供客观、灵敏且可靠的面孔识别测量。十名人类参与者在快速6 Hz的自然图像流中观看单一陌生身份的图像，分为两种条件：（1）仅存在低层变化（大小、亮度、对比度）而面孔图像相同；或（2）图像在背景、大小、头部朝向、注视方向等方面变化。在243 s的运行中，每9 s以脉冲形式引入七张不同陌生身份的图像。对于每名参与者和每种条件，我们记录了正立和倒置面孔的运行。分析在面孔选择区（由频率标记定位器定义）内以及傅里叶域中进行，在身份变化频率（0.111 Hz）处客观识别并量化个体面孔辨别反应。我们在核心面孔选择性腹侧区域（LatMidFG和IOG）中观察到两种条件下均存在稳健的基于图像的个体面孔辨别反应。相比之下，在需要跨视角变化泛化的第二种条件下，早期视觉皮层和pSTS中的反应可忽略不计。此外，LatMidFG显示出可靠的倒置效应，证实观察到的反应不能仅归因于低层图像差异。总体而言，这些发现凸显了fMRI频率标记在客观刻画陌生FIR背后的皮层网络方面的价值，为人类腹侧枕颞面孔选择网络中陌生面孔身份的高层辨别与泛化提供了证据。

items.title_en: Class-resolved sifting for quantum key distribution with photon pairs hyperentangled in polarization and transverse spatial variables
items.title_zh: 偏振与横向空间变量超纠缠光子对的量子密钥分发中的按类分辨筛选
items.abstract_en: Photon pairs hyperentangled in polarization and transverse spatial variables can carry two key bits per pair in entanglement-based quantum key distribution. We develop class-resolved sifting for such sources: every detected pair is assigned to a class according to which degrees of freedom were measured in compatible bases, and error and key rates are estimated separately in each class. Applied to previously reported data from a two-crystal spontaneous parametric down-conversion source read out in intermediate fractional-Fourier planes, the method recovers the key yield of independent sifting and turns the comparison between classes into a quantitative consistency test for cross-dependencies between the two degrees of freedom. The measured dependence lies below the spatial-polarization coupling predicted for the source, at the edge of the present statistical sensitivity. Resolving the data by polarization-analyzer setting, we find an approximately twofold dependence of the spatial error on the polarization setting in one readout arm, attributable to the measurement apparatus rather than to the source and relevant to basis-dependent side channels. We compare the hyperentangled protocol with a single 4-dimensional system measured in two mutually unbiased bases. Fundamentally, both yield the same key per detected pair and obey the same entropic bound, but they differ in their tensor-product structure: hyperentanglement factors the bases into separate two-outcome measurements, which are simpler to implement and allow errors to be attributed to each degree of freedom, whereas a single variable gives access to non-product bases that can increase the noise tolerance. For the present source, whose polarization coherence is limited by partial which-crystal erasure, a single-variable spatial encoding would yield more key only if its four-outcome readout kept the symbol error within a few percent.
items.abstract_zh: 在偏振与横向空间变量上超纠缠的光子对，在基于纠缠的量子密钥分发中每对可携带两个密钥比特。我们为此类源开发按类分辨筛选：每个探测到的光子对根据在兼容基中测量了哪些自由度被归入一类，并在每一类中分别估计错误率和密钥率。将该方法应用于先前报道的、在中间分数傅里叶平面读出的双晶体自发参量下转换源数据，该方法恢复了独立筛选的密钥产额，并将类别间比较转化为对两个自由度之间交叉依赖性的定量一致性检验。测得的依赖性低于为该源预测的空间-偏振耦合，处于当前统计灵敏度的边缘。按偏振分析器设置解析数据，我们发现一个读出臂中空间误差对偏振设置存在约两倍的依赖，这可归因于测量装置而非源，并与依赖基的侧信道相关。我们将超纠缠协议与在两个互无偏基中测量的单个四维系统进行比较。从根本上说，两者每个探测对产生相同密钥并服从相同熵界，但它们在张量积结构上不同：超纠缠将基分解为独立的二结果测量，这些测量更易实现，并允许将误差归因于每个自由度，而单个变量可访问非乘积基，从而可提高噪声容限。对于当前源，其偏振相干性受部分 which-crystal 擦除限制，单变量空间编码只有在其四结果读出将符号错误保持在百分之几以内时才会产生更多密钥。

items.title_en: Making Protocol Effects Explicit: LLM-to-Packet Simulation for Superpod Interconnect Exploration
items.title_zh: 使协议效应显式化：用于超节点互连探索的 LLM-to-Packet 仿真
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have become the foundation of modern AI services. The rapid growth of LLM sizes and context lengths has exceeded the memory capacity of a single GPU or NPU, requiring model partitioning across devices. However, partitioning models across devices introduces costly communication overhead, driving the need for superpods with large-scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency scale-up fabrics. Exploring superpod designs requires accurate interconnect simulation, as communication latency is jointly determined by link technologies, topologies, and scale-up protocol-stack choices. Latency-bandwidth models estimate communication latency using a startup term and a transfer term derived from message size and effective bandwidth. But they fail to capture contention and protocol effects. Packet-level simulators like ns-3 model routing, queueing, and packet timing, but require protocol-specific LLM-to-packet implementations. This paper presents ProtoBridge, an ns-3-based LLM-to-packet simulator for superpod interconnect exploration. To make protocol effects explicit, ProtoBridge introduces two abstraction layers over ns-3: (1) an operation-to-packet (OTP) layer that captures protocol-specific packet exchanges and dependencies, and (2) a packet-execution (PEX) layer that applies shared packet-level mechanisms to the ns-3 event system. ProtoBridge achieves average latency error of 17.8\% on H200 NVLink4 and 10.3\% on C500 MetaXLink. To enable faster superpod evaluation for further interconnect exploration, we derive a surrogate model that combines OTP parameters with analytical models of PEX mechanisms. The surrogate reduces evaluation time from 2.38$\sim$75.70s to 20.5us per operation. We use ProtoBridge to analyze two emerging superpod designs, scale-up memory pool and co-packaged optics (CPO) interconnects, revealing design insights for future LLM superpod architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为现代 AI 服务的基础。LLM 规模和上下文长度的快速增长已超过单个 GPU 或 NPU 的内存容量，需要跨设备划分模型。然而，跨设备划分模型会引入昂贵的通信开销，从而推动对具有大规模、高带宽、低延迟 scale-up 互连结构的超节点的需求。探索超节点设计需要准确的互连仿真，因为通信延迟由链路技术、拓扑和 scale-up 协议栈选择共同决定。延迟-带宽模型使用启动项和由消息大小与有效带宽导出的传输项来估计通信延迟，但它们无法捕捉竞争和协议效应。诸如 ns-3 的数据包级仿真器可对路由、排队和数据包时序建模，但需要针对特定协议的 LLM-to-packet 实现。本文提出 ProtoBridge，一个基于 ns-3 的 LLM-to-packet 仿真器，用于超节点互连探索。为使协议效应显式化，ProtoBridge 在 ns-3 之上引入两个抽象层：（1）操作到数据包（OTP）层，捕捉协议特定的数据包交换和依赖关系；（2）数据包执行（PEX）层，将共享的数据包级机制应用于 ns-3 事件系统。ProtoBridge 在 H200 NVLink4 上实现平均延迟误差 17.8%，在 C500 MetaXLink 上为 10.3%。为实现更快的超节点评估以进一步探索互连，我们推导了一个代理模型，将 OTP 参数与 PEX 机制的分析模型相结合。该代理模型将每次操作的评估时间从 2.38~75.70 秒缩短至 20.5 微秒。我们使用 ProtoBridge 分析两种新兴超节点设计——scale-up 内存池和共封装光学（CPO）互连——揭示了对未来 LLM 超节点架构的设计启示。

items.title_en: HGDNA: Overlapping k-mer Tokenization for Efficient Autoregressive Genomic Language Models
items.title_zh: HGDNA：用于高效自回归基因组语言模型的重叠k-mer分词
items.abstract_en: The domain of genomic language models (gLMs) has advanced rapidly, with models pretrained on diverse multi-species genomic corpora demonstrating their remarkable capabilities. While the effect of simple nucleotide-level tokenization on long-context modeling is well established, overlapping k-mer tokenization remains underexplored in causal pretraining, despite its rich neighborhood information. Here, we thoroughly revisit overlapping tokenization and introduce HGDNA, a hybrid linear-attention gLM with causal language modeling (CLM) pretraining and a shared token-prediction interface for downstream adaptation, using a species-classification auxiliary task and shared class tokens. HGDNA delivers competitive performance across sequence classification and frozen-embedding evaluations, supporting both short-range and long-range tasks with 30M parameters and 19B pretraining tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA
items.abstract_zh: 基因组语言模型（gLM）领域发展迅速，在多样多物种基因组语料上预训练的模型已展示出显著能力。虽然简单核苷酸级分词对长上下文建模的影响已得到充分确立，但重叠k-mer分词在因果预训练中仍研究不足，尽管其具有丰富的邻域信息。在此，我们重新深入审视重叠分词，并引入HGDNA，一种混合线性注意力gLM，具有因果语言建模（CLM）预训练和用于下游适配的共享标记预测接口，采用物种分类辅助任务和共享类别标记。HGDNA在序列分类和冻结嵌入评估中提供有竞争力的性能，以30M参数和19B预训练token支持短程和长程任务。代码见https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA

items.title_en: Wind-Aware Trajectory Planning for Deformable Aerial Formations
items.title_zh: 可变形空中编队的风感知轨迹规划
items.abstract_en: Coordinated aerial transport in dense urban environments requires drone formations to navigate confined spaces and adapt to spatially varying winds around buildings. Formation deformation enables passage through narrow spaces but changes individual drone velocities and the local winds they encounter, coupling formation motion with aerodynamic effects. We propose Family-Air, a wind-aware trajectory-family planner that constructs a virtual tube as shared collision-free flight space and jointly optimizes formation-center motion, deformation, and timing. A shared affine transformation represents a continuous trajectory family, incorporating spatially varying wind and deformation-induced velocities into a unified air-relative motion objective. The optimization enforces virtual-tube containment, inter-drone separation, and kinematic feasibility. Simulations across four urban wind-field scenarios demonstrate the importance of local wind-deformation coupling. Flight simulations further show improvements in trajectory tracking accuracy. These results demonstrate the potential of wind-aware trajectory-family planning for coordinated aerial transport in complex urban environments.
items.abstract_zh: 密集城市环境中的协同空中运输要求无人机编队穿行受限空间，并适应建筑物周围空间变化的风场。编队变形可实现狭窄空间通过，但会改变单架无人机的速度及其遇到的局部风，从而使编队运动与气动效应耦合。我们提出 Family-Air，一种风感知轨迹族规划器，构建虚拟管作为共享无碰撞飞行空间，并联合优化编队中心运动、变形与时间安排。共享仿射变换表示连续轨迹族，将空间变化的风与变形诱导速度纳入统一的相对空气运动目标。优化施加虚拟管约束、无人机间分离与运动学可行性。四个城市风场场景的仿真表明局部风-变形耦合的重要性。飞行仿真进一步显示轨迹跟踪精度提升。这些结果展示了风感知轨迹族规划在复杂城市环境中协同空中运输的潜力。

items.title_en: $ε$-Seg++: Ensembling Across Hierarchy and Training Time for Label-Efficient EM Segmentation
items.title_zh: $ε$-Seg++：面向标签高效 EM 分割的跨层级与跨训练时间集成
items.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation of electron microscopy (EM) volumes is a central step in quantitative cell biology, but dense voxel-wise annotation is prohibitively expensive. $ε$-Seg showed that a hierarchical variational autoencoder trained on sparsely annotated voxels can yield competitive segmentations, but it classifies from its topmost latent level only and operates exclusively on 2D patches. We introduce $ε$-Seg++, which places a semantic expert at every level of the hierarchy and consolidates their predictions with a parameter-free product of experts. We further enable 3D inputs through a leakage-free sub-volume splitting protocol, which allows 2D and 3D models to be compared under identical sparse supervision. Because validation labels are just as scarce as training labels, we treat checkpoint selection as part of the method and average the top-ranked checkpoints, a second ensemble, this time across training time. On the BetaSeg FIB-SEM dataset, the multi-level experts improve 2D mean Dice by about 0.1 at 2,500 training labels. With up to 600 training labels, the 2D model matches or exceeds 3D $ε$-Seg at about one eleventh of its prediction cost. Above roughly a thousand labels, 3D inputs dominate, and at matched annotation cost 3D $ε$-Seg++ reaches a mean Dice of 0.905 versus 0.880 for D3PM, while predicting between 5.4 and 27 times faster (with our checkpoint ensemble or a single model, respectively). Checkpoint ensembling matches single-best selection on average and markedly improves the worst case when the validation set is small.
items.abstract_zh: 电子显微镜（EM）体数据的语义分割是定量细胞生物学的核心步骤，但密集的逐体素标注成本高得难以承受。$ε$-Seg 表明，在稀疏标注体素上训练的分层变分自编码器可产生有竞争力的分割，但它仅从最高潜层进行分类，且仅在 2D 图像块上运行。我们提出 $ε$-Seg++，在层级每一层放置语义专家，并用无参数专家乘积整合其预测。我们进一步通过无泄漏子体积划分协议支持 3D 输入，使 2D 和 3D 模型可在相同稀疏监督下比较。由于验证标签与训练标签同样稀缺，我们将检查点选择视为方法的一部分，并对排名靠前的检查点取平均，这是第二个集成，此次跨训练时间。在 BetaSeg FIB-SEM 数据集上，多层级专家在 2,500 个训练标签下将 2D 平均 Dice 提高约 0.1。在最多 600 个训练标签时，2D 模型以约其十一分之一的预测成本达到或超过 3D $ε$-Seg。高于约一千个标签时，3D 输入占优；在相同标注成本下，3D $ε$-Seg++ 达到平均 Dice 0.905，而 D3PM 为 0.880，同时预测速度快 5.4 至 27 倍（分别使用我们的检查点集成或单个模型）。检查点集成平均而言与单最佳选择相当，并在验证集较小时显著改善最坏情况。

items.title_en: Disease-specific versus symptom-specific neuroimaging phenotypes across Alzheimer's Disease, Parkinson's Disease, and Small Vessel Disease
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和小血管病中疾病特异性与症状特异性神经影像表型的比较
items.abstract_en: Background: Neurodegenerative disorders are common in ageing populations, and arise from several distinct pathophysiological causes. Yet, they also share many symptoms, including cognitive and neuropsychiatric ones. It is unclear to what extent the impact of neurodegeneration on brain systems is unique or shared across disorders, and whether shared symptoms are driven by degeneration of the same brain systems. Methods: We collected data from n=251 participants with Alzheimer's Disease, Parkinson's Disease, Small Vessel Disease, and age-matched healthy controls. All participants underwent harmonized cognitive and neuropsychiatric assessment and were scanned using the UK-Biobank MRI protocol capturing features including brain volume, white matter lesions and microstructure, tract volume, iron content, and functional connectivity. Results: We replicated established case-control brain changes in Alzheimer's Disease, Parkinson's Disease and Small Vessel Disease compared to healthy controls. Leveraging this joint standardised dataset, we identified distinct neuroimaging features of individual neurodegenerative disorders, providing evidence for robust diagnosis-specific brain changes. Importantly, however, there was also a large degree of transdiagnostic similarity across neuroimaging markers. Testing for transdiagnostic associations between symptoms and brain phenotypes, we found that lower medial frontal pole connectivity to primary motor cortex was preferentially associated with apathy, fatigue, and depression; whereas cingulum microstructure was associated with cognitive deficits across diagnoses. Conclusions: These results demonstrate that different neurodegenerative diseases are characterised by dissociable brain changes, but also common transdiagnostic and symptom-associated features. This suggests that shared symptoms across neurodegeneration may in part be driven by overlapping impact on key brain systems, such as changes in medial frontal pole connectivity and cingulum microstructure. Our work highlights that multimodal imaging biomarkers can help understand and parse symptomatic heterogeneity in neurodegenerative and ageing populations.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：神经退行性疾病在老龄化人群中常见，并由若干不同的病理生理原因引起。然而，它们也共享许多症状，包括认知和神经精神症状。目前尚不清楚神经退行性变对脑系统的影响在多大程度上是疾病独有的或跨疾病共享的，也不清楚共享症状是否由相同脑系统的退变驱动。方法：我们收集了n=251名阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、小血管病患者以及年龄匹配的健康对照者的数据。所有参与者均接受了统一的认知和神经精神评估，并按照UK-Biobank MRI协议扫描，采集脑体积、白质病变与微结构、纤维束体积、铁含量和功能连接等特征。结果：我们复现了阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和小血管病相对于健康对照的既有病例-对照脑改变。利用这一联合标准化数据集，我们识别出各神经退行性疾病的独特神经影像特征，为稳健的诊断特异性脑改变提供了证据。然而重要的是，神经影像标志物之间也存在很大程度的跨诊断相似性。检验症状与脑表型之间的跨诊断关联时，我们发现内侧额极与初级运动皮层的连接降低优先与冷漠、疲劳和抑郁相关；而扣带微结构与各诊断中的认知缺陷相关。结论：这些结果表明，不同神经退行性疾病以可分离的脑改变为特征，但也具有共同的跨诊断和症状相关特征。这提示神经退行性变中的共享症状可能部分由对关键脑系统的重叠影响驱动，例如内侧额极连接和扣带微结构的变化。我们的工作强调，多模态影像生物标志物有助于理解和解析神经退行性及老龄化人群中的症状异质性。

items.title_en: Integrated lasing and dual-band gain in neodymium-implanted silicon nitride
items.title_zh: 注入钕的氮化硅中集成激光与双波段增益
items.abstract_en: Lasers at wavelengths near 1 micrometer are used in quantum technologies, precision metrology, and sensing. Rare-earth gain at these wavelengths in photonic integrated circuits can reduce the size and enable the scalable fabrication of these lasers. We fabricate neodymium-based integrated waveguide amplifiers and a ring laser using neodymium-implanted LPCVD silicon nitride. The photonic integrated circuits were fabricated on a 200 mm commercial wafer platform, and individual dies were implanted with neodymium ions. We show that the amplifiers provide gain in two bands around wavelengths of 920 nm and 1100 nm, and we show lasing in a ring resonator. This demonstrates that neodymium-implanted LPCVD silicon nitride is a suitable gain material for integrated lasers.
items.abstract_zh: 波长接近 1 微米的激光器用于量子技术、精密计量和传感。光子集成电路中这些波长的稀土增益可减小这类激光器的尺寸并实现可扩展制造。我们使用注入钕的 LPCVD 氮化硅制备了基于钕的集成波导放大器和环形激光器。光子集成电路在 200 mm 商用晶圆平台上制备，并对单个裸片注入钕离子。我们展示放大器在约 920 nm 和 1100 nm 波长附近的两个波段提供增益，并展示环形谐振器中的激射。这表明注入钕的 LPCVD 氮化硅是集成激光器的合适增益材料。

items.title_en: EEGJev: A System One Decision Model and Benchmark for Multi-Task EEG Question Answering
items.title_zh: EEGJev：用于多任务 EEG 问答的系统一决策模型与基准
items.abstract_en: A single electroencephalographic (EEG) recording can support multiple decoding tasks. Fixed-label tests cannot show how EEG foundation models handle changing questions or options. We introduce EEGJev, a fast decision model that scores candidate answers in one pass. Our benchmark, EEGJev-Bench, covers six question types across 19 public EEG sources. We held the recording and options fixed while switching between questions about attributes paired during training, such as facial expression and the hand participants were asked to use. Across 13 test sources, EEGJev selected a label for the requested attribute with 99.70% accuracy (49.20% under uniform choice). Balanced accuracy for the specific answer was 62.04%. Its 95th-percentile response time was shorter than NeuroLM's on matched validation questions answered individually. EEGJev lets users switch decoding targets by changing the question. With EEGJev-Bench, researchers can test whether new decoders follow the question more reliably, identify the correct answer more often, or both.
items.abstract_zh: 单次脑电图（EEG）记录可支持多个解码任务。固定标签测试无法展示 EEG 基础模型如何处理变化的问题或选项。我们提出 EEGJev，一种在一次通过中为候选答案打分的快速决策模型。我们的基准 EEGJev-Bench 覆盖 19 个公开 EEG 来源中的六类问题。我们在保持记录和选项固定时，在关于训练期间配对属性的问题之间切换，例如面部表情和参与者被要求使用的手。在 13 个测试来源上，EEGJev 为所请求属性选择标签的准确率为 99.70%（均匀选择下为 49.20%）。特定答案的平衡准确率为 62.04%。在逐个回答的匹配验证问题上，其第 95 百分位响应时间短于 NeuroLM。EEGJev 使用户可通过改变问题来切换解码目标。借助 EEGJev-Bench，研究人员可测试新解码器是否更可靠地遵循问题、更常识别正确答案，或两者兼有。

items.title_en: SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report
items.title_zh: SAG-Mem-1.0 技术报告
items.abstract_en: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.
items.abstract_zh: 长期对话记忆需要检索分散在对话会话中的互补事实，包括与原问题相似度有限的中间证据。现有方法通常依赖派生记忆表示或持久关系结构，引入构建成本并可能丢失源细节。我们提出 SAG-Mem，一种对话记忆框架，将完整对话消息保留在互不重叠的块中，并通过查询时词汇扩展发现互补证据。记忆构建无需模型推理，使用词汇索引，不进行基于 LLM 的抽取、摘要或语义关系构建。查询时，BM25 检索初始候选，证据评估器识别有用块，来自所选证据的词汇线索引导额外一轮检索。检索到的对话还标注了受支持的相对时间表达的日历解释，同时保留原始措辞和时间粒度。我们还提出 SAG-Mem-Lite，一种替代配置，用基于嵌入的候选打分替代证据打分，在两个基准上均实现低于 Full Context 和所有基于记忆的基线的运行成本，且查询延迟低。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上，SAG-Mem 的总体得分分别为 83.08 和 80.20，是两个基准上被评估方法中最高的。在 LongMemEval 上，它比最强对比基线高 7.20 分。SAG-Mem-Lite 的得分分别为 77.09 和 77.20。这些结果支持将对话保留和证据引导的检索扩展作为长期对话记忆的有效设计。

items.title_en: One Policy, Many Bodies: Cooperative Human-Object Interaction with Heterogeneous Teams
items.title_zh: 一种策略，多种身体：异构团队中的协作式人-物交互
items.abstract_en: Physics-based human-object interaction (HOI) has enabled multiple characters to cooperatively transport objects, but existing cooperative controllers largely assume homogeneous embodiments and predefined interaction tasks. We ask whether a single physics-based policy can enable cooperation across diverse embodiments, team compositions, and interaction skills. We present MorphHOI, a decentralised framework built on a key insight: effective heterogeneous cooperation requires a unified representation across embodiments while accounting for differences in their physical capabilities. To realise this insight, we introduce a canonical body interface that unifies observation and action spaces, together with an embodiment-conditioned transformer that adapts cooperative decisions to the physical capabilities of each agent and its teammates. To extend cooperation to new interaction skills, we reuse the learned cooperative policy through task-specific tokens and lightweight adaptation, preserving its original capabilities. Our framework achieves success rates of up to 96.7\% on seen embodiments, 95.6\% on unseen embodiments, and 91.4\% on novel payloads. Furthermore, the learned cooperation extends to diverse interaction skills with high success rates, including box carrying, transport on stairs, and waypoint following, while preserving previously acquired cooperative capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 基于物理的人-物交互（HOI）已使多个角色能够协作搬运物体，但现有协作控制器大多假设同质具身形态和预定义交互任务。我们研究单一基于物理的策略是否能够实现跨多样具身形态、团队组成和交互技能的合作。我们提出MorphHOI，一个基于关键洞见的去中心化框架：有效的异构协作需要跨具身形态的统一表示，同时考虑其物理能力差异。为实现这一洞见，我们引入一个规范身体接口，以统一观测空间和动作空间，并引入一种以具身为条件的Transformer，使协作决策适配每个智能体及其队友的物理能力。为将合作扩展到新的交互技能，我们通过任务特定令牌和轻量适配复用了已学习的协作策略，同时保留其原始能力。我们的框架在已见具身形态上达到最高96.7%的成功率，在未见具身形态上达到95.6%，在新载荷上达到91.4%。此外，所学合作扩展到多样交互技能并具有高成功率，包括搬运箱子、楼梯运输和航点跟随，同时保留先前获得的协作能力。

items.title_en: Field-Level Crop Classification via Similarity-Induced Supervision from Imperfect Labels
items.title_zh: 基于不完美标签的相似性诱导监督的田块级作物分类
items.abstract_en: Regional-scale crop mapping is critical for food production monitoring, yet remains challenging in tropical regions, where persistent cloud cover limits optical imagery. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) enables continuous observation throughout the agricultural cycle, but a second obstacle is label quality: national-scale land cover products exhibit systematic biases that underestimate less prevalent crops, and training directly on them inherits and amplifies their errors. This work proposes a methodology to build large-scale crop classification models from imperfect public land cover products, requiring no new field campaign, ground survey, or manual label correction. The approach combines two mechanisms. The first reduces the semantic inconsistency of the labels by shifting supervision from the sample level to the group level: a similarity-based clustering model organizes SAR time series into coherent groups, and noisy labels are used only to assign each group its most representative class. The resulting clusters are highly pure with respect to the reference classes (89.0% and 91.2% in the two study regions). The second reduces the spatial inconsistency of the predictions: a segmentation model delineates crop field boundaries from optical imagery, and patch-level predictions are consolidated by majority voting within each field, yielding spatially coherent maps. Evaluated in two Brazilian municipalities, Campo Verde (Mato Grosso) and Luís Eduardo Magalhães (Bahia), the approach consistently outperforms the noisy baseline in mean class accuracy, with gains of up to 10.14 percentage points, especially for minority crops. A state-scale analysis across Mato Grosso and Bahia shows stable behavior without further model adjustment, and the derived municipal crop areas are consistent with official IBGE/PAM statistics, an independent estimate the model never observes.
items.abstract_zh: 区域尺度作物制图对粮食生产监测至关重要，但在热带地区仍具挑战性，因为持续的云覆盖限制了光学影像。合成孔径雷达（SAR）能够在整个农业周期内进行连续观测，但第二个障碍是标签质量：国家级土地覆盖产品存在系统性偏差，会低估较不普遍的作物，直接在其上训练会继承并放大其误差。本工作提出一种从有缺陷的公开土地覆盖产品构建大规模作物分类模型的方法，无需新的野外调查、地面测量或人工标签校正。该方法结合两种机制。第一种通过将监督从样本级转移到组级来降低标签的语义不一致性：基于相似性的聚类模型将SAR时间序列组织为一致的组，含噪标签仅用于为每个组分配最具代表性的类别。所得聚类相对于参考类别具有高纯度（在两个研究区域分别为89.0%和91.2%）。第二种降低预测的空间不一致性：分割模型从光学影像中勾画作物田块边界，并通过在每个田块内多数投票合并地块级预测，生成空间连贯的制图结果。在两个巴西市镇Campo Verde（马托格罗索州）和Luís Eduardo Magalhães（巴伊亚州）评估，该方法在平均类别精度上持续优于含噪基线，提升最高达10.14个百分点，尤其是对少数作物。在馬托格羅索州和巴伊亚州进行的州尺度分析显示出稳定行为而无需进一步模型调整，且导出的市级作物面积与官方IBGE/PAM统计数据一致，而该独立估计是模型从未观测到的。

items.title_en: From Growth Inhibition to Fluctuations: Testing an Ising Model of Bacterial Responses to Antibiotics
items.title_zh: 从生长抑制到涨落：检验细菌对抗生素响应的Ising模型
items.abstract_en: Complex networks of biochemical reactions have been proposed to exhibit emergent cooperativity that can be described by an effective Ising model, with a small number of parameters encoding collective interactions. Here this mapping is experimentally tested using the response of three bacterial species to a range of antibiotics acting on different cellular targets. The Ising description is compared to the conventional Hill model, examining both the mean growth-rate response and, importantly, its population growth-rate heterogeneity (PGRH). While both models describe the mean growth-rate dependence on antibiotic concentration comparably well, we find that the Ising model provides a markedly better description of PGRH, offering an additional and more stringent test of the collective description. The fitted Ising interaction strength is systematically related to the Hill exponent and increases with the functional distance of the antibiotic target from the protein-production machinery. These results provide experimental support for describing complex biochemical reaction networks through effective cooperative Ising interactions, and suggest that the collective response of bacterial growth to antibiotics reflects the organization of the underlying metabolic network.
items.abstract_zh: 已提出，复杂的生化反应网络可表现出可由有效Ising模型描述的新兴协同性，用少量参数编码集体相互作用。本文利用三种细菌物种对作用于不同细胞靶点的一系列抗生素的响应，对该映射进行实验检验。将Ising描述与常规Hill模型进行比较，考察平均生长速率响应，以及重要的一点——其种群生长速率异质性（PGRH）。虽然两种模型对平均生长速率随抗生素浓度变化的依赖关系描述得相当好，但我们发现Ising模型对PGRH的描述明显更好，为集体描述提供了额外且更严格的检验。拟合的Ising相互作用强度与Hill指数系统性相关，并随抗生素靶点与蛋白质生产机器之间的功能距离增大而增大。这些结果为通过有效协同Ising相互作用描述复杂生化反应网络提供了实验支持，并表明细菌生长对抗生素的集体响应反映了底层代谢网络的组织。

items.title_en: Reducing RSA-2048 Factoring Resources Below One Billion Toffolis via LLM-Driven Verifiable Quantum Compilation
items.title_zh: 通过 LLM 驱动的可验证量子编译将 RSA-2048 分解资源降至十亿个 Toffoli 门以下
items.abstract_en: Modular exponentiation dominates the logical cost of factoring 2048-bit RSA integers (RSA-2048) with Shor's algorithm. Recent approaches based on approximate residue number systems (RNS) sharply reduce the required logical qubits, yet still demand billions of Toffoli gates. Optimizing these circuits is difficult because shared ancilla qubits and measurement-based uncomputation tightly couple the arithmetic stages, while rare overflows in compressed registers occur too infrequently for random simulation to detect. Here we use large language model (LLM)-driven search to redesign the RNS pipeline across stages and build a deterministic compiler that produces a Pareto frontier of RSA-2048 circuits. We bound rare overflow probabilities analytically and verify the resulting elementary gate sequences across all constituent RNS primes on representative circuits. Relative to Gidney's 2025 baseline under matched adder accounting, our frontier cuts the minimum qubit-Toffoli product by 70.1% and lowers expected factoring Toffolis by up to 78.6% at matched accumulator precision, bringing RSA-2048 factoring below one billion Toffolis for the first time.
items.abstract_zh: 模幂运算主导了使用 Shor 算法分解 2048 位 RSA 整数（RSA-2048）的逻辑成本。近期基于近似余数系统（RNS）的方法大幅减少了所需逻辑量子比特，但仍需要数十亿个 Toffoli 门。优化这些电路很困难，因为共享辅助量子比特和基于测量的逆计算紧密耦合算术阶段，而压缩寄存器中罕见的溢出发生频率太低，随机模拟无法检测。在这里，我们使用大语言模型（LLM）驱动的搜索跨阶段重新设计 RNS 流水线，并构建确定性编译器，生成 RSA-2048 电路的帕累托前沿。我们解析地界定罕见溢出概率，并在代表性电路上跨所有组成 RNS 素数验证所得基本门序列。在匹配加法器核算下相对于 Gidney 2025 基线，我们的前沿将最小量子比特-Toffoli 乘积降低 70.1%，并在匹配累加器精度下将预期分解 Toffoli 数最多降低 78.6%，首次将 RSA-2048 分解降至十亿个 Toffoli 门以下。

items.title_en: Shifter Quantization: Compact Representations for Native Integer Computation
items.title_zh: Shifter Quantization：面向原生整数计算的紧凑表示
items.abstract_en: Groupwise quantization is used in LLM quantization to improve accuracy at low bit widths, but grouping weights keeps standard integer MMA from spanning the full dot product for efficient GPU inference. We develop a new quantization method, Shifter Quantization (SQ), that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits. To further extend the efficiency, we develop a special variant of SQ, Shifter Integer (SHI), to use INT4 kernels. We show that SQ and SHI formats perform better than standard groupwise quantization in quality, as measured by projection error and KL divergence, and in inference speed, as measured during decoding and prefill. For low precision like 2-bit quantization, SQ2 and SHI2 achieve 2.71-3.77x the 4,096-token prefill throughput of llama.cpp on a Q2_K checkpoint and reduce WikiText-2 KL by 6.6-7.8%. For mid precision like 4-bit quantization, SQ4 achieves 1.43-2.47x the prefill throughput of NInfer's groupwise-integer baselines across the tested models and prompt lengths, with 24-40% lower KL than the NInfer baselines. For high precision like 8-bit quantization, SQ8 achieves 27.4% higher batch-one prefill throughput and 72.7% lower KL than vLLM's online FP8.
items.abstract_zh: 分组量化（groupwise quantization）在 LLM 量化中用于在低比特宽度下提高精度，但分组权重使标准整数 MMA 无法覆盖完整点积，从而妨碍高效的 GPU 推理。我们提出一种新的量化方法 Shifter Quantization（SQ），它通过追加并移位共享比特来重建原生宽度的整数操作数。为进一步提高效率，我们开发了 SQ 的一种特殊变体 Shifter Integer（SHI），以使用 INT4 内核。我们表明，以投影误差和 KL 散度衡量，SQ 与 SHI 格式在质量上优于标准分组量化；在解码和预填充期间测得的推理速度上也更优。对于 2 比特量化等低精度，SQ2 和 SHI2 在 Q2_K 检查点上达到 llama.cpp 的 4,096-token 预填充吞吐量的 2.71–3.77 倍，并将 WikiText-2 KL 降低 6.6–7.8%。对于 4 比特量化等中等精度，在所测试模型和提示长度上，SQ4 达到 NInfer 的分组整数基线的预填充吞吐量的 1.43–2.47 倍，KL 比 NInfer 基线低 24–40%。对于 8 比特量化等高精度，SQ8 的 batch-one 预填充吞吐量比 vLLM 的在线 FP8 高 27.4%，KL 低 72.7%。

items.title_en: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
items.title_zh: AIChipBench：面向自动化 AI 加速器设计的 LLM 智能体基准测试
items.abstract_en: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型解码器在解码步骤之间携带状态，而在硬件中，错误的状态更新可能使当前 token 正确，却在若干 token 之后破坏输出，因此一个设计可能通过输出测试却仍然是错误的。AIChipBench 探究 LLM 编码智能体需要什么才能正确构建此类硬件。智能体针对可执行的整数参考实现，用可综合的寄存器传输级（RTL）代码实现量化的 Qwen3.5、Gemma 3、Gemma 4 和 Llama 3.2 解码器；该参考实现规定了每个解码步骤的输出和所存储状态。智能体在固定预算下针对公开测试进行调试；其冻结设计在留出的 token 序列、复位、内存停顿和综合上进行评分，第二个赛道要求它们在面积几乎固定的情况下加速一个正确设计。在四个编码智能体的 9,136 次尝试中，难点在于存储状态。在一项匹配研究中，所有 12 个智能体—任务单元中，指向首个状态不匹配的反馈相比仅输出反馈将接受率提高 25.0 至 46.9 个百分点，并将每个被接受设计所需的智能体小时数减半。在新序列和新条件下重新评分时，69 个被接受设计中有 45 个在其测试所要求的 32 步内失败。超过三分之一的加速正确设计的尝试最终未能得到正确设计。总体得分将 Sol 5.6 和 Fable 5.1 排在 Astra 6 和 Opus 5.5 之上，并且在全部 200 次随机划分中，实例的两个半部分都给出这一顺序。因此，硬件智能体需要能暴露存储状态的调试反馈，其基准测试也需要远远超出开发用例的最终测试。

items.title_en: One Latent World for Heterogeneous LiDARs: A Scan Pattern Agnostic 4D World Model via Direct Ray Decoding
items.title_zh: 异构LiDAR的单一潜在世界：通过直接光线解码的扫描模式无关4D世界模型
items.abstract_en: LiDAR world models generate and predict metric 3D observations in the form of LiDAR scans. They typically synthesize scans following the scan pattern of their training sensor or render them from an intermediate 3D surface or field. However, following one scan pattern limits transfer to LiDARs with other patterns, and rendering from intermediate geometry can cause incorrect depths and false returns. In this paper, we propose a scan pattern agnostic 4D LiDAR world model that decouples the scene from sensor observation, so one spatial latent can be observed by heterogeneous LiDARs at the same mounting position without regeneration. Our decoder predicts the hit probability and depth of each ray directly from the latent, combining global scene context with local features retrieved at a preliminary depth. Without an intermediate surface or field, it reduces incorrect depths and false returns, and as each ray is decoded independently from one latent, LiDARs that share a ray receive the same return and observe one consistent scene. Finally, a diffusion transformer generates scenes in this latent and predicts 4D sequences from observed latents warped by the given ego and object motion. On KITTI-360 and nuScenes, our model generates realistic scenes and reduces the registration error between predicted frames by about 70% relative to the best compared world model. Its decoder yields 19 to 28% lower depth error than the rendering used by other world models, and generated scans benefit several downstream tasks. Our code will be open-sourced. More details are available at https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR世界模型以LiDAR扫描的形式生成和预测度量3D观测。它们通常按照训练传感器的扫描模式合成扫描，或从中间3D表面或场渲染。然而，遵循一种扫描模式限制了向具有其他模式的LiDAR的迁移，从中间几何渲染可能导致不正确的深度和虚假回波。在本文中，我们提出一种扫描模式无关的4D LiDAR世界模型，将场景与传感器观测解耦，使得同一安装位置上的异构LiDAR可以观测同一个空间潜在表示而无需重新生成。我们的解码器直接从潜在表示预测每条光线的命中概率和深度，结合全局场景上下文与在初步深度处检索的局部特征。没有中间表面或场，它减少了不正确的深度和虚假回波，并且由于每条光线从同一潜在表示独立解码，共享一条光线的LiDAR接收相同的回波并观测到一个一致的场景。最后，扩散变换器在该潜在表示中生成场景，并从由给定自车和物体运动变形的观测潜在表示预测4D序列。在KITTI-360和nuScenes上，我们的模型生成逼真的场景，并相对于最佳比较世界模型将预测帧之间的配准误差降低约70%。其解码器产生的深度误差比其他世界模型使用的渲染低19%到28%，生成的扫描有益于若干下游任务。我们的代码将开源。更多细节见https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld。

items.title_en: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
items.title_zh: 写入、演化、读取：将相机流式传输为持久世界状态以进行4D占据预测
items.abstract_en: 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld
items.abstract_zh: 4D占据预测预测驾驶场景未来几秒的3D语义占据。在几秒内，场景变化很小而车辆移动，因此前方大部分空间已经被看到。将未来分为不变、变化和未见的空间，我们发现当前基于相机的世界模型在不变部分表现不足：它们未能保持已经看到的内容，而不是预测将会变化的内容。因此，我们让模型已经看到的内容成为其状态。PersistWorld将相机帧流式传输到锚定在场景中的持久3D世界状态，每帧写入一次，而不是从过去的帧重建状态。该状态与预测端到端学习，演化器在自车轨迹上任意查询时间预测该状态。在Occ3D-nuScenes上，PersistWorld将最佳基于相机的世界模型的IoU在1-3秒提高19个点，在最长8秒提高18到24个点，同时运行速度提高两倍以上。代码和模型：https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld。项目页面：https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld

items.title_en: Integrating hydrogen-exchange experiments with conformational ensembles
items.title_zh: 将氢交换实验与构象系综整合
items.abstract_en: Protein conformational dynamics are central to biological function but remain difficult to characterise at scale. Amide hydrogen exchange (HX), measured by NMR or mass spectrometry, probes these dynamics but requires computational models for integration with structural ensembles. We benchmark models for calculating HX from ensembles using a large literature-derived dataset spanning folded and intrinsically disordered proteins. We then develop a model that identifies exchange-competent amides from local structural descriptors while accounting for electrostatic effects. The model predicts protection across a broad dynamic range in ensembles generated by molecular dynamics and generative AI. HX-guided ensemble reweighting improves agreement with independent NMR, SAXS, and folding-stability measurements. Millisecond HX distinguishes and refines alternative ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins, while reweighting of structured proteins reveals folding intermediates and low-population excited states. These results establish HX as a quantitative restraint for ensemble reweighting and provide a scalable framework for benchmarking simulations and generative protein models.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象动力学是生物功能的核心，但在规模化表征上仍然困难。通过核磁共振或质谱测量的酰胺氢交换（HX）可探测这些动力学，但需要计算模型才能与结构系综整合。我们使用一个涵盖折叠蛋白和固有无序蛋白的大规模文献衍生数据集，对从系综计算 HX 的模型进行基准测试。随后，我们开发了一个模型，从局部结构描述符中识别具备交换能力的酰胺，同时考虑静电效应。该模型在由分子动力学和生成式 AI 生成的系综中，能在广泛动态范围内预测保护程度。HX 引导的系综重加权改善了与独立 NMR、SAXS 和折叠稳定性测量的一致性。毫秒级 HX 可区分并细化固有无序蛋白的替代系综，而对结构化蛋白进行重加权则可揭示折叠中间体和低占据激发态。这些结果确立了 HX 作为系综重加权的定量约束，并提供了一个可扩展框架，用于对模拟和生成式蛋白质模型进行基准测试。

items.title_en: Dark and bright solitons in a multimodal lithium tantalate microresonator
items.title_zh: 多模态钽酸锂微谐振器中的暗孤子和亮孤子
items.abstract_en: Bright-soliton and dark-pulse microcombs provide complementary outputs. Integrating both states in a single resonator would expand the operating capabilities of an integrated coherent source, but requires opposite group-velocity-dispersion (GVD) channels while reconciling localized interfamily interaction for dark-pulse formation with spectral isolation for independent bright-soliton pumping. Wavelength-addressed access to both states is achieved in a LiTaO$_3$ microring through two TE-like transverse mode families. The higher-order TE$_{10}$ family fulfills two distinct roles in different spectral regions. Within localized avoided-mode-crossing regions, mode-resolved spectroscopy implicates TE$_{10}$ in perturbing the normal-GVD TE$_{00}$ resonance sequence. Away from these regions, TE$_{10}$ retains anomalous GVD and remains spectrally isolated as an independently pumpable bright-soliton channel; at representative pump resonances, the closest resonance of the non-addressed family is separated by 75--192 loaded cavity linewidths. With the input polarization held fixed, pumping TE$_{00}$ and TE$_{10}$ resonances generates dark-pulse and bright-soliton microcombs, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first experimental realization of a dark-pulse microcomb in an integrated LiTaO$_3$ microring. These results establish transverse-mode-family engineering as a route to combining localized modal interaction with independent spectral addressing in a single microresonator.
items.abstract_zh: 亮孤子和暗脉冲微梳提供互补输出。在单个谐振器中集成这两种状态将扩展集成相干源的工作能力，但需要相反的群速度色散（GVD）通道，同时要协调用于暗脉冲形成的局域跨族相互作用与用于独立亮孤子泵浦的光谱隔离。通过两个类TE横模族，在LiTaO3微环中实现了对两种状态的波长寻址访问。高阶TE10族在不同光谱区域发挥两种不同作用。在局域避免模式交叉区域内，模式分辨光谱表明TE10参与扰动正常GVD的TE00共振序列。远离这些区域，TE10保持反常GVD，并作为可独立泵浦的亮孤子通道保持光谱隔离；在代表性泵浦共振处，非寻址族最近的共振相隔75–192个加载腔线宽。在输入偏振保持固定时，泵浦TE00和TE10共振分别产生暗脉冲和亮孤子微梳。据我们所知，这是集成LiTaO3微环中暗脉冲微梳的首次实验实现。这些结果确立了横模族工程作为在单个微谐振器中将局域模式相互作用与独立光谱寻址相结合的途径。

items.title_en: The Reliability Function of Error-Correcting Output Codes with Noisy Binary Classifiers
items.title_zh: 带噪声二分类器的纠错输出码的可靠性函数
items.abstract_en: Error-correcting output coding (ECOC) builds a multi-class classifier from binary classifiers. We study the excess error rate of ECOC over the Bayes (MAP) classifier when each binary classifier outputs a posterior estimate whose log-odds is corrupted by Gaussian noise. Recasting decoding as a test over a Gaussian channel, we derive an upper bound from the union and Chernoff bounds and a lower bound from the nearest competing category and the Mills ratio. The bounds show that a large Hamming distance is both necessary and sufficient for reducing the excess error rate. The excess error rate stays bounded away from zero, by a constant that depends on the two largest posteriors and the noise level but not on the number of categories $M$, whenever the distance between the code words of the two most probable categories is bounded; for equidistant codes this distance is $d_{\min}$. Conversely, it is at most $M-1$ times a factor that is exponentially small in the minimum distance $d_{\min}$, and it vanishes whenever $κ\,d_{\min}-\ln(M-1)\to\infty$ for an explicit $κ$ (for general codes, under a posterior condition). For $n$-vs-rest codes with $n\geq2$, the upper and lower exponents coincide asymptotically, which determines the reliability function of ECOC in closed form. The results extend to correlated Gaussian noise with the Hamming distance replaced by an effective distance; when noise is shared at the level of categories, the effective distance stays bounded and the excess error rate does not vanish for any code. All theorems are machine-checked in Lean 4. In a semi-synthetic setting, the measured decay agrees with the predicted exponent. On ResNet-50 features of CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-1k, the excess error over a log-likelihood decoding reference decreases with $d_{\min}$ and, for larger $M$, levels off at a moderate distance, while codes with $d_{\min}=1$ degrade as $M$ grows.
items.abstract_zh: 纠错输出编码（ECOC）由二分类器构建多类分类器。我们研究当每个二分类器输出的后验估计的对数几率被高斯噪声破坏时，ECOC 相对于贝叶斯（MAP）分类器的超额错误率。将解码重新表述为高斯信道上的检验，我们从联合界和 Chernoff 界推导上界，并从最近竞争类别和 Mills 比率推导下界。这些界表明，大汉明距离对于降低超额错误率既是必要的也是充分的。只要两个最可能类别的码字之间的距离有界，超额错误率就与零保持有界距离，该常数取决于两个最大后验和噪声水平，而不取决于类别数 $M$；对于等距码，该距离为 $d_{\min}$。反过来，它至多是 $M-1$ 乘以一个在最小距离 $d_{\min}$ 上指数小的因子；并且当 $κ\,d_{\min}-\ln(M-1)\to\infty$ 时，对于显式的 $κ$（对于一般码，在后验条件下），它趋于零。对于 $n$-vs-rest 码且 $n\geq2$，上下指数渐近重合，这以闭式确定了 ECOC 的可靠性函数。结果可扩展到相关高斯噪声，用有效距离替代汉明距离；当噪声在类别层面共享时，有效距离保持有界，且对于任何码，超额错误率都不会消失。所有定理均在 Lean 4 中机器验证。在半合成设置中，测得的衰减与预测指数一致。在 CIFAR-10/100 和 ImageNet-1k 的 ResNet-50 特征上，相对于对数似然解码参考的超额错误随 $d_{\min}$ 减小，并且对于更大的 $M$，在中等距离处趋于平稳，而 $d_{\min}=1$ 的码会随着 $M$ 增大而退化。

items.title_en: Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems
items.title_zh: 面向基于 LLM 的推荐系统不确定性量化的更真实评估
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for recommendation systems. However, their issued rankings require reliable instance-level uncertainty monitoring. In this scenario, comparing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods becomes challenging because LLM rankers lack a standard item-classification head. Their scores may depend on option labels, prompts, generation procedures, and the available user and item evidence. Existing methods derive uncertainty from different sources and apply it at different stages of the recommendation process. Some methods evaluate an issued ranking, whereas others use uncertainty to change the ranking itself, making direct comparison difficult. Here we introduce a fixed-ranking benchmark which evaluates eight heterogeneous UQ signals as record-level monitors under a shared output contract. We evaluate these signals across four recommendation datasets and two LLM backbones under a shared fixed-ranking protocol. From the results, we draw three main observations. First, UQ method ordering changes across backbones even on the same reference instances. Second, ranking-aligned Top10Mass provides the strongest scalar Error@10 detection in several evaluation conditions, reflecting effective cutoff-aligned monitoring, while its advantage narrows for popularity-tail targets. Third, scalar UQ signals are weak at identifying which control has the larger clipped NDCG@10 difference, whereas source-specific signals, including Perturbation Rank Instability and simple listwise distances, provide stronger paired-control agreement, reflecting their sensitivity to the two controlled evidence sources. These findings motivate us to evaluate ranking-failure detection, robustness across recommendation conditions, and responses to controlled evidence changes as distinct properties of UQ.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）为推荐系统提供了灵活的接口。然而，它们发布的排序需要可靠的实例级不确定性监测。在此场景中，比较不确定性量化（UQ）方法变得具有挑战性，因为 LLM 排序器缺乏标准的物品分类头。其分数可能取决于选项标签、提示、生成过程以及可用的用户和物品证据。现有方法从不同来源推导不确定性，并将其应用于推荐过程的不同阶段。一些方法评估已发布的排序，而另一些方法使用不确定性来改变排序本身，这使得直接比较困难。这里我们引入一个固定排序基准，它在共享输出契约下将八个异构 UQ 信号作为记录级监测器进行评估。我们在共享固定排序协议下，跨四个推荐数据集和两个 LLM 骨干评估这些信号。从结果中，我们得出三个主要观察。第一，即使在同一参考实例上，UQ 方法的排序也会随骨干变化。第二，与排序对齐的 Top10Mass 在若干评估条件下提供最强的标量 Error@10 检测，反映出有效的截断对齐监测，但其优势对流行度尾部目标会缩小。第三，标量 UQ 信号在识别哪个控制具有更大的裁剪 NDCG@10 差异方面较弱，而来源特定信号，包括 Perturbation Rank Instability 和简单的列表级距离，提供更强的成对控制一致性，反映出它们对两个受控证据来源的敏感性。这些发现促使我们将排序失败检测、跨推荐条件的鲁棒性以及对受控证据变化的响应作为 UQ 的不同属性来评估。

items.title_en: EnvTrap: Revealing the Environment-Only Attack Surface in Embodied AI via Consequence-Blind Action Execution
items.title_zh: EnvTrap：通过后果盲的动作执行揭示具身 AI 中仅环境攻击面
items.abstract_en: As AI models evolve from text and vision to physical agents, embodied AI faces a fundamentally different attack surface. Prior attacks on embodied systems have used crafted instructions, adversarial visual inputs, and training-time policy modifications; we study environment-only object rearrangements with unchanged models and instructions. We reveal an attack surface in safety-critical spatial relations among existing objects. An adversary who rearranges objects, without modifying instructions or accessing models, can cause hazardous consequences. In this work, we propose EnvTrap, a diagnostic pipeline that constructs paired safe, trap, and null-trap (benign but misleading) embodied scenarios. We demonstrate that environment-only perturbations raise hazardous-action rates to an average of 83.4% across the five evaluated action policies, with similar vulnerability patterns confirmed in world models. On a consequence-prediction task, model accuracy remains near chance, while human evaluators achieve high accuracy. We further propose a consequence-aware defense that reduces trap trigger rates by an average of 76.3 percentage points across action policies in simulation and by 62.9 percentage points pooled across physical backends. Together, these findings link environment-only attacks to a broader deficit in physical reasoning: embodied models recognize task-relevant objects yet fail to anticipate how spatial relations change the consequences of acting on them. EnvTrap makes this gap directly testable and turns hazardous layouts into training scenarios for safer embodied action. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap.
items.abstract_zh: 随着 AI 模型从文本和视觉演进为物理智能体，具身 AI 面临根本不同的攻击面。以往对具身系统的攻击使用了精心设计的指令、对抗性视觉输入以及训练时的策略修改；我们研究在模型和指令均不变的条件下仅通过环境中的物体重排实施的攻击。我们揭示了现有物体之间安全攸关空间关系中的一个攻击面。攻击者在不修改指令、不访问模型的情况下重排物体，便可造成危险后果。在本工作中，我们提出 EnvTrap，一个诊断流程，用于构建成对的安全、陷阱和空陷阱（良性但具误导性）具身场景。我们证明，仅环境扰动使五种被评估动作策略的危险动作率平均升至 83.4%，并在世界模型中也确认了相似的脆弱性模式。在后果预测任务上，模型准确率仍接近随机，而人类评估者达到高准确率。我们进一步提出一种后果感知防御，在仿真中将各动作策略的陷阱触发率平均降低 76.3 个百分点，在汇总多个物理后端时降低 62.9 个百分点。总之，这些发现将仅环境攻击与更广泛的物理推理缺陷联系起来：具身模型能识别任务相关物体，却无法预判空间关系如何改变对其采取行动的后果。EnvTrap 使这一差距可直接检验，并将危险布局转化为训练场景，以支持更安全的具身行动。代码和数据见 https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap。

items.title_en: RoMo Hands: A Large Scale Richly Organized Text to Hand Motion Dataset
items.title_zh: RoMo Hands：一个大规模、组织丰富的文本到手部运动数据集
items.abstract_en: While text-driven body motion generation has matured, pure-hand synthesis remains bottlenecked by data. Existing datasets often treat hands as rigid end-effectors, lack fine-grained captions, or are too limited in scale to support robust generalization. We introduce RoMo Hands, an in-the-wild, text-paired dataset of ~542K sequences (884 hours, 95.5M frames at 30 fps) which is an order of magnitude larger than prior work. To ensure high-quality supervision, a stringent dexterity filter discards low-articulation sequences, focusing the distribution on complex bimanual movement. Each clip is paired with five captions at increasing granularities from global semantic tags to atomic finger states, organized under a hierarchical taxonomy. To bridge the gap between body and hand architectures, we propose a novel 393-D bimanual representation that adapts redundant body-motion paradigms to the high-DoF kinematics of hands. Systematic benchmarking of diffusion, masked-token, and autoregressive generators reveals distinct trade-offs under these hand-specific adaptations, including a sharp divergence between semantic alignment and kinematic plausibility. Our dataset, representation, and benchmark establish a rigorous foundation for the next generation of dexterous motion synthesis. Project page: https://romodataset.github.io/romo-hands/.
items.abstract_zh: 虽然文本驱动的身体运动生成已经成熟，但纯手部合成仍受数据瓶颈制约。现有数据集通常将手视为刚性末端执行器，缺乏细粒度描述，或规模太有限而无法支持稳健泛化。我们引入 RoMo Hands，这是一个野外场景中与文本配对的数据集，包含约 542K 个序列（884 小时，30 fps 下 95.5M 帧），比先前工作大一个数量级。为确保高质量监督，严格的灵巧度过滤器丢弃低关节活动序列，使分布集中于复杂双手运动。每个片段配有五条字幕，粒度从全局语义标签递增到原子手指状态，并在分层分类体系下组织。为弥合身体与手部架构之间的差距，我们提出一种新的 393 维双手表示，将冗余的身体运动范式适配到手部的高自由度运动学。对扩散、掩码 token 和自回归生成器的系统基准测试揭示了在这些手部特定适配下的不同权衡，包括语义对齐与运动学合理性之间的显著分歧。我们的数据集、表示和基准为下一代灵巧运动合成奠定了严谨基础。项目页面：https://romodataset.github.io/romo-hands/。

items.title_en: A generative framework for unified representations bridging electrophysiological and haemodynamic brain activity
items.title_zh: 一种用于统一表征的生成框架，桥接电生理与血流动力学脑活动
items.abstract_en: Electrophysiological and haemodynamic recordings resolve brain activity at complementary temporal and spatial scales, yet paired acquisition remains difficult to scale. We propose a generative framework that aligns paired multimodal recordings in a unified representation space and generates modality-specific haemodynamic responses from EEG. In paired cohorts, the framework generated fMRI BOLD and fNIRS haemoglobin responses that reproduced regional dynamics, cortical maps, functional connectivity and task structure. Generated BOLD followed Real BOLD time courses and cortical patterns, while Generated haemoglobin responses tracked task-evoked HbO and HbR dynamics. The framework enabled decoding across visual, motor-imagery and mental-arithmetic tasks, independent-record decoding, external BOLD localization and low-sample augmentation. Paired feature-space calibration supported bidirectional retrieval. The proposed framework extends cortical analysis and brain decoding to EEG recordings when Real haemodynamic data are sparse.
items.abstract_zh: 电生理和血流动力学记录在互补的时间与空间尺度上解析脑活动，但配对采集仍然难以规模化。我们提出一种生成框架，在统一表征空间中对齐配对的多模态记录，并从EEG生成模态特定的血流动力学响应。在配对队列中，该框架生成fMRI BOLD和fNIRS血红蛋白响应，重现了区域动力学、皮层映射、功能连接和任务结构。生成的BOLD遵循真实BOLD的时间过程和皮层模式，而生成的血红蛋白响应跟踪任务诱发的HbO和HbR动力学。该框架支持跨视觉、运动想象和心理算术任务的解码、独立记录解码、外部BOLD定位和低样本增强。配对特征空间校准支持双向检索。当真实血流动力学数据稀疏时，所提出的框架将皮层分析和脑解码扩展到EEG记录。

items.title_en: Auditing a superconducting database built by a large language model
items.title_zh: 审计由大语言模型构建的超导数据库
items.abstract_en: The data on superconducting materials are published as measurements and scattered across the literature, in prose, in tables and in figures, so that gathering them into one place means reading the papers themselves. Large language models (LLMs) can read those papers, and databases built that way are appearing. The difficulty is not the reading but the trust: a number lifted out of a sentence can belong to a neighbouring compound, a computed transition temperature can be recorded without saying that it is computed, and the paper itself may be wrong. This paper describes a pipeline that extracts superconducting materials from the published literature with an LLM, checks every value against its source, and asks how far that checking goes. The pipeline proposed 19,576 records; a cascade of gates rejected 659,252 field-level extractions, 644,438 of them for want of verbatim evidence, 13,121 because the text does not attach the value to the material, and 1,693 because the source sentence reads as a calculation. The database that survives holds 3,137 material records, each with the sentence its value came from. An audit of the survivors by two independent models, on 500 records drawn in proportion to the database, shows that the gates remove the errors that are mechanical: in 93.4% of the audited records the value is in the text and the text is about the compound the record names, and 91.8% of them are measurements rather than predictions.
items.abstract_zh: 超导材料数据以测量结果形式发表，并分散于文献中的散文、表格和图像里，因此将其汇集到一处意味着要阅读论文本身。大语言模型（LLM）可以阅读这些论文，以这种方式构建的数据库正在出现。困难不在于阅读，而在于信任：从句子中提取出的数字可能属于相邻化合物；计算得到的转变温度可能被记录而未说明其为计算值；论文本身也可能有误。本文描述一个流程：用 LLM 从已发表文献中提取超导材料，对每个数值与其来源进行核对，并追问这种核对能深入到何种程度。该流程提出 19,576 条记录；一系列门控拒绝了 659,252 次字段级抽取，其中 644,438 次因缺少逐字证据，13,121 次因文本未将该数值归属于该材料，1,693 次因源句读起来像计算。最终保留的数据库包含 3,137 条材料记录，每条记录都带有其数值来源句子。由两个独立模型对幸存记录进行审计，样本为按数据库比例抽取的 500 条记录，结果显示门控移除了机械性错误：在受审计记录中，93.4% 的数值出现在文本中，且文本所涉化合物与记录所指化合物一致；其中 91.8% 是测量值而非预测值。

items.title_en: One Style Fits All? Cultural Values Embedded in Conversational AI via a People-Pleasing Lens
items.title_zh: 一种风格适合所有？从讨好倾向视角看会话 AI 中嵌入的文化价值观
items.abstract_en: Conversational AI systems trained on large-scale web corpora inevitably encode the cultural values and interactional norms embedded in their training data, yet our understanding of how deployed LLMs reflect or reinforce culture-specific social expectations remains limited. This study examined how supportive versus challenging chatbot interaction styles shape user experience and continuance intention, and whether people-pleasing tendency (PPT) moderates these effects across cultures. Taiwanese (N = 49) and Korean (N = 52) participants completed a collaborative tourism-planning task. Results showed that: (1) supportive chatbots consistently led to higher continuance intention, satisfaction, and trust; (2) PPT did not moderate these effects; and (3) cultural variation emerged only in perceived threat, where higher PPT was associated with greater baseline threat in the Taiwanese but not the Korean sample. These findings reveal how a general-purpose LLM style may differentially activate culturally situated social scripts, raising implications for culturally inclusive conversational AI design.
items.abstract_zh: 基于大规模网络语料训练的会话 AI 系统不可避免地编码了训练数据中嵌入的文化价值观和互动规范，然而我们对已部署 LLM 如何反映或强化特定文化的社会期望仍知之甚少。本研究考察支持性与挑战性聊天机器人互动风格如何塑造用户体验和持续使用意向，以及讨好倾向（PPT）是否在不同文化中调节这些效应。台湾（N = 49）和韩国（N = 52）参与者完成了一项协作旅游规划任务。结果显示：（1）支持性聊天机器人始终带来更高的持续使用意向、满意度和信任；（2）PPT 并未调节这些效应；（3）文化差异仅出现在感知威胁上，其中较高的 PPT 在台湾样本中与更高的基线威胁相关，而在韩国样本中则不然。这些发现揭示了通用 LLM 风格可能如何差异化地激活文化情境化的社会脚本，并对文化包容性会话 AI 设计提出了启示。

items.title_en: Specification-Aware Sparse Differentiation: Planning under Signal Temporal Logic with Sparsemax Robustness
items.title_zh: 规范感知的稀疏微分：在带有 Sparsemax 鲁棒性的信号时序逻辑下规划
items.abstract_en: Gradient-based optimal control under a Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specification involves solving a nonlinear program whose constraints are smoothed robustness functions of the trajectory, and automatic differentiation without knowledge of sparsity computes the Jacobian and the Hessian that its solver needs in full. This often renders the problem computationally intractable. The dynamics and the specification prescribe a sparsity pattern through the STL syntax, the windows of the temporal operators and the variables that the predicates read. Standard tools such as CasADi recover this pattern by structural detection. In this work, we propose a method to prescribe such a pattern directly from the task specification. We show that our method allows us to exploit SparseMax, a recently proposed smooth robustness operator that is certifiably sparse and sound. Its derivative is exactly zero at every operand at or below a data-dependent threshold, which structural detection cannot see. We derive the patterns that expose this trajectory-dependent sparsity to sparse automatic differentiation, with a margin test for their reuse and Hessians confined to the variables of each constraint's support. We demonstrate the method on a dual-arm coordination task in which two arms share a hand-off zone divided into cells and one until constraint per scheduled visit keeps the other arm out of a cell until the visitor has left it. The two scenes are a zone of five cells and a circle of 64 cells, with single solves and closed-loop re-planning on a rigid-body simulation. Our exact-Hessian interior-point solves are up to 27 times faster than those with the sound log-sum-exp robustness in CasADi and IPOPT.
items.abstract_zh: 在信号时序逻辑（STL）规范下的基于梯度的最优控制涉及求解一个非线性规划，其约束是轨迹的平滑鲁棒性函数，而不知道稀疏性的自动微分会完整计算其求解器所需的雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵。这通常使问题在计算上难以处理。动力学和规范通过 STL 语法、时序算子的窗口以及谓词读取的变量规定了一种稀疏模式。像 CasADi 这样的标准工具通过结构检测恢复该模式。在这项工作中，我们提出一种直接从任务规范规定这种模式的方法。我们表明，我们的方法允许利用 SparseMax，这是一种最近提出的平滑鲁棒性算子，具有可证明的稀疏性和可靠性。在每个等于或低于数据相关阈值的操作数处，其导数恰好为零，而结构检测无法看到这一点。我们推导出将这些依赖于轨迹的稀疏性暴露给稀疏自动微分的模式，并带有用于复用它们的边际检验，以及限制在每个约束支撑变量上的海森矩阵。我们在一个双臂协调任务上演示该方法，其中两条臂共享一个划分为单元格的交接区域，并且每次计划访问有一个 until 约束，使另一条臂在访问者离开某个单元格之前不能进入该单元格。两个场景是一个由五个单元格组成的区域和一个由 64 个单元格组成的圆，在刚体仿真上进行单次求解和闭环重规划。我们的精确海森内点法求解比在 CasADi 和 IPOPT 中使用可靠的 log-sum-exp 鲁棒性的求解快最多 27 倍。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 区分计算预测、回顾性分析与实验验证；不把模型输出作为临床结论，数据和权重许可需单独核对。
